Text (Russian): Ух, я словно заболела и вывалялась в грязи гадких мыслей этого страшно эгоцентричного человека. Так это был... Малахай? Монстр, устроивший Катаклизм? Я пережила именно тот момент?
Text (Spanish): Uf, los viles pensamientos de alguien tan absorto en sí mismo me hacen sentir asqueado y sucio. ¿Era ese… Malachai? ¿El monstruo que produjo el Cataclismo? ¿Acabo de revivir ese momento?
Text (Thai): Ugh, I am left sickened and dirtied by the vile thoughts of someone intensely self-absorbed. Was that... Malachai? The monster who brought about the Cataclysm? Did I just relive that moment?
Text (Traditional Chinese): 噁，我被一個極度自我中心的傢伙搞得噁心想吐。那是...瑪拉凱？那個帶來了大災變的怪物？我現在是在重溫那場夢魘嗎？

Text: It's him! He sails back to me, my Daresso! I shall sing for him. I shall show him the way. Come, my love. Come to me. We shall be together at last.
Text (French): C'est lui ! Mon Daresso a pris la mer pour revenir dans mes bras ! Je vais chanter pour lui. Je vais lui montrer la voie. Viens, mon amour. Viens jusqu'à moi, que nous soyons enfin réunis.
Text (German): Er ist es! Er segelt zurück zu mir, mein Daresso! Ich werde für ihn singen. Ich werde ihm den Weg weisen. Kommt zu mir, mein Liebster. Kommt zu mir. Endlich werden wir wieder vereint sein.
Text (Japanese): It's him! He sails back to me, my Daresso! I shall sing for him. I shall show him the way. Come, my love. Come to me. We shall be together at last.
Text (Korean): 다레소잖아! 나의 다레소가 내게 돌아오고 있다고! 노래를 불러야겠어. 이쪽으로 오도록 말이지. 어서 와, 내 사랑. 내게로 와 줘. 마침내 영원히 함께하는 거야.
Text (Portuguese): É ele! Ele navega de volta para mim, meu Daresso! Cantarei  para ele. Vou mostrar-lhe o caminho. Venha, meu amor. Venha para mim. Finalmente estaremos juntos.
Text (Russian): Это он! Мой Дарессо, он возвращается ко мне! Я стану ему петь. Я покажу ему путь. Приди, любовь моя. Приди ко мне. Наконец-то мы будем вместе.
Text (Spanish): ¡Es él! Está navegando hacia mí, ¡mi Daresso! Cantaré para él. Le mostraré el camino. Ven, amor mío. Ven a mí. Al fin estaremos juntos.
Text (Thai): It's him! He sails back to me, my Daresso! I shall sing for him. I shall show him the way. Come, my love. Come to me. We shall be together at last.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 是他！他回來了，我的德瑞索！我應該為他唱歌。我應該為他帶路。來吧，我的愛。到我這裡來。我們終於能夠團圓了。

Text: No, turn away! Don't listen to my singing, you'll die upon the rocks! Turn away...! Turn away... Turn away...
Text (French): Non, fais demi-tour ! N'écoute pas mon chant, sinon tu mourras contre les rochers ! Fais demi-tour… ! Fais demi-tour… Fais demi-tour…
Text (German): Nein, kehr um! Hör nicht auf meinen Gesang, du wirst auf den Felsen enden! Kehr um ...! Kehr um ... kehr um ...
Text (Japanese): No, turn away! Don't listen to my singing, you'll die upon the rocks! Turn away...! Turn away... Turn away...
Text (Korean): 아냐, 돌아가! 내 노래를 듣지 마! 바위에 부딪혀 죽게 될 거라고! 돌아가...! 돌아가... 제발 돌아가...
Text (Portuguese): Não, fique longe! Não escute minha canção, você morrerá nas pedras! Fique longe...! Fique longe... fique longe...
Text (Russian): Нет, уплывай! Не слушай моё пение, иначе разобьёшься о скалы! Уплывай!.. Уплывай... Уплывай...
Text (Spanish): ¡No! ¡Aléjense! ¡No escuchen mi canto! ¡Morirán en las rocas! ¡Aléjense…! Aléjense… Aléjense…
Text (Thai): No, turn away! Don't listen to my singing, you'll die upon the rocks! Turn away...! Turn away... Turn away...
Text (Traditional Chinese): 不，快走！別聽我的歌聲，你會死在礁岩上的！快逃...！快逃...快逃....

Text: Was that Merveil? That poor woman. Somewhere within her monstrous form lived the woman she once was. What a terrible curse.
Text (French): N'était-ce pas… Merveil ? Pauvre femme. Quelque part derrière son aspect monstrueux vivait encore celle qu'elle fut jadis. Quelle terrible malédiction…
Text (German): War das Merveil? Diese arme Frau. Irgendwo in ihrer monströsen Gestalt lebte die Frau, die sie einst war. Welch ein schrecklicher Fluch.
Text (Japanese): Was that Merveil? That poor woman. Somewhere within her monstrous form lived the woman she once was. What a terrible curse.
Text (Korean): 머베일이었나요? 불쌍한 여자였네요. 그 괴물의 모습 안 어딘가에 본래 인간으로서의 그 여자가 남아있었나 봐요. 이 무슨 끔찍한 저주인지.
Text (Portuguese): Aquela era... Merveil? Coitada. Em algum lugar dentro de sua forma monstruosa viveu a mulher que ela fora. Que maldição terrível.
Text (Russian): Это была Мервейл? Бедняжка. В теле чудовища оставалась частица былой женщины. Что за кошмарное проклятье.
Text (Spanish): ¿Esa era Merveil? Pobre mujer. En algún lugar dentro de esa monstruosa forma vivía la mujer que una vez fue. Qué terrible maldición.
Text (Thai): Was that Merveil? That poor woman. Somewhere within her monstrous form lived the woman she once was. What a terrible curse.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 那是...莫薇兒？可憐的女人。難以相信那個駭人的外表以前曾是個動人的美女。多麼可怕的詛咒。

Text: The Courts are burning. Accusations fly. Sinner! Heretic! I am but an initiate, and my patron urges silence. We will keep our heads down while one High Templar supplants another. It's all about power, my patron whispers, and we have none.
Text (French): Le Tribunal est en flammes. Les accusations fusent de toutes parts. « Pécheur ! Hérétique ! » Je ne suis qu'un initié et mon supérieur m'impose le silence. Nous allons faire profil bas le temps qu'un Haut templier en supplante un autre. Tout est une question de pouvoir, me souffle à l'oreille mon protecteur, et nous n'en avons aucun.
Text (German): Die Gerichte stehen in Flammen. Anschuldigungen hallen durch die Räumlichkeiten. Sünder! Ketzer! Ich bin nur ein Novize und mein Schutzheiliger fordert Ruhe. Wir werden unsere Köpfe unten halten, während ein Hoher Templer den anderen verdrängt. Es geht um Macht, flüstert er mir, und wir haben keine.
Text (Japanese): The Courts are burning. Accusations fly. Sinner! Heretic! I am but an initiate, and my patron urges silence. We will keep our heads down while one High Templar supplants another. It's all about power, my patron whispers, and we have none.
Text (Korean): 법정이 불타오른다. 고발이 난무하고 있다. 죄인이다! 이단이다! 신참에 지나지 않는 내게 후원자는 잠자코 있으라 지시할 뿐이다. 고위 템플러가 바뀔 때까진 머리를 숙이고 있어 주마. 후원자가 속삭이듯이 결국은 권력이 전부다. 하지만 현재 우리에겐 아무런 권력도 없지.
Text (Portuguese): Os Tribunais queimavam. Acusações voavam. Pecador! Herege! Eu era apenas um iniciado, e meu patrono incitou silêncio. Mantivemos a cabeça baixa enquanto um Alto Templários substituía outro. É tudo uma questão de poder, meu patrono sussurrou, e não temos nenhum.\r\n
Text (Russian): Суды горят. Люди обвиняют друг друга. Грешник! Святотатец! Я всего лишь послушник, на которого шикает наставник. Пока верховные жрецы борются за положение, мы будем держаться ниже травы. Наставник шепчет, что всему виной власть, а у нас её нет.
Text (Spanish): Las Cortes están ardiendo. Vuelan las acusaciones. ¡Pecador! ¡Hereje! Soy solo un iniciado, y mi patrón me urge al silencio. Mantendremos nuestras cabezas bajas mientras un Alto Templario suplanta a otro. Todo gira alrededor del poder, susurra mi patrón, y nosotros no tenemos.
Text (Thai): The Courts are burning. Accusations fly. Sinner! Heretic! I am but an initiate, and my patron urges silence. We will keep our heads down while one High Templar supplants another. It's all about power, my patron whispers, and we have none.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 教廷燒起來了。指控漫天飛舞。罪人！異教徒！不，我只是個發起人，而我的支持者主張沉默。當聖宗交替時，我們將低下頭。這一切都是權力遊戲，我的支持者低語著，而我們則保持沉默。

Text: Should an accusation fall our way, we shall be doomed to die with the other accused. Be unseen and unheard, he whispers. This is what happens when men who seek power refuse to wait. I learned a valuable lesson that day: Trust without leverage is vulnerability.
Text (French): Si l'on devait nous-mêmes devenir la cible d'accusations, nous serions condamnés à mourir comme tous les autres accusés. Il me murmure de ne pas me faire voir ni entendre. Voilà ce qui arrive quand les hommes en quête de pouvoir refusent d'attendre. J'ai appris une importante leçon ce jour-là : lorsqu'on n'a aucune influence, faire confiance, c'est être vulnérable.
Text (German): Sollten wir jemals einer Sache beschuldigt werden, sind wir dazu verdammt, mit den anderen Angeklagten zu sterben. Verhalte dich immer unauffällig, flüstert er. Das ist es, was passiert, wenn Menschen, die nach Macht streben, sich weigern zu warten. Wenn man jemandem vertraut, ohne ein Druckmittel in der Hand zu haben, ist man verwundbar.
Text (Japanese): Should an accusation fall our way, we shall be doomed to die with the other accused. Be unseen and unheard, he whispers. This is what happens when men who seek power refuse to wait. I learned a valuable lesson that day: Trust without leverage is vulnerability.
Text (Korean): 고발이라도 당한다면, 우리는 다른 죄인들과 함께 죽음이라는 운명만을 맞이하게 될 것이다. 드러내지 말고 잠자코 있으라 후원자는 속삭이고 있다. 권력을 추구하면서 인내할 줄 모르면 이렇게 되는 거였군. 그날 나는 하나의 소중한 교훈을 배웠다. 힘없는 신뢰는 나약하기 짝이 없다는 것을.
Text (Portuguese): Se uma acusação cair em nosso caminho, estaremos condenados a morrer com os outros acusados. Seja invisível e inaudível, ele sussurrou. É o que acontece quando os homens que procuram poder se recusam a esperar. Eu aprendi uma lição valiosa naquele dia: a confiança sem vantagem é vulnerabilidade.\r\n
Text (Russian): Если нас обвинят, мы будем обречены принять смерть вместе с другими обвинёнными. Наставник шепчет, что нас не должно быть видно и слышно. Вот что бывает, когда рвущиеся к власти люди не хотят ждать. В этот день я усвоил ценный урок: доверие без рычагов давления делает тебя уязвимым.
Text (Spanish): Si una acusación recae sobre nosotros, estaremos condenados a morir con los otros acusados. Me susurra que nadie debe verme ni oírme. Esto es lo que ocurre cuando los hombres que buscan poder se rehúsan a esperar. Aprendí una valiosa lección ese día: la confianza sin ninguna ventaja es vulnerabilidad.
Text (Thai): Should an accusation fall our way, we shall be doomed to die with the other accused. Be unseen and unheard, he whispers. This is what happens when men who seek power refuse to wait. I learned a valuable lesson that day: Trust without leverage is vulnerability.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 如果罪名阻礙了我們的道路，那麼我們注定與其他被告一同死去。無視一切，他低語著。這就是當一個人追求權力卻不願等待時會發生的事。今天我學到了寶貴的一課：無償的信任，是最為脆弱的。

Text: Exile! That was the moment Venarius decided to seize life and vie for power. That was the moment doom for men like my father was assured.
Text (French): <if:MS>{Exilé ! C'est l'instant où Vénarius a décidé de créer sa propre chance et de lutter pour le pouvoir. L'instant qui a scellé le destin des hommes comme mon père.}<elif:FS>{Exilée ! C'est l'instant où Vénarius a décidé de créer sa propre chance et de lutter pour le pouvoir. L'instant qui a scellé le destin des hommes comme mon père.}
Text (German): <if:MS>{Verbannter! Dies war der Moment, in dem Venarius beschloss, nach der Macht zu greifen. Dies war der Moment, in dem der Untergang für Männer wie meinen Vater besiegelt wurde.}<elif:FS>{Verbannte! Dies war der Moment, in dem Venarius beschloss, nach der Macht zu greifen. Dies war der Moment, in dem der Untergang für Männer wie meinen Vater besiegelt wurde.}
Text (Japanese): Exile! That was the moment Venarius decided to seize life and vie for power. That was the moment doom for men like my father was assured.
Text (Korean): 이건 베나리우스가 온 생을 다해 권력을 추구하기로 결심한 기억이었어요. 우리 아버지 같은 사람들의 운명이 나락으로 떨어지던 순간이었죠.
Text (Portuguese): <if:MS>{Exilado! Esse foi o momento em que Venarius decidiu aproveitar a vida e disputar o poder. Esse foi o momento em que foi garantida a ruína para homens como meu pai.}<elif:FS>{Exilada! Esse foi o momento em que Venarius decidiu aproveitar a vida e disputar o poder. Esse foi o momento em que foi garantida a ruína para homens como meu pai.}
Text (Russian): Изгнанник! Это момент, когда Венарий решил посвятить свою жизнь погоне за властью. Тот миг, в который людям вроде моего отца был подписан смертный приговор.
Text (Spanish): ¡Exiliado! Ese fue el momento en que Venarius decidió aferrarse a la vida y luchar por el poder. Ese fue el momento en que los hombres como mi padre fueron condenados.
Text (Thai): Exile! That was the moment Venarius decided to seize life and vie for power. That was the moment doom for men like my father was assured.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 流亡者！那就是維那利斯決定為了奪取權力而奪去生命的那一刻。就像我的父親所遭遇的那個死亡的瞬間一樣。

Text: Master's orders were clear; I am to wait here until his return. I cast my eyes to the horizon and see smoke billowing from Sarn. The city burns, and I fear my master burns with it.
Text (French): Les ordres du maître sont clairs : je dois attendre son retour ici même. En portant mon regard à l'horizon, je distingue une épaisse fumée qui s'élève de Sarn. La cité brûle et je crains que mon maître ne soit en train de brûler avec elle.
Text (German): Die Befehle des Meisters waren klar – ich warte hier auf seine Rückkehr. Mein Blick geht gen Horizont und ich sehe, wie sich in Sarn Rauch auftürmt. Die Stadt brennt, und ich fürchte, mein Herr brennt mit ihr.
Text (Japanese): Master's orders were clear; I am to wait here until his return. I cast my eyes to the horizon and see smoke billowing from Sarn. The city burns, and I fear my master burns with it.
Text (Korean): 스승님의 명령은 명확했다. 그분께서 돌아오실 때까지 여기서 기다려야 한다. 나는 지평선을 흘깃 바라보고는 사안에서 연기가 피어오르는 모습을 지켜보았다. 도시가 불탄다. 스승님께서도 저기서 불타버릴까 두렵다.
Text (Portuguese): As ordens do Mestre foram claras; devo esperar aqui até que ele volte. Eu lancei meu olhar para o horizonte e vi fumaça saindo de Sarn. A cidade queimava, e temo que meu mestre queimava com ela.
Text (Russian): Господин чётко дал понять, что мне надо дождаться его возвращения. Я всматриваюсь в горизонт и вижу клубящийся над Сарном дым. Город пылает. Боюсь, мой господин горит вместе с ним.
Text (Spanish): Las órdenes del Maestro fueron claras: debo esperar aquí hasta que regrese. Si miro hacia el horizonte puedo ver columnas de humo saliendo de Sarn. La ciudad arde, y temo que mi maestro arda con ella.
Text (Thai): Master's orders were clear; I am to wait here until his return. I cast my eyes to the horizon and see smoke billowing from Sarn. The city burns, and I fear my master burns with it.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 主人的命令非常明確：在這裡等待他回來。我將眼光投向遠方，看見滾滾濃煙從薩恩城竄出。城市陷入一片火海，而我擔心我的主人會被大火吞噬。

Text: The sky grows red. I hear screaming from the village by the Crossroads, but I will not abandon my post. Master will return, and I will await him. No matter how long, I will wait for Maligaro's return...
Text (French): Le ciel devient rouge. J'entends des cris retentir depuis le village près de la Croisée des chemins, mais je ne quitterai pas mon poste quoiqu'il advienne. Mon maître reviendra et je l'attendrai. J'attendrai le retour de Maligaro le temps qu'il faudra…
Text (German): Der Himmel färbt sich rot. Schreie aus dem Dorf am Wegekreuz ereilen mein Gehör, aber ich werde meinen Posten nicht aufgeben. Mein Meister wird zurückkehren, und ich werde ihn erwarten. Egal wie lange, ich werde auf Maligaros Rückkehr warten ...
Text (Japanese): The sky grows red. I hear screaming from the village by the Crossroads, but I will not abandon my post. Master will return, and I will await him. No matter how long, I will wait for Maligaro's return...
Text (Korean): 하늘이 붉게 물든다. 교차로 옆의 마을에서 비명 소리가 들려오지만 지금 내 자리를 벗어날 순 없다. 스승님께선 돌아오실 것이다. 그분을 기다릴 것이다. 아무리 오래 걸리더라도 말리가로 님의 귀환을 기다릴 것이다...
Text (Portuguese): O céu ficou vermelho. Eu ouvi gritos vindo da aldeia perto da Encruzilhada, mas não abandonei o meu posto. O Mestre retornaria e eu o esperaria. Não importa quanto tempo, esperaria pelo retorno de Maligaro...
Text (Russian): Небо краснеет. Я слышу вопли из деревеньки у перекрёстка, но не стану покидать свой пост. Я должна дождаться господина. Сколько бы ни пришлось ждать, я дождусь возвращения Малигаро.
Text (Spanish): El cielo se torna rojo. Oigo gritos provenientes en la aldea de la Encrucijada, pero no abandonaré mi puesto. Mi Maestros regresará y yo lo esperaré. No importa cuánto tarde, esperaré el regreso de Malígaro…
Text (Thai): The sky grows red. I hear screaming from the village by the Crossroads, but I will not abandon my post. Master will return, and I will await him. No matter how long, I will wait for Maligaro's return...
Text (Traditional Chinese): 天空呈現一片通紅。我聽見危機岔路的村子傳來陣陣尖叫，但我不會捨棄我的命令。主人會回來的，我會等著他。無論多久，我都會等著馬雷葛蘿回來...

Text: A memory from someone close to the Inquisitor. How exciting! I bet there are many historians who would be interested in such a find.
Text (French): C'est le souvenir de quelqu'un proche de l'Inquisiteur. Comme c'est excitant ! Je parie qu'une telle trouvaille susciterait l'intérêt de nombreux historiens.
Text (German): Eine Erinnerung von jemandem, der dem Inquisitor nahe steht. Wie aufregend! Ich wette, es gibt viele Historiker, die sich für einen Fund dieser Kategorie interessieren würden.
Text (Japanese): A memory from someone close to the Inquisitor. How exciting! I bet there are many historians who would be interested in such a find.
Text (Korean): 이단심문관과 가까웠던 사람의 기억이네요. 굉장한데요! 역사가라면 누구나 이 광경에 눈이 뒤집힐걸요!
Text (Portuguese): Uma memória de alguém próximo ao Inquisidor... Que emocionante! Aposto que muitos historiadores se interessariam por esse achado.
Text (Russian): Это воспоминание близкого к дознавателю человека. Как занятно! Готова биться об заклад, что эта находка заинтересует многих историков.
Text (Spanish): Una memoria de alguien cercano al Inquisidor. ¡Qué emocionante! Apuesto que muchos historiadores estarían interesados en un hallazgo así.
Text (Thai): A memory from someone close to the Inquisitor. How exciting! I bet there are many historians who would be interested in such a find.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 一個來自審判者身邊的人的記憶。真是令人振奮！我敢說一定有很多的史學家對這個發現感興趣。

Text: Another child was taken last night, so tonight we wait, praying the demon does not return, but it does. It soars through the air and passes through the wall of the hut. We catch only a glimpse of its grey skin beneath the moonlight. We pursue the demon on foot to the edge of the woods. The child it carries does not cry out.
Text (French): Un autre enfant a été enlevé la nuit dernière, alors ce soir, nous restons figés dans l'attente en priant que le démon ne revienne pas — mais il est de retour. Il flotte dans l'air et passe au travers de la paroi de la hutte, ne nous offrant qu'un aperçu de sa peau grise au clair de lune. Nous pourchassons le démon à pied jusqu'à l'orée du bois. L'enfant qu'il transporte ne crie pas à l'aide.
Text (German): Letzte Nacht wurde ein weiteres Kind entführt, also warten wir heute Abend und beten, dass der Dämon nicht zurückkehrt, aber er kommt. Im Mondlicht erhaschen wir nur einen flüchtigen Blick auf seine graue Haut. Wir folgen dem Dämon zu Fuß bis zum Waldrand. Das Kind, das er trägt, gibt keine Laute von sich.
Text (Japanese): Another child was taken last night, so tonight we wait, praying the demon does not return, but it does. It soars through the air and passes through the wall of the hut. We catch only a glimpse of its grey skin beneath the moonlight. We pursue the demon on foot to the edge of the woods. The child it carries does not cry out.
Text (Korean): 어젯밤 또 다른 아이가 사라졌다. 오늘도 우린 그 악마가 돌아오지 않기만을 기도하고 있다. 기도는 소용이 없었다. 악마가 하늘을 날아 오두막의 벽을 통과해 들어온다. 우리는 그저 월광 아래에서 악마의 회색 피부만을 흘깃 볼 수 있었다. 걸어서 숲 가장자리까지 악마를 추적해보았다. 악마에게 납치당한 아이는 잠잠할 뿐이었다.
Text (Portuguese): Outra criança foi levada noite passado, então naquela noite nós esperamos, rezando para que o demônio não voltasse, mas ele voltou. Ele voou pelo ar e passou pela parede da cabana. Vimos apenas um vislumbre de sua pele cinza sob a luz do luar. Perseguimos o demônio a pé até a entrada da floresta. A criança que ele carregou não chorava.
Text (Russian): Прошлой ночью пропал ещё один ребёнок. Теперь мы ждём и возносим молитвы о том, чтобы демон не вернулся... но он уже здесь. Он проносится по воздуху и проникает сквозь стену хижины. Мы только мельком успеваем заметить отблеск его серой кожи под светом луны. Мы бежим вслед за демоном до самого края леса. Он уносит дитя, которое уже не плачет.
Text (Spanish): Anoche se ha llevado otro niño, así que esta noche esperamos y rezamos para que el demonio no regrese, pero regresa. Viaja por el aire y atraviesa la pared de la choza. Solo logramos ver un atisbo de su piel gris bajo la luz de la luna. Perseguimos al demonio a pie hasta el límite del bosque. El niño que lleva no llora.
Text (Thai): Another child was taken last night, so tonight we wait, praying the demon does not return, but it does. It soars through the air and passes through the wall of the hut. We catch only a glimpse of its grey skin beneath the moonlight. We pursue the demon on foot to the edge of the woods. The child it carries does not cry out.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 昨夜又有一個小孩被帶走了。因此今晚我們守著，並祈禱那個惡魔不會再來，但牠卻又回來了。牠在空中遨翔並穿過了小屋的牆壁。在月光的照射下，我們只能看到牠那慘灰的外皮。我們徒步追趕那個惡魔直至森林的邊緣。但被牠捉走的小孩並沒有哭鬧。

Text: Anaris follows closely, but I hesitate out of fear. I gather my will and I leap into the shadows, tracking the demon by the tendrils left in its wake. But I am too late. The demon and child are gone, and Anaris stands frozen, pale as the moon. He whispers something I do not understand and falls, dead. I fear we will be hunted to extinction.
Text (French): Anaris le talonne de près, mais la peur me fait hésiter. Je rassemble mon courage et plonge dans l'obscurité, pistant le démon en suivant les filaments qu'il laisse dans son sillage. Cependant, j'arrive trop tard. Le démon et l'enfant ont disparu et Anaris demeure figé, pâle comme la lune. Il murmure quelque chose que je ne saisis pas avant de tomber raide mort. Je redoute que l'on nous extermine à petit feu.
Text (German): Anaris folgt ihm, aber ich zögere aus Angst. Ich sammle meinen Mut und springe in die Schatten, wo ich den Dämon nur noch anhand der sich windenden Ranken erschließen kann. Aber ich bin zu spät. Der Dämon und das Kind sind weg, und Anaris steht erstarrt da, fahl wie der Mond. Er flüstert etwas, das ich nicht verstehen kann und fällt tot um. Ich fürchte, dass wir bis zum Aussterben gejagt werden.
Text (Japanese): Anaris follows closely, but I hesitate out of fear. I gather my will and I leap into the shadows, tracking the demon by the tendrils left in its wake. But I am too late. The demon and child are gone, and Anaris stands frozen, pale as the moon. He whispers something I do not understand and falls, dead. I fear we will be hunted to extinction.
Text (Korean): 아나리스는 바짝 따라붙었지만, 난 두려움에 주저하고 있었다. 곧 마음을 추스른 후 어둠 속으로 뛰어들어 흔적을 좇아 악마를 추적했다. 하지만 너무 늦었다. 악마와 아이는 오간데 없이 사라졌고 아나리스는 달처럼 창백하게 얼어붙어 서 있을 뿐이었다. 그는 무언가 알아들을 수 없는 말을 속삭이더니 쓰러져 죽어 버리고 말았다. 이러다가 우리가 모조리 사냥당하는 건 아닐까 두렵다.
Text (Portuguese): Anaris seguia de perto, mas eu hesitei por medo. Juntei toda minha força de vontade e mergulhei nas sombras, seguindo o demônio pelos rastros deixados em seu caminho. Mas cheguei tarde demais. O demônio e a criança se foram, e Anaris permanecia estático, pálido como a lua. Ele sussurrou algo que não compreendi e caiu, morto. Temia que seríamos caçados até a extinção.
Text (Russian): Анарис преследует демона по пятам, но я мешкаю от страха. Потом собираю волю в кулак и прыгаю в тень, высматривая похитителя по оставленным следам. Но уже поздно. Демон и ребёнок пропали. Я вижу только замершего и бледного Анариса. Он что-то неразборчиво шепчет, а после падает замертво. Я опасаюсь, что эдак мы вымрем все до единого.
Text (Spanish): Anaris lo sigue de cerca, pero yo dudo, pues tengo miedo. Reúno valor y salto hacia las sombras, siguiendo los restos que deja el demonio a su paso. Pero es tarde. El demonio y el niño se han ido, y Anaris está inmóvil y pálido como la luna. Susurra algo que no puedo comprender y cae, muerto. Temo que seremos cazados hasta la extinción.
Text (Thai): Anaris follows closely, but I hesitate out of fear. I gather my will and I leap into the shadows, tracking the demon by the tendrils left in its wake. But I am too late. The demon and child are gone, and Anaris stands frozen, pale as the moon. He whispers something I do not understand and falls, dead. I fear we will be hunted to extinction.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 安納里斯緊追在後，但我卻因為恐懼而踟躕不前。我在重新鼓起勇氣後跳進了暗影之中，透過牠所留下來的痕跡追蹤著惡魔。但我來遲了。惡魔和孩子都不見了，安納里斯呆站在原地，臉色蒼白如月。他低語著一些我無法理解的東西，隨後便倒地不起。我害怕我們將會被狩獵直至滅絕。

Text: Could it be...? Exile, this sounds just like the entity hunting my father. But... the memory is so old. How is this possible?
Text (French): <if:MS>{Serait-ce… ? Exilé, on dirait l'entité qui pourchasse mon père. Mais… Ce souvenir est si ancien ! Comment est-ce possible ?}<elif:FS>{Serait-ce… ? Exilée, on dirait l'entité qui pourchasse mon père. Mais… Ce souvenir est si ancien ! Comment est-ce possible ?}
Text (German): <if:MS>{Könnte das ...? Verbannter, es klingt genau wie das Wesen, das meinen Vater jagt. Aber ... Die Erinnerung ist so alt. Wie ist das möglich?}<elif:FS>{Könnte das ...? Verbannte, es klingt genau wie das Wesen, das meinen Vater jagt. Aber ... Die Erinnerung ist so alt. Wie ist das möglich?}
Text (Japanese): Could it be...? Exile, this sounds just like the entity hunting my father. But... the memory is so old. How is this possible?
Text (Korean): 그럴 리가..? 이건 그 존재가 우리 아버지를 사냥하던 때와 같은 기억이에요. 그런데... 굉장히 오래전의 기억이네요. 어떻게 이런 게 가능한 거죠?
Text (Portuguese): <if:MS>{Será...? Exilado, parece a entidade que assombra meu pai. Mas... A memória é tão antiga. Como é possível?}<elif:FS>{Será...? Exilada, parece a entidade que assombra meu pai. Mas... A memória é tão antiga. Como é possível?}
Text (Russian): Неужели это?.. Изгнанник, это существо очень похоже на тварь, которая охотится на моего отца. Только... Это воспоминание такое старое. Разве такое возможно?
Text (Spanish): <if:MS>{¿Podrá ser…? Exiliado, suena justo como la entidad que caza a mi padre. Pero… La memoria es tan antigua… ¿Cómo es posible?}<elif:FS>{¿Podrá ser…? Exiliada, suena justo como la entidad que caza a mi padre. Pero… La memoria es tan antigua… ¿Cómo es posible?}
Text (Thai): Could it be...? Exile, this sounds just like the entity hunting my father. But... the memory is so old. How is this possible?
Text (Traditional Chinese): 這有可能嗎...？流亡者，這聽起來像是那個狩獵我父親的東西。但...這個記憶實在太古老了。這怎麼可能？

Text: A man in uniform visits. He is from the Courts. He says the Templar have alms for widows like my mother, but she must collect it in person. We go to the church together, and I wait outside in the gardens. The sun is setting. I don't know how long I've been sitting here.
Text (French): Un homme en uniforme vient nous rendre visite. Quelqu'un du Tribunal. Il affirme à ma mère que les Templiers ont une aumône destinée aux veuves comme elle, mais qu'elle doit se rendre sur place pour la recevoir. Nous allons donc à l'église ensemble et je l'attends dehors. Le soleil se couche. J'ignore depuis combien de temps je suis assis ici, dans les jardins.
Text (German): Ein Mann in Uniform stattet uns einen Besuch ab. Er ist vom Gericht. Er sagt, die Templer hätten Almosen für Witwen wie meine Mutter, aber sie müsse sie persönlich abholen. Wir gehen in die Kirche und ich warte draußen in den Gärten. Die Sonne geht unter. Ich weiß nicht, wie lange ich hier schon sitze.
Text (Japanese): A man in uniform visits. He is from the Courts. He says the Templar have alms for widows like my mother, but she must collect it in person. We go to the church together, and I wait outside in the gardens. The sun is setting. I don't know how long I've been sitting here.
Text (Korean): 제복을 입은 남자가 방문했다. 법정에서 온 사람이다. 그는 템플러에서 우리 어머니 같은 과부들을 위해 구호금을 준비했지만, 이를 받으려면 직접 가야 한다고 했다. 어머니와 함께 교회에 당도했다. 난 정원에서 기다렸고 해는 뉘엿뉘엿 지고 있었다. 얼마나 더 여기에 앉아 있어야 하는지 모르겠다.
Text (Portuguese): Um homem de uniforme visitou. Era dos tribunais. Ele disse que os Templários tem esmolas para viúvas como a minha mãe, mas ela precisaria coletá-las pessoalmente. Fomos juntos à igreja e eu esperei do lado de fora nos jardins. O sol estava se pondo. Não sabia há quanto tempo estava sentado ali.
Text (Russian): Пришёл человек в одеждах жреца. Он из храмовников. Говорит, у них есть вещи для вдов вроде моей мамы, но она должна лично прийти и забрать их. Мы вместе идём в храм, но я остаюсь ждать снаружи, в садах. Солнце клонится к горизонту. Не знаю, сколько я уже тут сижу.
Text (Spanish): Nos visita un hombre en uniforme. Viene de las Cortes. Dice que los Templarios tienen limosnas para las viudas como mi madre, pero que deben buscarlo en persona. Vamos juntos a la iglesia y yo espero afuera en los jardines. Está cayendo el sol. No sé hace cuánto estoy aquí.
Text (Thai): A man in uniform visits. He is from the Courts. He says the Templar have alms for widows like my mother, but she must collect it in person. We go to the church together, and I wait outside in the gardens. The sun is setting. I don't know how long I've been sitting here.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 一個穿著制服的男人來訪。男人聲稱他來自教廷。他說聖堂武僧有在提供一些救濟品給像我母親這樣的寡婦，但她必須親自前往領取。於是我們一起前往教堂。我坐在教堂外的花園等待。日落了。我已經忘了我在這邊坐了多久。

Text: Mother comes from around the rear. She looks pale. Her eyes are red, and her clothes are torn. She doesn't look at me but she grabs my hand. We walk home in silence. I lay awake in bed. I hear her crying. The man comes over often after that, with toys and food, but I don't like him...
Text (French): Sortant de l'église par l'arrière, Mère vient me rejoindre. Elle est pâle. Elle a les yeux rouges et ses vêtements sont déchirés. Elle me prend par la main sans me regarder. Nous marchons vers la maison en silence. Je reste allongé dans mon lit, incapable de dormir. Je l'entends pleurer. L'homme revient souvent nous voir par la suite avec de la nourriture et des jouets, mais je ne l'aime pas pour autant…
Text (German): Als Mutter zurückkehrt, sieht sie blass aus. Ihre Augen sind rot, und ihre Kleidung ist zerrissen. Sie greift nach meiner Hand und schweigend gehen wir nach Hause. Ich liege wach im Bett. Ich höre sie weinen. Der Mann kommt danach oft vorbei, mit Spielzeug und Essen, aber ich mag ihn nicht ...
Text (Japanese): Mother comes from around the rear. She looks pale. Her eyes are red, and her clothes are torn. She doesn't look at me but she grabs my hand. We walk home in silence. I lay awake in bed. I hear her crying. The man comes over often after that, with toys and food, but I don't like him...
Text (Korean): 뒤쪽에서 어머니가 오신다. 어머니의 얼굴은 창백하고 눈은 빨갛게 충혈되었으며, 옷은 찢어진 상태였다. 내 손을 잡아주시지만 어머니는 나를 바라보진 않으셨다. 그렇게 말없이 집으로 걸어왔다. 침대에 눕자 어머니가 흐느끼는 소리가 들렸다. 그 남자는 그 뒤로도 장난감과 음식을 들고 자주 왔지만, 나는 그를 좋아할 수가 없었다...
Text (Portuguese): Mamãe veio da porta dos fundos. Parecia pálida. Seus olhos estavam vermelhos, e suas roupas rasgadas. Ela não olhou para mim, mas pegou minha mão. Andamos em silêncio para casa. Fiquei acordado na cama. Escutei ela chorar. O homem voltou várias vezes depois daquilo, com brinquedos e comida, mas eu não gostava dele...
Text (Russian): Мама выходит через заднюю дверь. На ней нет лица. Глаза красные, а одежда разорвана. Она не глядя берёт меня за руку. Домой мы идём в молчании. Ночью я лежу в кровати без сна. Слышу, как плачет мама. Тот человек возвращается снова и снова, приносит игрушки и еду, но всё равно мне не нравится.
Text (Spanish): Madre aparece desde la parte trasera. Se ve pálida. Sus ojos están enrojecidos y sus ropas están rotas. No me mira pero toma mi mano. Volvemos a casa en silencio. Estoy despierto en mi casa. La oigo llorar. El hombre viene en ocasiones con juguetes y comida, pero no me agrada...
Text (Thai): Mother comes from around the rear. She looks pale. Her eyes are red, and her clothes are torn. She doesn't look at me but she grabs my hand. We walk home in silence. I lay awake in bed. I hear her crying. The man comes over often after that, with toys and food, but I don't like him...
Text (Traditional Chinese): 母親從後面回來。她臉色蒼白，眼睛紅紅腫腫的，衣服破破爛爛的。她沒有看著我，而是直接抓住了我的手。我們默默的回到了家中。我清醒的躺在床上。我聽見她在哭。在那之後，那個男人經常過來我們家，帶著玩具和食物，但我不喜歡他...

Text: I think... I think this is a memory from Venarius. How horrible. Why would he want to join an organisation like this?
Text (French): Je… Je crois que ce souvenir appartient à Vénarius. Comme c'est horrible ! Pourquoi a-t-il voulu rejoindre une organisation qui se comporte de la sorte ?
Text (German): Ich denke ... Ich denke, dass das eine Erinnerung von Venarius ist. Wie schrecklich. Warum sollte er sich einer solchen Organisation anschließen wollen?
Text (Japanese): I think... I think this is a memory from Venarius. How horrible. Why would he want to join an organisation like this?
Text (Korean): 제 생각엔... 베나리우스의 기억인 것 같아요. 끔찍하네요. 템플러가 이런 조직인 걸 알면서도 베나리우스는 왜 들어가려 했던 걸까요?
Text (Portuguese): Eu acho... acho que essa é uma memória do Venarius. Que horror. Por que ele se juntaria a uma organização assim?
Text (Russian): Думаю... Думаю, это воспоминание Венария. Какой ужас. Почему в итоге он решил податься в жрецы?
Text (Spanish): Creo… Creo que esta memoria es de Venarius. Qué horrible. ¿Por qué querría unirse a una organización así?
Text (Thai): ข้าว่า... ช้าว่านี่เป็นความทรงจำจากเวนาริอุส ช่างเลวร้ายนัก เหตุใดเขาจึงต้องการเข้าร่วมองค์กรเช่นนี้?
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我想...我想這是維那利斯的記憶。真是太可怕了。為什麼他會願意加入這樣的組織？

Text: Help! Please, somebody, help me! I've fallen down here! I think I've hurt my leg! Hello?!... Stay calm. I'm sure someone will come soon. I'm so hungry... If I get desperate, maybe I can eat some of the mushrooms down here.
Text (French): Au secours ! S'il vous plaît, quelqu'un, aidez-moi ! Je suis tombé ! Je crois que je me suis cassé la jambe ! Ohé… ! Reste calme. Quelqu'un va finir par arriver. Qu'est-ce que j'ai faim… En désespoir de cause, je pourrai toujours manger deux ou trois de ces champignons…
Text (German): Hilfe! Bitte, irgendjemand, helft mir! Ich bin hier runtergefallen! Ich glaube, ich habe mir das Bein verletzt! Hallo?! ... Nur die Ruhe bewahren. Ich bin sicher, dass bald jemand kommen wird. Ich bin so hungrig ... Zur Not könnte ich einige der Pilze hier unten essen.
Text (Japanese): Help! Please, somebody, help me! I've fallen down here! I think I've hurt my leg! Hello?!... Stay calm. I'm sure someone will come soon. I'm so hungry... If I get desperate, maybe I can eat some of the mushrooms down here.
Text (Korean): 도와주세요! 아무나 좀 도와주세요! 사람이 여기에 떨어졌어요! 다리를 다친 것 같아요! 아무도 없어요?! ...진정하자. 분명 지나가는 사람이 있을 거야. 배가 너무 고픈데... 상황이 정 안 좋아지면 저 아래에 있는 버섯이라도 먹어야겠어.
Text (Portuguese): Socorro! Por favor, alguém me ajude! Eu caí aqui! Acho que machuquei minha perna! Olá?!... Acalme-se. Com certeza alguém virá logo. Estou com tanta fome... Se eu entrar em desespero, posso comer uns cogumelos desses aqui.
Text (Russian): Спасите! Кто-нибудь, пожалуйста, помогите мне! Я упала! Кажется, я сломала ногу! Эй?! Так, спокойно. Кто-нибудь обязательно скоро придёт... Я так хочу есть. Если живот совсем сведёт от голода, попробую съесть здешние грибы.
Text (Spanish): ¡Ayuda! ¡Por favor, alguien ayúdeme! ¡He caído aquí dentro! ¡Creo que lastimé mi pierna! ¡¿Hola?! Mantén la calma… Estoy seguro de que alguien vendrá pronto. Tengo tanta hambre… Si estoy demasiado desesperado quizás pueda comer alguno de los hongos que hay aquí.
Text (Thai): Help! Please, somebody, help me! I've fallen down here! I think I've hurt my leg! Hello?!... Stay calm. I'm sure someone will come soon. I'm so hungry... If I get desperate, maybe I can eat some of the mushrooms down here.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 救命！拜託，誰來救救我！我摔下來了！而且我想我的腿受傷了！哈囉！？冷靜下來，我相信一定有人會經過這裡的。我好餓...危急時，我想我可以吃旁邊的蘑菇求生。

Text: I feel strange. My head feels like it is filled with bubbles. Are the walls breathing? The colours here are so vibrant... oh... My stomach... I'm ill. The world is spinning and, oh, my gut! What did I eat? I feel--
Text (French): Je me sens bizarre… Comme si j'avais la tête remplie de bulles. Les murs seraient pas en train de respirer ? Ma parole, les couleurs sont vraiment vives ici… Aïe… Mon ventre… Je suis malade. Le monde vrille autour de moi et — aïe, mon bide ! Qu'est-ce que j'ai bien pu avaler ? Je me sens —
Text (German): Ich fühle mich seltsam ... mein Kopf fühlt sich an, als wäre er mit Blasen gefüllt. Atmen die Wände etwa? Die Farben hier sind so prächtig ... oh ... mein Magen ... ich bin krank. Die Welt dreht sich und, oh, mein Bauch! Was habe ich gegessen? Ich fühle mich –
Text (Japanese): I feel strange. My head feels like it is filled with bubbles. Are the walls breathing? The colours here are so vibrant... oh... My stomach... I'm ill. The world is spinning and, oh, my gut! What did I eat? I feel--
Text (Korean): 기분이 이상해. 머리에 거품이 가득 낀 것 같아. 벽이 숨을 쉬는 건가? 색깔이 굉장히 선명한... 으... 배가... 뭔가 잘못됐어. 세상이 도네... 으, 배야! 내가 뭘 먹었었지? 기분이...
Text (Portuguese): Sinto-me estranha. Minha cabeça parece estar cheia de bolhas. As paredes estão respirando? As cores aqui são tão vibrantes... Oh... Meu estômago... Não estou bem. O mundo gira e oh, minhas entranhas! O que eu comi? Eu sinto--
Text (Russian): Странное чувство... Моя голова будто наполнена пузырьками. А эти стены... Они дышат? Какие яркие здесь цвета... Ох. Мой живот... Я больна. Всё вокруг вращается и... Ах, мои кишки! Что я такого съела? Я сейчас...
Text (Spanish): Me siento extraño. Siento mi cabeza llena de burbujas. ¿Están respirando las paredes? Los colores son tan vibrantes… oh… mi estómago… estoy enfermo. El mundo gira y, ¡ay, mis tripas! ¿Qué comí? Me siento…
Text (Thai): I feel strange. My head feels like it is filled with bubbles. Are the walls breathing? The colours here are so vibrant... oh... My stomach... I'm ill. The world is spinning and, oh, my gut! What did I eat? I feel--
Text (Traditional Chinese): 感覺好怪...我的腦袋裡面像充滿了泡泡。那個牆壁在吐氣？哦啊好鮮豔的顏色...哦...我的胃...這蘑菇...有毒...。所有的東西都在旋轉，天旋地轉，噢，我的內臟！我到底吃了什麼？我覺得－－...

Text: Well, I'm not sure whose memory that was, but it's safe to say you shouldn't eat mushrooms you don't know.
Text (French): Eh bien, je ne sais pas à qui appartenait ce souvenir, mais il est inutile de rappeler qu'il ne faut pas manger les champignons qu'on ne connaît pas.
Text (German): Nun, ich bin mir nicht sicher, wessen Erinnerung das war, aber mit Sicherheit kann ich sagen, dass man keine Pilze essen sollte, die man nicht kennt.
Text (Japanese): Well, I'm not sure whose memory that was, but it's safe to say you shouldn't eat mushrooms you don't know.
Text (Korean): 음, 누구의 기억인지는 모르겠지만, 모르는 버섯은 먹는 게 아니라는 건 확실히 알았네요.
Text (Portuguese): Bom, não tenho certeza de quem era aquela memóiria, mas posso dizer que não se deve comer cogumelos desconhecidos.
Text (Russian): Не знаю точно, чьи это воспоминания, но могу сказать наверняка, что не следует есть неизвестные тебе грибы.
Text (Spanish): Bueno, no estoy segura de quién es el dueño de esa memoria, pero lo que es seguro es que no debes comer hongos que no conozcas.
Text (Thai): Well, I'm not sure whose memory that was, but it's safe to say you shouldn't eat mushrooms you don't know.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 好吧，我不太確定這是誰的記憶。不過我可以很肯定的跟你說別亂吃來歷不明的蘑菇。

Text: Sapinti went on her first fishing trip alone and did not return. When her body finally washed ashore, it looked as though it had been mummified for a thousand years. The fish did not touch her flesh.
Text (French): Sapinti était partie pêcher seule pour la première fois et n'était jamais revenue. Lorsque son corps s'échoua enfin sur le rivage, on aurait dit qu'il était momifié depuis un millénaire. Aucun poisson n'avait touché à sa chair.
Text (German): Sapinti ging zum ersten Mal allein auf eine Angeltour und kam nicht zurück. Als ihr Körper schließlich an Land gespült wurde, sah es so aus, als wäre er bereits seit tausenden von Jahren mumifiziert. Der Fisch rührte ihr Fleisch nicht an.
Text (Japanese): Sapinti went on her first fishing trip alone and did not return. When her body finally washed ashore, it looked as though it had been mummified for a thousand years. The fish did not touch her flesh.
Text (Korean): 사핀티는 홀로 첫 번째 낚시 여행을 떠나 돌아오지 않았다. 마침내 해안으로 밀려온 그녀의 시신은 마치 천 년은 지난 미라를 보는 듯했다. 물고기도 그녀의 살점에 입을 대지 않을 정도였다.
Text (Portuguese): Sapinti foi à sua primeira pescaria sozinha e não voltou. Quando seu corpo finalmente apareceu na praia, parecia ter estado mumificado por mil anos. Os peixes não chegaram nem perto.
Text (Russian): Сапинти уплыла на свою первую рыбалку одна и не вернулась. Позже волны вынесли тело на берег, но она выглядела как тысячелетняя мумия. Её даже не стали обгладывать рыбы.
Text (Spanish): Sapinti fue sola en su primer viaje de pesca y no regresó. Cuando su cuerpo finalmente llegó a la orilla, parecía como si hubiera estado momificado durante mil años. Los peces no tocaron su cuerpo.
Text (Thai): Sapinti went on her first fishing trip alone and did not return. When her body finally washed ashore, it looked as though it had been mummified for a thousand years. The fish did not touch her flesh.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 瑟潘帝獨自前往釣魚，但並沒有回來。當她的屍體終於被沖上岸時，她看起來活像是個千年木乃伊。完全沒有魚敢碰她的屍體。

Text: She was perfectly preserved, but drained of her blood. We buried her, but within days the earth rejected her. Whatever killed her took root in that place. The earth soured and we had to move, abandoning her body.
Text (French): Elle était parfaitement préservée, mis à part qu'elle était vidée de son sang. Nous l'avons inhumée, mais la terre l'a rejetée quelques jours plus tard. Ce qui l'avait tuée a fini par prendre racine à cet endroit. Le sol étant devenu infécond, nous avons dû aller nous installer ailleurs, abandonnant le corps derrière nous.
Text (German): Ihr Körper war perfekt erhalten, bis auf das Blut, von dem jede Spur fehlte. Wir begruben sie, doch die Erde gab sie wenige Tage darauf wieder preis. Was auch immer sie getötet hat, schlug an diesem Ort Wurzeln. Die Erde wurde sauer und zwang uns, von dort fortzuziehen und ihren Körper zurückzulassen.
Text (Japanese): She was perfectly preserved, but drained of her blood. We buried her, but within days the earth rejected her. Whatever killed her took root in that place. The earth soured and we had to move, abandoning her body.
Text (Korean): 사핀티의 시신은 완벽하게 보존되어 있었으나 피만은 모조리 사라진 뒤였다. 우리는 그녀를 땅에 묻었지만 며칠이 지나지 않아 땅 자체가 사핀티를 거절하였다. 사핀티를 죽인 무언가가 그곳에 뿌리를 내려 땅이 썩어간 탓이었다. 우리는 그녀의 시신을 버려두고 떠나야만 했다.
Text (Portuguese): Estava perfeitamente conservada, mas o sangue drenado. Nós a enterramos, mas dentro de alguns dias a terra a rejeitou. O que quer que tenha sido que a matou se enraizou naquele lugar. A terra azedou e tivemos que nos mudar, abandonando seu corpo.
Text (Russian): Она прекрасно сохранилась, но была полностью обескровлена. Мы похоронили Сапинти, но пару дней спустя земля отвергла её. Что бы не забрало её жизнь, оно пришло и на сушу. Земля скисла, нам пришлось бросить её тело и уйти.
Text (Spanish): Estaba perfectamente preservada, pero no tenía sangre. La enterramos, pero en pocos días la tierra la rechazó. Lo que sea que la mató echó raíces en ese lugar. La tierra se agrió y tuvimos que mudarnos, dejando su cuerpo atrás.
Text (Thai): She was perfectly preserved, but drained of her blood. We buried her, but within days the earth rejected her. Whatever killed her took root in that place. The earth soured and we had to move, abandoning her body.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 她的屍體完整，但血液被抽乾。我們埋葬了她，但大地拒絕了她。無論是什麼殺了她都在此紮了根。大地受到汙染，我們只好搬離，並放棄了她的屍體。

Text: Hmm, this memory seems too ancient to have belonged to Venarius.
Text (French): Hum. Ce souvenir me semble trop ancien pour avoir appartenu à Vénarius.
Text (German): Hmm, diese Erinnerung scheint zu alt, um Venarius zu gehören.
Text (Japanese): Hmm, this memory seems too ancient to have belonged to Venarius.
Text (Korean): 흠, 이건 베나리우스의 기억이라기엔 너무 오래전 일이군요.
Text (Portuguese): Hmm, essa memória parece ser antiga demais para pertencer ao Venarius
Text (Russian): Хм-м, это воспоминание слишком древнее и не может принадлежать Венарию.
Text (Spanish): Hmm, esta memoria parece demasiado antigua como para ser de Venarius.
Text (Thai): อืม ความทรงจำนี้ดูเก่าเกินไปที่จะเป็นของเวนาริอุส
Text (Traditional Chinese): 嗯，這個記憶實在過於古老，不像是維那利斯的記憶。

Text: Ha! Lioneye's failure against Kaom comes as no surprise. He was always more arrogant than skilled. It is time a real man showed the Karui the might of the Eternal Empire.
Text (French): Ha ! La défaite d'Œil de Lion face à Kaom n'a rien de surprenant. Son arrogance l'a toujours emporté sur sa compétence. Il est temps qu'un vrai homme vienne montrer la puissance de l'Empire éternel aux Karuis.
Text (German): Ha! Löwenauges Scheitern gegen Kaom ist keine Überraschung. Er war immer arroganter als alles andere. Es ist an der Zeit, dass ein echter Mann den Karui die Macht des Ewigen Kaiserreichs demonstriert.
Text (Japanese): Ha! Lioneye's failure against Kaom comes as no surprise. He was always more arrogant than skilled. It is time a real man showed the Karui the might of the Eternal Empire.
Text (Korean): 하! 라이온아이가 카옴에게 패배한 건 예상했던 일이지. 그는 노련하다는 말보다는 거만하다는 말이 더 어울리는 사내였어. 그래, 진정한 남자가 영원한 제국의 힘을 카루이에게 보여줄 때가 된 거야.
Text (Portuguese): Ha! A derrota de Lioneye contra os Karui não me surpreende. Ele sempre foi mais arrogante do que habilidoso. Era hora de um homem de verdade mostrar aos Karui a força do Império Eterno.
Text (Russian): Я не удивляюсь тому, что Львиный глаз проиграл Каому. Марк слишком гордился своим умом, которого не было. Пора настоящему мужчине показать этим каруи всю мощь Вечной Империи.
Text (Spanish): ¡Ja! El fracaso de Lioneye contra Kaom no es ninguna sorpresa. Siempre tuvo más arrogancia que habilidad. Es hora de que un verdadero hombre le muestre a los karui el poder del Imperio Eterno.
Text (Thai): ฮา! ความล้มเหลวของไลออนอายต่อคอมม์นั้นไม่น่าแปลกใจเลย เขามักมีความเย่อหยิ่งมากกว่ามีฝีมือ ถึงเวลาแล้วที่ลูกผู้ชายตัวจริงได้แสดงให้เห็นถึงคารุยถึงศักยภาพของจักรวรรดินิรันดร์
Text (Traditional Chinese): 哈！獅眼會敗給岡姆並不令人意外。他總是喜歡誇大自己的本事。是時候讓那些卡魯仔體會不朽帝國真正的力量了！

Text: Shavronne assures me that my process will be relatively painless, and that my duties as warden can continue unhindered, but as my flesh swells and ruptures, I realise I am just another test subject. At least I can fulfill my duties to the Empire before my mind--
Text (French): Shavronne m'assure que le processus sera relativement indolore et que je pourrai poursuivre mes tâches de geôlier sans encombre, mais quand je vois ma chair se gonfler et se fissurer, je réalise que je ne suis qu'un cobaye de plus. Au moins, je peux continuer à servir l'Empire avant que mon esprit ne…
Text (German): Shavronne versichert mir, dass der Prozess relativ schmerzlos sein wird und dass ich meine Pflichten als Aufseher ungehindert ausführen könne, aber während mein Fleisch anschwillt und reißt, wird mir klar, dass ich nur ein weiteres Testobjekt bin. Wenigstens kann ich meine Pflichten gegenüber dem Kaiserreich erfüllen, bevor mein Verstand ...
Text (Japanese): Shavronne assures me that my process will be relatively painless, and that my duties as warden can continue unhindered, but as my flesh swells and ruptures, I realise I am just another test subject. At least I can fulfill my duties to the Empire before my mind--
Text (Korean): 샤브론은 시술 과정에서의 고통은 크지 않을 것이며, 간수 임무는 아무 문제 없이 계속할 수 있을 거라 호언장담했다. 하지만 살이 부풀고 갈라지는 모습을 보면서 나 또한 그저 또 하나의 실험체에 불과하다는 걸 깨달았다. 그래도 제국에 대한 나의 의무를 다할 수는 있겠지. 적어도 내 정신이 남아있는 한--
Text (Portuguese): Shavronne me garantiu que o processo seria relativamente indolor e que não me impediria de exercer minha função de carcereiro, mas quando meu corpo começou a inchar e romper, percebi que eu era apenas mais um objeto de teste. Pelo menos poderia concluir meus deveres para com o Império antes que minha mente--
Text (Russian): Шавронн уверяет, что «процедура сравнительно безболезненна», что мне надо и дальше выполнять долг надзирателя. Вот только моя плоть бугрится, а кожа лопается. Я понимаю, что стал очередным подопытным образцом. По крайней мере я могу служить Империи до тех пор, пока мой разум...
Text (Spanish): Shavronne me asegura que mi proceso será relativamente indoloro, y que mis labores como guardián no se verán afectadas, pero a medida que mi piel se hincha y desgarra, entiendo que solo soy otro sujeto de pruebas. Al menos puedo cumplir mis deberes para con el Imperio antes de que mi mente...
Text (Thai): แชฟรอนน์ยืนยันกับข้าว่ากระบวนการของข้าจะไม่เจ็บปวดและหน้าที่ของข้าในฐานะผู้คุมสามารถดำเนินการต่อไปได้ แต่เมื่อเนื้อข้าบวมและแตก ข้ารู้ว่าข้าเป็นเพียงแค่การผู้ร่วมการทดลองอีกคนหนึ่ง อย่างน้อยข้าก็สามารถทำหน้าที่ของฉันต่อจักรวรรดิได้สำเร็จก่อนที่ใจข้า--
Text (Traditional Chinese): 薛朗向我保證過程不會很痛，並且還不會妨礙我維護身為典獄長的職責，但隨著我的肉體膨脹並破裂，我才意識到我只是另一個實驗品罷了。至少在我失去理智之前，我還可以完成帝國賜予我的使－－....

Text: I felt so... so strong! Yet I couldn't shake the feeling I was at my breaking point. What a terrible sensation! Was that the Warden of Axiom?
Text (French): Je me suis sentie si… forte ! Pourtant, je ne pouvais chasser l'impression que j'avais atteint le point de rupture. Quelle terrible sensation ! N'était-ce pas le Geôlier d'Axiom ?
Text (German): Ich fühlte mich so ... so stark! Doch ich konnte das Gefühl nicht loswerden, dass ich an meiner Belastungsgrenze war. Was für ein schreckliches Gefühl! War das der Aufseher des Axiom-Gefängnisses?
Text (Japanese): I felt so... so strong! Yet I couldn't shake the feeling I was at my breaking point. What a terrible sensation! Was that the Warden of Axiom?
Text (Korean): 굉장히... 강력한 힘이었어요! 하지만 돌이킬 수 없는 어떤 상태였다는 느낌을 떨칠 수가 없네요. 이런 끔찍한 감각이라니! 액시옴의 간수 맞죠?
Text (Portuguese): Eu me senti tão... Tão forte! Mas não pude deixar de sentir que estava à beira de um colapso. Que sensação terrível! Esse foi o Carcereiro de Axiom?
Text (Russian): Я ощущала себя такой... сильной! Но не могла избавиться от ощущения, что еле выдерживаю эту силу. Какое страшное чувство. Это был Смотритель Аксиомы?
Text (Spanish): Me sentí tan… ¡tan fuerte! Y sin embargo no puedo eliminar esa sensación de haber estado a punto de quebrarme. ¿Era ese el Guardián de Axiom?
Text (Thai): I felt so... so strong! Yet I couldn't shake the feeling I was at my breaking point. What a terrible sensation! Was that the Warden of Axiom?
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我覺得...好強大！這讓我難以擺脫這種超越極限感覺。這真是個可怕的體驗。那真的是典獄長嗎？

Text: People stream down the street towards Oriath Square. I hear their shouts and cheers, and when my mother isn't looking, sneak out to join the merry crowd. Just outside the pens, a Karui boy, no older than I, stands atop the gallows.
Text (French): Les gens affluent dans la rue qui mène à la Place d'Oriath. Excité par les cris et les acclamations, je me glisse dans la foule en liesse aussitôt que Mère a le dos tourné. À l'extérieur des enclos, je vois un garçon karui de mon âge debout sur l'échafaud.
Text (German): Die Menschen strömen die Straße hinunter in Richtung Oriaths Stadtplatz. Ich höre ihre Schreie und Jubelrufe, und als Mutter nicht hinsieht, schleiche ich mich hinaus, um mich der fröhlichen Menge anzuschließen. Etwas außerhalb der Sklavenpferche steht ein Karui-Junge, nicht älter als ich, am Galgen.
Text (Japanese): People stream down the street towards Oriath Square. I hear their shouts and cheers, and when my mother isn't looking, sneak out to join the merry crowd. Just outside the pens, a Karui boy, no older than I, stands atop the gallows.
Text (Korean): 사람들이 길을 따라 오리아스 광장으로 몰려들었다. 밖에서 들려오는 함성과 환호에 홀려 어머니 몰래 그 흐름에 합류했다. 쳐 놓은 울타리 바로 저편에, 내 또래의 카루이 소년이 교수대 위에 서 있었다.
Text (Portuguese): As pessoas corriam pela rua em direção à Praça de Oriath. Escutava seus gritos e aplausos, e quando mamãe não estava olhando, saí sorrateiramente para me juntar à multidão alegre. Além do rebuliço, um menino Karui, não mais velho que eu, pendurado na forca.
Text (Russian): Люди идут по улице к площади Ориата. Я слышу их выкрики и радостный гам. Стоит маме отвернуться, как я выскальзываю наружу и вливаюсь в весёлую толпу. Прямо возле бараков я вижу каруи. Мальчишку едва ли старше меня, который стоит на помосте виселицы.
Text (Spanish): La gente se arremolina hacia la Plaza de Oriath. Escucho sus gritos y vítores, y cuando madre no mira, me escabullo para unirme a la alegre multitud. Fuera de las jaulas hay un chico karui, no mayor que yo, parado en la horca.
Text (Thai): People stream down the street towards Oriath Square. I hear their shouts and cheers, and when my mother isn't looking, sneak out to join the merry crowd. Just outside the pens, a Karui boy, no older than I, stands atop the gallows.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 群眾往奧瑞亞大廣場聚集。我聽到他們的叫喊與歡呼聲，而我趁母親不注意時偷偷溜出去加入了歡騰的人群中。在欄杆外，我看見一個比我還年輕的卡魯族小孩，站在絞刑架上。

Text: I see by the sign around his neck he has been caught stealing. I swear I will not look away, but fear overtakes me. I hear the rope snap taut and the crowd cheer, but I fight back the tears...
Text (French): Je comprends grâce à l'écriteau qui pend à son cou qu'il a été pris en flagrant délit de vol. Je me promets de ne pas détourner le regard, mais ma peur l'emporte. J'entends la corde se tendre subitement et la foule pousser des exclamations de joie tandis que je retiens mes larmes…
Text (German): Anhand des Schilds um seinen Hals erkenne ich, dass er beim Stehlen erwischt worden ist. Ich schwöre, ich werde nicht wegschauen. Aber die Angst überkommt mich. Ich höre, wie das Seil straff wird und die Menge jubelt, während ich gegen die Tränen ankämpfe ...
Text (Japanese): I see by the sign around his neck he has been caught stealing. I swear I will not look away, but fear overtakes me. I hear the rope snap taut and the crowd cheer, but I fight back the tears...
Text (Korean): 목에 건 판자를 보니 도둑질을 하다가 붙잡힌 아이였다. 끝까지 지켜볼 것이라고 속으로 맹세해 보지만 두려움이 엄습해오는 건 어쩔 수가 없다. 밧줄이 팽팽해지는 소리와 사람들의 환호 소리가 들려 왔다. 난 그저 흘러내리려는 눈물을 참을 뿐이었다.
Text (Portuguese): Vi pela marca em seu pescoço que ele fora pego roubando. Jurei que não desviaria o olhar, mas o medo me consumiu. Escutei o estalo da corda e a alegria da plateia, mas lutei contra as lágrimas...
Text (Russian): Я вижу на его шее табличку с надписью, что мальчика поймали на воровстве. Я клянусь себе не отворачиваться, но страх оказывается сильнее. Я слышу звук натянутой верёвки и одобрительный гомон толпы, но с трудом сдерживаю слезы.
Text (Spanish): Veo el letrero en su cuello y sé que lo atraparon robando. Juro que no desviaré la mirada, pero el miedo me supera. Oigo cómo la soga se tensa y la multitud aclama, pero me esfuerzo para no llorar…
Text (Thai): I see by the sign around his neck he has been caught stealing. I swear I will not look away, but fear overtakes me. I hear the rope snap taut and the crowd cheer, but I fight back the tears...
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我看見他脖子上的記號，他是因為偷竊被捕。我發誓我不會把眼光移開。但恐懼直竄心頭。我聽見繩索緊繃的聲音與人群的歡呼聲，而我的淚水奪眶而出...

Text: Was that Venarius as a child? I think perhaps it was... society has not changed much since he was young.
Text (French): Était-ce Vénarius enfant ? Je crois que c'était le cas… La société n'a guère changé depuis cette époque.
Text (German): War das Venarius als Kind? Ich denke, dass er es vielleicht war ... Die Gesellschaft hat sich seit seiner Jugend nicht wirklich verändert.
Text (Japanese): Was that Venarius as a child? I think perhaps it was... society has not changed much since he was young.
Text (Korean): 어린 시절의 베나리우스였나요? 제 생각엔... 베나리우스가 어릴 적의 풍조 역시 지금과 별로 다를 게 없었던 것 같네요.
Text (Portuguese): Esse era o Venarius quando criança? Acho que talvez era... a sociedade não mudou muito desde sua juventude.
Text (Russian): Это детское воспоминание Венария? Думаю, что да... Со времён его детства общество не особенно изменилось.
Text (Spanish): ¿Ese era Venarius cuando era niño? Creo que quizás era… La sociedad no ha cambiado mucho desde que él era un niño.
Text (Thai): นั่นเวนาริอุสในวัยเด็กรึ? ข้าคิดว่าบางทีมันอาจเป็นเช่นนั้น... สังคมไม่ได้เปลี่ยนไปมากนักตั้งแต่เขายังเด็ก
Text (Traditional Chinese): 那是維那利斯小時候？我想應該沒有錯...看來從他懂事以來，這個社會似乎從未變過。

Text: Out of sight, out of mind. No one speaks of the cursed land anymore. That has made it quite simple to send our smugglers out in search of powerful Eternal artefacts.
Text (French): Loin des yeux, loin du cœur. Plus personne ne parle de la terre maudite, ce qui nous a simplifié la tâche quand est venu le temps d'envoyer nos contrebandiers à la recherche de puissants artefacts des Éternels.
Text (German): Aus den Augen, aus dem Sinn. Niemand spricht mehr vom verfluchten Land. Das hat es ganz einfach gemacht, unsere Schmuggler auf die Suche nach mächtigen Ewigen Artefakten zu schicken.
Text (Japanese): Out of sight, out of mind. No one speaks of the cursed land anymore. That has made it quite simple to send our smugglers out in search of powerful Eternal artefacts.
Text (Korean): 눈에서 멀어지면 마음에서도 멀어진다지. 이제는 아무도 그 저주받은 땅에 대해 얘기하지 않아. 덕분에 우리 쪽 밀수업자들이 제국의 강력한 유물을 찾기는 더 쉬워졌지만.
Text (Portuguese): O que os olhos não veem o coração não sente. Ninguém fala mais sobre a terra amaldiçoada. Facilitou bastante o envio de contrabandistas para encontrar poderosos artefatos Eternos.
Text (Russian): С глаз долой — из сердца вон. Больше никто не говорит о проклятой земле. Поэтому она отлично подходит для наших контрабандных дел и поисков могущественных артефактов вечных.
Text (Spanish): Si no la ven, no piensan en ella. Nadie habla ya sobre la tierra maldita. Eso ha facilitado mucho enviar a los contrabandistas a buscar artefactos eternos poderosos.
Text (Thai): เมื่ออยู่ไกลใจก็ห่าง ไม่มีใครพูดถึงดินแดนที่ถูกสาปอีกต่อไป นั่นทำให้มันง่ายมากที่จะส่งนักลักลอบขนของเราออกไปเพื่อค้นหาสิ่งประดิษฐ์นิรันดร์ที่ทรงพลัง
Text (Traditional Chinese): 眼不見為淨。現在沒有人敢討論詛咒之地的事情。這讓我們可以輕鬆的尋找那些強大的不朽帝國製品並搞些走私的勾當。

Text: We knew of the gems, but we did not know of what Malachai called his 'muse.' The smugglers have returned with rubbings of the device they found. They call it 'miraculous.' I know a thing or two about miracles, so I will be the judge of that.
Text (French): Nous avions entendu parler des gemmes, mais pas de ce que Malachai appelait sa « muse ». Les contrebandiers sont revenus avec des décalques de l'appareil qu'ils ont découvert. Ils le déclarent « miraculeux ». Comme il se trouve que je m'y connais légèrement en miracles, je me forgerai ma propre opinion là-dessus…
Text (German): Wir wussten von den Gemmen, aber wir wussten nicht, wen oder was Malachai seine \"Muse\" nannte. Die Schmuggler sind mit Zeichnungen der Apparatschaft zurückgekehrt, die sie gefunden haben. Sie nennen sie \"wundersam\". Ich erkenne ein Wunder, wenn ich es sehe, also werde ich darüber urteilen.
Text (Japanese): We knew of the gems, but we did not know of what Malachai called his 'muse.' The smugglers have returned with rubbings of the device they found. They call it 'miraculous.' I know a thing or two about miracles, so I will be the judge of that.
Text (Korean): 마석에 대해서는 우리도 알아. 하지만 말라카이가 자신의 '뮤즈'라고 했던 게 무엇인지는 아는 게 없어. 밀수업자들이 무슨 장치의 탁본을 구해왔다던데. 이건 정말 '기적'이라면서 말이야. 기적이라면 소양이 좀 있으니 직접 보고 판단해 봐야겠군.
Text (Portuguese): Sabíamos das gemas, mas não sabíamos do que Malachai chamava de 'musa'. Os contrabandistas voltaram com pedaços do dispositivo que encontraram. Chamaram de 'milagroso'. Sei uma coisa ou outra sobre milagres, então eu que vou julgar...
Text (Russian): Мы знали о камнях, но не знали о том, что Малахай называл своей музой. Контрабандисты вернулись с набросками найденного устройства. Они считали его чудесным. Я кое-что понимаю в чудесах, поэтому смогу разобраться в вопросе.
Text (Spanish): Sabíamos acerca de las gemas, pero no sabíamos acerca de lo que Malachai llamaba su \"musa\". Los contrabandistas regresaron con impresiones del artefacto que encontraron. Lo llaman \"milagroso\". Sé algo sobre milagros, así que yo juzgaré eso.
Text (Thai): เรารู้เรื่องอัญมณี แต่เราไม่รู้ว่ามาลาคีเรียกเขาว่า 'มิวส์' ได้อย่างไร ผู้ลักลอบขนของกลับมาพร้อมกับอุปกรณ์ที่พบ พวกเขาเรียกมันว่า 'ปาฏิหาริย์' ข้ารู้เรื่องปาฏิหาริย์สักเรื่องหนึ่งหรือสองเรื่อง ดังนั้นข้าจะเป็นผู้ตัดสินสิ่งนั้น
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我們知道寶石是什麼，但我們並不理解瑪拉凱口中的「奇異」是什麼意思。那些走私者帶著他們找到的裝置的拓片回來了。他們稱之為「奇術」。我知道一兩件關於奇術的事情，所以我有辦法作出判斷...

Text: This was almost certainly one of the High Templar's memories. In fact, I think this was not long before he spoke to my father!
Text (French): C'était presque certainement l'un des souvenirs du Haut templier. En fait, je pense que c'était peu de temps avant qu'il ne parle à mon père !
Text (German): Mit großer Sicherheit war das eine Erinnerung des Hohen Templers. Genau genommen glaube ich, dass er kurz darauf mit meinem Vater sprach!
Text (Japanese): This was almost certainly one of the High Templar's memories. In fact, I think this was not long before he spoke to my father!
Text (Korean): 고위 템플러의 기억이었던 게 분명해요. 우리 아버지에게 접근하기 그리 오래전 같지도 않고요!
Text (Portuguese): Essa foi com certeza uma memória de um dos Alto Templários, Na  verdade, acho que não foi muio antes dele falar com meu pai!
Text (Russian): Это почти наверняка одно из воспоминаний верховного жреца. Мне даже кажется, что вскоре после этого он говорил с моим отцом!
Text (Spanish): Estoy casi segura de que esta es una de las memorias del Alto Templario. De hecho, ¡creo que fue poco antes de que hable con mi padre!
Text (Thai): นี่เป็นหนึ่งในความทรงจำของเทมพลาร์เกือบแน่นอน อันที่จริงข้าคิดว่านี่มันไม่นานก่อนที่เขาจะพูดกับพ่อข้า!
Text (Traditional Chinese): 這幾乎可以肯定是聖宗的記憶。事實上，我想這發生在他與我父親接觸之前不久。

Text: The stench convenes around me thicker than the press of the vagabonds themselves. Though starving, their strength while holding on to one another is surprising. I am trapped in a knot of ragged bodies, and the men of the Church clap me in irons despite my cries.
Text (French): La puanteur des lieux me suffoque encore davantage que la masse de vagabonds pressée contre moi. Même affamés, ils sont capables d'une force prodigieuse lorsqu'ils s'appuient l'un sur l'autre. Je suis empêtré dans un nœud de corps déguenillés et les hommes de l'Église me mettent aux fers malgré mes supplications.
Text (German): Der Gestank um mich herum ist stärker als die Muskeln der Vagabunden. Obwohl sie ausgehungert sind, halten sie einander mit einer solch überraschenden Kraft fest. Ich bin gefangen in einem Knoten aus geschundenen Körpern, und mein klägliches Schreien hält die Männer der Kirche nicht davon ab, mich in Ketten zu legen.
Text (Japanese): The stench convenes around me thicker than the press of the vagabonds themselves. Though starving, their strength while holding on to one another is surprising. I am trapped in a knot of ragged bodies, and the men of the Church clap me in irons despite my cries.
Text (Korean): 노숙자들 그 자체보다도 악취가 더욱더 진득하게 내게 달라붙는다. 굶주렸음에도 이들이 서로에게 달라붙는 힘은 놀랍기까지 하다. 교회 사람들이 그런 비루한 몸뚱이들 사이에 갇혀 있는 나를 철창에 가둔다. 내 비명은 철장 속에서 공허히 울릴 뿐이었다.
Text (Portuguese): O fedor me cercava mais do que a pressão dos próprios vagabundos. Ainda que famintos, a força que se seguravam uns aos outros era surpreendente. Estava preso em um nó de corpos esfarrapados, e os homens da Igreja me algemaram, apesar dos meus gritos.
Text (Russian): Сила окутывающей вони превосходит даже силу пихающих меня мерзавцев. Люди здесь голодают, но с поразительной силой держатся друг за друга. Я вязну в толпе оборванцев, а храмовники заковывают меня в железо несмотря на протесты.
Text (Spanish): El hedor hace más presión sobre mí que el peso de los propios vagabundos. Aunque están hambrientos, su fuerza mientras se agarran unos a otros es sorprendente. Estoy atrapado en un embrollo de cuerpos andrajosos, y los hombres de la iglesia me encadenan a pesar de mis gritos.
Text (Thai): The stench convenes around me thicker than the press of the vagabonds themselves. Though starving, their strength while holding on to one another is surprising. I am trapped in a knot of ragged bodies, and the men of the Church clap me in irons despite my cries.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我周圍的惡臭堪比那個無賴對我所施加的壓力。雖然我也很餓，但這兩種感覺摻雜在一起之強烈依舊令人感到驚訝。我體無完膚的被綁著，而那個來自教堂的男人無視我的哭聲，不斷地以鐵條痛毆我。

Text: I am not one of them! Can't you hear me? I'm not Maraketh, nor homeless, and I have committed no sins. That ship is not for me! Why won't you listen?!
Text (French): Je ne suis pas l'un d'eux ! Vous ne m'entendez donc pas ? Je ne suis ni Maraketh ni sans-abri et je n'ai commis aucun péché ! Je n'ai rien à faire dans ce navire ! Pourquoi ne m'écoutez-vous pas ?
Text (German): Ich bin keiner von ihnen! Könnt ihr mich nicht hören? Ich bin weder Maraketh noch obdachlos und frei von Sünden. Das Schiff ist nicht für mich! Warum hört ihr mir nicht zu?!
Text (Japanese): I am not one of them! Can't you hear me? I'm not Maraketh, nor homeless, and I have committed no sins. That ship is not for me! Why won't you listen?!
Text (Korean): 난 저쪽 사람이 아니라고! 내 말 안 들려? 난 마라케스 사람도 아니고, 노숙자도 아냐! 죄를 짓지도 않았고! 저 배는 내가 탈 배가 아니라는데 왜 내 말을 안 들어주는데?!
Text (Portuguese): Eu não sou um deles! Estão me ouvindo? Eu não sou Maraketh, nem sem-teto, e não comei pecados. Aquele navio não é pra mim! Por que não me escutam?!
Text (Russian): Я не из этих! Вы меня слышите? Я не маракет, не бездомный и не совершал грехов. Я не должен быть на этом корабле! Почему вы не слушаете?
Text (Spanish): ¡No soy uno de ellos! ¿No me oyen? No soy maraketh, ni un indigente, y no he cometido ningún pecado. ¡Ese barco no es para mí! ¡¿Por qué no me escuchan?!
Text (Thai): I am not one of them! Can't you hear me? I'm not Maraketh, nor homeless, and I have committed no sins. That ship is not for me! Why won't you listen?!
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我跟他們不是一夥的！你沒聽見嗎？我不是馬拉克斯人，我也不是流浪漢，我更沒有犯任何的罪。我不屬於那艘船！為什麼你就是聽不懂？

Text: A young Venarius, innocent and helpless. If only he'd stayed that way. It never ceases to amaze me how much a person can change over their lifetime.
Text (French): Un jeune Vénarius, innocent et sans défense. Si seulement il était resté ainsi. Le changement radical qui peut s'opérer chez les gens au cours de leur vie ne cessera jamais de m'ébahir.
Text (German): Ein junger Venarius, unschuldig und hilflos. Wenn er doch nur so geblieben wäre. Ich bin immer wieder überrascht darüber, wie sehr sich ein Mensch im Laufe seiner Lebtage verändern kann.
Text (Japanese): A young Venarius, innocent and helpless. If only he'd stayed that way. It never ceases to amaze me how much a person can change over their lifetime.
Text (Korean): 순수하고 무력한, 젊은 베나리우스네요. 그냥 저대로 있었으면 좋았을 텐데. 한 사람이 일생동안 얼마나 많은 변화를 겪을 수 있는지를 보면 항상 놀라게 된다니까요.
Text (Portuguese): Um jovem Venarius, inocente e indefeso. Se ele tivesse ficado longe. Nunca deixo de me surpreender com as mudanças que uma pessoa pode passar em sua vida.
Text (Russian): Юный Венарий, невинный и беспомощный. Эх, вот бы он таким и остался. Я не устану поражаться тому, как сильно может измениться человек.
Text (Spanish): Un Venarius joven, inocente y desamparado. Si solo se hubiera quedado así. Nunca deja de sorprenderme cuánto puede cambiar una persona a lo largo de su vida.
Text (Thai): เวนาริอุสหนุ่มผู้บริสุทธิ์และไร้ทางสู้ ถ้าเพียงเขาเป็นแบบนั้นต่อไปก็ดี ข้าอดทึ่งไม่ได้ว่าคนๆ หนึ่งสามารถเปลี่ยนแปลงได้ตลอดชีวิตของพวกเขา
Text (Traditional Chinese): 年輕的維那利斯，無垢且無助。如果他保持這個樣子。我可能永遠也不會驚訝於一個人的人生之中能有多大的轉變。

Text: The shackles cut into my wrists and ankles. The guards are deaf to my pleading, but I am no murderer. If I am guilty of anything, it is falling in love with the wrong person. Ugh! Justice served, they claim.
Text (French): Les fers me mordent les poignets et les chevilles. Les gardiens restent sourds lorsque je leur clame mon innocence, mais je ne suis pas un meurtrier. Si je suis coupable de quelque chose, c'est d'être tombé amoureux de la mauvaise personne. Pff ! Justice rendue, qu'ils disent.
Text (German): Die Fesseln haben sich in meine Handgelenke und Knöchel geschnitten. Die Wachen reagieren meinem Flehen gegenüber mit Taubheit, aber ich bin kein Mörder. Wenn ich mich einer Sache schuldig gemacht habe, dann ist es, dass ich mich in die falsche Person verliebt habe. Der Gerechtigkeit ist Genüge getan, behaupten sie.
Text (Japanese): The shackles cut into my wrists and ankles. The guards are deaf to my pleading, but I am no murderer. If I am guilty of anything, it is falling in love with the wrong person. Ugh! Justice served, they claim.
Text (Korean): 손목과 발목에 족쇄가 파고든다. 나는 살인자가 아니라고 아무리 애원해도 경비병들은 들은 척도 하지 않는다. 내게 죄가 있다면 사랑하지 말았어야 했던 사람과 사랑에 빠졌다는 거겠지. 하! 이래놓고 정의가 실현되었다고 말하는 꼴이라니.
Text (Portuguese): As algemas cortavam meus pulsos e tornozelos. Os guardas não escutavam minhas súplicas, mas eu não era um assassino. Se eu era culpado de algo, era de ter me apaixonado pela pessoa errada. Ugh! Justiça foi feita, eles diziam.
Text (Russian): Оковы врезаются в запястья и лодыжки. Стража глуха к моим мольбам, а ведь я не убийца. Я виноват только в том, что полюбил не того человека. Они говорят, что справедливость восторжествовала.
Text (Spanish): Las cadenas cortan mis muñecas y mis tobillos. Los guardias hacen oídos sordos a mis súplicas, pero no soy ningún asesino. Si soy culpable de algo, es de enamorarme de la persona equivocada. ¡Ugh! Y claman estar haciendo justicia.
Text (Thai): The shackles cut into my wrists and ankles. The guards are deaf to my pleading, but I am no murderer. If I am guilty of anything, it is falling in love with the wrong person. Ugh! Justice served, they claim.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 鐐銬深深的嵌入我的雙腕與腳踝。守衛對我的懇求充耳不聞，但我不是殺人犯。如果說我犯了什麼罪，那一定只有我愛上了錯誤的人。啊啊啊！他們居然聲稱，正義必得伸張。

Text: This is not justice. Any chance of justice evaporated the moment I walked into the courtroom and saw her husband held the gavel. I'm just the scapegoat. It's easy to get away with murder when you're the judge.
Text (French): Ça n'a rien de juste. Tout espoir que justice soit faite s'est volatilisé à l'instant où je suis entré dans la salle d'audience et que j'ai vu que c'était son mari qui tenait le marteau. Je ne suis que le bouc émissaire. Facile pour un meurtrier de s'en tirer quand c'est lui le juge…
Text (German): Das ist keine Gerechtigkeit. Jede Chance auf Gerechtigkeit verflog in dem Moment, als ich den Gerichtssaal betrat und sah, wie ihr Mann den Hammer hielt. Ich bin nichts weiter als der Sündenbock. Es ist einfach, mit Mord davonzukommen, wenn man der Richter ist.
Text (Japanese): This is not justice. Any chance of justice evaporated the moment I walked into the courtroom and saw her husband held the gavel. I'm just the scapegoat. It's easy to get away with murder when you're the judge.
Text (Korean): 이런 건 정의가 아냐. 그녀의 남편이 법정 안에서 의사봉을 들고 있는 모습을 본 순간, 공정함 따위는 어디에도 없음을 깨달았다. 나는 그저 희생양일 뿐이었구나. 판사가 되면 합법적으로 사람을 죽이는 것이 이렇게 쉬운 거였구나.
Text (Portuguese): Isso não é justiça. Qualquer chance de justiça evaporou no momento em que adentrei o tribunal e vi o marido dela segurar o martelo. Fui o bode expiatório. É fácil se safar de homicídio quando se é o juiz.
Text (Russian): Это не справедливость. Любой намёк на справедливость испарился, когда я вошёл в зал суда и увидел молоточек в руке её мужа. Я стал козлом отпущения. Как просто уйти от правосудия, если убийца — судья...
Text (Spanish): Esto no es justicia. Cualquier posibilidad de justicia se evaporó al entrar a esa corte y ver que su esposo sostenía el martillo. Soy solo un chivo expiatorio. Es fácil salir indemne de un asesinato cuando eres el juez.
Text (Thai): นี่ไม่ใช่ความยุติธรรม โอกาสใด ๆ ของความยุติธรรมจะหายไปทันทีที่ข้าเดินเข้าไปในห้องพิจารณาคดีและเห็นว่าสามีของเธอถือค้อน ข้าเป็นแค่แพะรับบาป มันง่ายที่จะหนีจากการฆาตกรรมเมื่อเจ้าเป็นผู้พิพากษา
Text (Traditional Chinese): 這才不是正義。每當我走進法庭並看見那個女人的丈夫手持著木槌時，任何的公理與正義都蕩然無存。我只是個替罪的羔羊。當你就是法官時，逃避謀殺的罪責是易如反掌的事情...

Text: The most upsetting thing about this memory is how unsurprising it is. It's hard to tell whose memory this was. Certainly not Venarius, but I wouldn't be shocked to hear he was the judge.
Text (French): Le plus choquant dans ce souvenir, c'est de voir à quel point il n'est pas surprenant. Difficile de dire à qui il appartient… Certainement pas à Vénarius ; par contre, je ne serais pas étonnée d'apprendre que c'était lui, le juge en question.
Text (German): Das Schlimmste an dieser Erinnerung ist, wie wenig überraschend sie ist. Es ist schwer zu sagen, wessen Erinnerung das war. Sicherlich nicht die von Venarius, aber ich wäre nicht schockiert zu hören, dass er der Richter war.
Text (Japanese): The most upsetting thing about this memory is how unsurprising it is. It's hard to tell whose memory this was. Certainly not Venarius, but I wouldn't be shocked to hear he was the judge.
Text (Korean): 이 기억에서 가장 기분 나쁜 부분은 이게 놀랍지 않다는 사실이에요. 누구의 기억인지는 확인이 어렵군요. 당사자가 베나리우스는 아니란 건 분명하지만... 판사가 베나리우스라고 해도 놀랍진 않을 것 같아요.
Text (Portuguese): A coisa mais triste sobre essa memória é o fato de não ser nenhuma surpresa. É difícil dizer de quem foi essa memória. Certamente não do Venarius. Mas não me surpreenderia saber que ele era o juiz.
Text (Russian): Грустнее всего то, что это воспоминание меня совершенно не удивляет. Трудно определить, кому оно принадлежало... Разумеется, не Венарию, но я бы не удивилась, увидев его судьёй.
Text (Spanish): Lo más perturbador de esta memoria es lo poco que me sorprende. Es difícil saber de quién es esta memoria. Definitivamente no es de Venarius, pero no me sorprendería saber que él era el juez.
Text (Thai): The most upsetting thing about this memory is how unsurprising it is. It's hard to tell whose memory this was. Certainly not Venarius, but I wouldn't be shocked to hear he was the judge.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 最令人沮喪的是這樣子的記憶居然絲毫不令人感到驚訝。實在是很難判別這些是誰的記憶...但一定不會是維那利斯的記憶，但如果說那個法官就是維那利斯，我也不會感到絲毫的驚訝。

Text: I strike the earth once more as I have countless times, but my strike feels unfamiliar. Instead of the crack of stone, I am met with flexing sinew. I examine my pick axe. A dark red liquid froths on its tip.
Text (French): Je frappe le sol d'un nouveau coup de pioche comme je l'ai fait d'innombrables fois auparavant, mais l'impact me paraît inhabituel. Au lieu d'une fissure dans la pierre, je constate ce qui semble être un muscle qui se tord. J'examine mon outil… Un liquide sombre et rouge bouillonne sur la pointe.
Text (German): Ich schlage mit meiner Hacke in den Stein, so wie die unzähligen Male zuvor, doch dieses Mal fühlt sich mein Schlag ungewohnt an. Anstelle des bröckelnden Steins treffe ich eine fleischige Sehne. Ich begutachte meine Spitzhacke. Eine dunkelrote Flüssigkeit schäumt von der Spitze.
Text (Japanese): I strike the earth once more as I have countless times, but my strike feels unfamiliar. Instead of the crack of stone, I am met with flexing sinew. I examine my pick axe. A dark red liquid froths on its tip.
Text (Korean): 이미 셀 수도 없을 만큼 땅을 내리쳐 왔지만, 이번만은 느낌이 다르다. 돌이 부서지는 느낌 대신에, 구부러지는 힘줄과 맞닥뜨렸다. 곡괭이 끝을 살펴보았다. 검붉은 액체가 그 끝에서 부글대고 있었다.
Text (Portuguese): Eu bati na terra mais uma vez como já fiz inúmeras vezes, mas dessa vez minha pancada pareceu estranha. Ao invés do estalo da pedra, senti uma base flexível. Examinei minha picareta. Um líquido vermelho escuro espumava na ponta.
Text (Russian): Я привычно врубаюсь в породу как делал это бессчётное число раз, но этот удар отличается от прочих. Я не раскалываю камень, а втыкаюсь в упругую жилу. Оглядываю свою кирку... и вижу тёмно-красную жидкость на острие.
Text (Spanish): Golpeo la tierra una vez más, como lo he hecho incontables veces, pero mi golpe se siente extraño. En lugar del crujido de la tierra, encuentro tendones flexionados. Examino mi pico. Un oscuro líquido rojo se gotea en la punta.
Text (Thai): I strike the earth once more as I have countless times, but my strike feels unfamiliar. Instead of the crack of stone, I am met with flexing sinew. I examine my pick axe. A dark red liquid froths on its tip.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我已經記不清這是第幾次了，我只是本能的再次重擊大地，但這一次的手感卻非常的陌生。與之前敲碎的石頭不同，映入眼簾的是扭曲的肌肉。而我檢查了一下我的鎬頭...暗紅色的液體沾染在鎬頭的尖端，並冒著不詳的泡泡。

Text: The metal beneath rapidly corrodes. Have I found it at last? I run to alert the General. I'm told not to speak of what I found. The other slaves must continue to dig, but I am set free.
Text (French): Le métal sous le liquide se corrode rapidement. L'aurais-je enfin trouvée ? Je cours prévenir le Général. Il me dit de ne parler de ma découverte à personne. Les autres esclaves doivent continuer à creuser, mais moi, je suis libéré.
Text (German): Das darunterliegende Metall korrodiert augenblicklich. Habe ich es endlich gefunden? Ich eile, um den General zu alarmieren. Mir wurde gesagt, nicht über meinen Fund zu sprechen. Die anderen Sklaven müssen weiter graben, aber ich bin frei.
Text (Japanese): The metal beneath rapidly corrodes. Have I found it at last? I run to alert the General. I'm told not to speak of what I found. The other slaves must continue to dig, but I am set free.
Text (Korean): 아래쪽의 금속이 빠르게 부식된다. 드디어 찾아낸 건가? 장군에게 달려가 이를 알렸다. 발견한 것에 관해 입을 다물라는 이야기를 들었다. 다른 노예들은 여전히 땅을 파야 하는 신세지만, 난 자유의 몸이 될 수 있었다.
Text (Portuguese): O metal corroeu rapidamente. Eu havia finalmente encontrado? Corri para alertar o General. Ordenaram que eu não falasse sobre o que eu achara. Os outros escravos deviam continuar cavando, mas eu fui libertado.
Text (Russian): Жидкость быстро разъедает металл. Неужто я всё-таки его нашёл? Я бегу рассказать о находке легату. Он приказывает не говорить больше никому. Другие рабы продолжат раскопки, а меня отпускают...
Text (Spanish): El metal que está debajo se corroe rápidamente. ¿Lo habré encontrado al fin? Corro para alertar al General. Me indican que no debo hablar de lo que encontré. Los otros esclavos deben seguir cavando, pero yo soy libre.
Text (Thai): The metal beneath rapidly corrodes. Have I found it at last? I run to alert the General. I'm told not to speak of what I found. The other slaves must continue to dig, but I am set free.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 沾染液體的金屬迅速的被腐蝕。我終於找到了嗎？我跑去通知將軍。但我被告知不要告訴任何人我找到的東西。其他的奴隸必須繼續挖掘，而我則被釋放了...

Text: This must have been one of the Eternal slaves... an Ezomyte, maybe. But sinew beneath stone? What could that be?
Text (French): Ce devait être l'un des esclaves des Éternels… Un Ézomyte, peut-être. Mais du muscle sous la pierre ? Qu'est-ce que ça pouvait bien être ?
Text (German): Das muss wohl ein Sklave der Ewigen  gewesen sein ... Vielleicht ein Ezomyt. Aber eine Sehne unter dem Gestein? Was könnte das sein?
Text (Japanese): This must have been one of the Eternal slaves... an Ezomyte, maybe. But sinew beneath stone? What could that be?
Text (Korean): 영원한 제국의 노예들 중 하나가 분명해요... 아마 에조미어 사람이었겠죠. 그런데 돌 아래의 힘줄이라고요? 어떻게 그런 게 가능한 거지?
Text (Portuguese): Esse deve ser um dos escravos Eternos... um Ezomita, talvez. Mas a base embaixo da pedra? O que seria?
Text (Russian): Видать, это один из рабов вечных. Может быть, эзомит. Но жила в толще камня? Что это могло быть?
Text (Spanish): Este debe haber sido uno de los esclavos eternos... un ezomita, tal vez. Pero, ¿tendones bajo la tierra? ¿Qué sería eso?
Text (Thai): This must have been one of the Eternal slaves... an Ezomyte, maybe. But sinew beneath stone? What could that be?
Text (Traditional Chinese): 這一定是某個不朽帝國的奴隸...一個艾茲麥人？或許是。但埋藏在石頭裡的肌肉？那會是什麼？

Text: Indexing artefact one-twelve in lot ten, an ancient jawbone. Carvings on the side attribute it to... Valako? This can't actually be the jawbone from the myth... and this... Tukohama's tooth? Hinekora's hair?
Text (French): Indexation de l'artefact vingt et un dans le lot dix. Une mandibule ancienne. Des inscriptions sur le côté indiquent qu'elle aurait appartenu à… Valako ? Ça ne peut quand même pas être l'os dont parle le mythe… Et ça… ? La dent de Tukohama ? Les cheveux d'Hinekora ?
Text (German): Indexierung von Artefakt eins-zwölf auf Platz zehn, ein alter Kieferknochen. Lässt es sich mit den Schnitzereien auf der Seite ... Valako zuordnen? Das kann unmöglich der Kieferknochen aus dem Mythos sein ... und das ... Tukohamas Zahn? Hinekoras Haar?
Text (Japanese): Indexing artefact one-twelve in lot ten, an ancient jawbone. Carvings on the side attribute it to... Valako? This can't actually be the jawbone from the myth... and this... Tukohama's tooth? Hinekora's hair?
Text (Korean): 10번 구역의 1-12 유물 색인을 정리하고 있다. 고대의 턱뼈다. 바깥쪽에 새겨진 건... 발라코인가? 설마 진짜 신화 속의 그 턱뼈일 리가... 그리고 이건... 투코하마의 이빨인가? 히네코라의 머리카락?
Text (Portuguese): Arquivando artefato um-doze no lote dez, um antigo maxilar. Escrituras na lateral o atribuem a... Valako? Esse não pode ser o mesmo maxilar da mitologia... e esse... dente de Tukohama? Cabelo de Hinekora?
Text (Russian): Каталогизирую древнюю челюсть — артефакт один-двенадцать из десятой партии. Отметины на боку позволяют отнести её к... Валако? Эта челюсть не могла пожаловать сюда прямиком из мифа... А это... зуб Тукохамы? Волос Хинекоры?
Text (Spanish): Indexando artefacto uno-doce del lote diez, una mandíbula antigua. Los grabados a los lados la atribuyen a... ¿Valako? No es posible que sea la mandíbula del mito... y esto... ¿el diente de Tukohama? ¿Cabello de Hinekora?
