Text (Russian): Я прихожу в себя и понимаю, что лежу в одиночестве на крохотном островке. Скорее, это просто риф. Я не вижу другой земли. Уж лучше бы я оказался в Рэкласте.
Text (Spanish): Cuando despierto, estoy solo en una pequeña isla. En verdad es poco más que una roca. No puedo ver nada de tierra. Hasta Wraeclast hubiera sido mejor que esto.
Text (Thai): When I come to, I'm alone on a tiny island. Little more than a rock, really. I can't see any other land. Even Wraeclast would've been better than this.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 當我醒來時，我獨自在一個小島上。大概只有一個石頭那麼大，不誇張。我沒看見其他陸地。我想就連瓦爾克拉斯都比這來得好。

Text: Just goes to show, even as the world around us lays in ruins, things could always be worse.
Text (French): Cela démontre que même lorsque le monde autour de nous tombe en ruines, les choses peuvent toujours être encore pires.
Text (German): Das zeigt, auch wenn die Welt um uns herum in Trümmern liegt, könnte es immer noch schlimmer kommen.
Text (Japanese): Just goes to show, even as the world around us lays in ruins, things could always be worse.
Text (Korean): 아무리 상황이 나락으로 떨어져도 그보다도 더 바닥이 있을 수 있다는 걸 보여주는 것 같네요.
Text (Portuguese): Apenas uma prova de que o mundo à nossa volta está em ruínas. As coisas sempre podem piorar.
Text (Russian): Как видишь, даже если окружающий нас мир лежит в руинах, бывают положения и похуже.
Text (Spanish): Y así está la cosa. Incluso cuando el mundo a nuestro alrededor yace en ruinas, las cosas siempre podrían estar peor.
Text (Thai): Just goes to show, even as the world around us lays in ruins, things could always be worse.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 這就像是在告訴我，就算我們身處的世界被一片廢墟環繞，事情總還是會變得更糟。

Text: The world is changing in dark and subtle ways around us as I run. My arms burn from the weight of my young children. The sun is turning blood red, and there's only one place of safety I can imagine.
Text (French): Le monde s'altère de manières aussi sombres que subtiles tandis que je cours, les bras endoloris par le poids de mes jeunes enfants. Le soleil devient rouge sang, et il n'y a qu'un seul endroit auquel je pense où nous serions en sécurité.
Text (German): Während ich laufe, verändert sich die Welt um uns herum langsam auf dunkle Weise. Meine Arme schmerzen durch das Gewicht meiner kleinen Kinder. Die Sonne färbt sich blutrot, und ich kenne nur einen Ort, an dem wir sicher sind.
Text (Japanese): The world is changing in dark and subtle ways around us as I run. My arms burn from the weight of my young children. The sun is turning blood red, and there's only one place of safety I can imagine.
Text (Korean): 달려가는 동안 주변의 세상이 어둡고 기괴하게 변해가고 있었다. 아이들을 안고 있는 팔이 떨어져 나갈 것 같다. 태양이 핏빛으로 변하는 와중에도 안전한 곳이라곤 단 한 곳만이 떠오를 뿐이다.
Text (Portuguese): O mundo estava mudando de formas sutis e obscuras à nossa volta enquanto eu corria. Meus braços queimavam com o peso dos meus filhos pequenos. O sol se tornava vermelho sangue, e eu só conseguia pensar em um lugar que seria seguro.
Text (Russian): Я бегу, а мир вокруг нас неуловимо становится темнее. Руки гудят от тяжести моих маленьких детей. Солнце наливается багрянцем. Я бегу к единственному месту, которое кажется безопасным.
Text (Spanish): A medida que corro el mundo cambia de forma oscura y sutil a nuestro alrededor. Mis brazos queman por el peso de mis pequeños niños. El sol se está volviendo rojo sangre, y solo hay un lugar seguro que puedo imaginar.
Text (Thai): The world is changing in dark and subtle ways around us as I run. My arms burn from the weight of my young children. The sun is turning blood red, and there's only one place of safety I can imagine.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 當我奔跑時，世界逐漸變暗並以一種其妙的方式靠近我們。我懷中的孩子灼燒著我的手臂。太陽逐漸轉變為血紅色，我只能想到一個安全的地方。

Text: The walls of the cave we huddle in tremble. The screaming outside keeps us from fleeing into the open air. Life has gone mad, and the sky is burning. The children cry out for their mother, but I haven't the heart to tell them what she became in front of my eyes.
Text (French): Les parois de la grotte dans laquelle nous nous blottissons tremblent, mais les cris à l'extérieur nous découragent de prendre la fuite. La vie a sombré dans la démence et le ciel est en flammes. Les enfants appellent leur mère, mais je n'ai pas le cœur de leur apprendre ce qu'elle est devenue sous mes propres yeux.
Text (German): Die Wände der Höhle, in der wir zusammenkauern, erzittern. Nur die schreiende Außenwelt hält uns davon ab, ins Freie zu fliehen. Das Leben spielt verrückt, und der Himmel brennt. Die Kinder schreien nach ihrer Mutter, aber ich bringe es nicht über mein Herz, ihnen zu sagen, was aus ihr vor meinen Augen geworden ist.
Text (Japanese): The walls of the cave we huddle in tremble. The screaming outside keeps us from fleeing into the open air. Life has gone mad, and the sky is burning. The children cry out for their mother, but I haven't the heart to tell them what she became in front of my eyes.
Text (Korean): 숨어있던 동굴의 벽이 떨려왔다. 밖에서 들려오는 비명에 밖으로 나갈 엄두가 나지 않았다. 살아있는 자들은 미쳐가고, 하늘은 불타고 있다. 아이들은 엄마를 찾아 울어대건만, 아내가 내 눈앞에서 어떻게 변했는지 차마 말해줄 용기가 나지 않는다.
Text (Portuguese): As paredes da caverna onde nos amontoávamos tremiam. Os gritos do lado de fora nos impediam de fugir para o ar livre. A vida enloquecia, o céu queimava. As crianças choravam por sua mãe, mas eu não tinha coragem de dizer a eles no que ela se tornou diante dos meus olhos.
Text (Russian): Стены укрывшей нас пещеры содрогаются, но доносящиеся снаружи крики отбивают всякую охоту выбегать на открытый воздух. Само небо горит, а жизнь сошла с ума. Дети плачут и зовут свою маму, а у меня не хватает духу рассказать о том, во что она превратилась прямо у меня на глазах.
Text (Spanish): Las paredes de la cueva en la que nos acurrucamos tiemblan. Los gritos del exterior evitan que huyamos hacia campo abierto. La vida se ha vuelto loca, y el cielo arde. Los niños lloran por su madre, pero no tengo las fuerzas para decirles en lo que se ha convertido frente a mis ojos.
Text (Thai): The walls of the cave we huddle in tremble. The screaming outside keeps us from fleeing into the open air. Life has gone mad, and the sky is burning. The children cry out for their mother, but I haven't the heart to tell them what she became in front of my eyes.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我們蜷縮在山洞的牆角顫抖著，外面的尖叫聲使我們不敢逃到外面去。一切逐漸變得瘋狂，天空像是在燃燒。孩子哭喊著他們的母親，但我實在不忍心告訴他們，她現在在我面前成了什麼樣子。

Text: How horrible... I wonder what ever happened to those children. Perhaps it's better not to know.
Text (French): Comme c'est horrible… Je me demande ce que ces enfants sont devenus. Il vaut peut-être mieux ne pas le savoir.
Text (German): Wie schrecklich ... Ich frage mich, was mit diesen Kindern passiert ist. Vielleicht ist es besser, es nicht zu erfahren.
Text (Japanese): How horrible... I wonder what ever happened to those children. Perhaps it's better not to know.
Text (Korean): 끔찍하네요... 아이들이 어찌 되었을지 궁금해지는데, 어쩌면 그냥 모르는 편이 나을지도 모르겠어요.
Text (Portuguese): Que horror... O que será que aconteceu com aquelas crianças? Talvez seja melhor não saber.
Text (Russian): Какой ужас. Знать бы, что стало с этими детьми. Хотя... лучше оставаться в неведении.
Text (Spanish): Qué horrible… me pregunto qué habrá ocurrido con esos niños. Tal vez sea mejor no saber.
Text (Thai): ช่างน่ากลัวเหลือเกิน... ข้าสงสัยว่าเกิดอะไรขึ้นกับลูกเหล่านั้น บางทีมันอาจจะดีกว่าที่ไม่รู้
Text (Traditional Chinese): 這真是太可怕了...我很好奇那些孩子們之後發生了什麼事。或許還是不要知道比較好。

Text: The boats are the only way out of the city! Don't you understand? The sky is burning! We have to go!
Text (French): Les bateaux sont le seul moyen de sortir de la cité ! Vous ne comprenez donc pas ? Le ciel est en feu ! Nous devons partir !
Text (German): Die Boote sind der einzige Weg aus der Stadt! Verstehst du nicht? Der Himmel brennt! Wir müssen los!
Text (Japanese): The boats are the only way out of the city! Don't you understand? The sky is burning! We have to go!
Text (Korean): 도시를 빠져나갈 방법은 배편밖에 없어! 아직 모르겠어? 하늘이 불타고 있다고! 도망쳐야 해!
Text (Portuguese): Os barcos são o único jeito de sair sa cidade! Você não entendeu? O céu está em chamas! Temos que ir!
Text (Russian): Мы можем выбраться из города только на лодках! Ты что, не видишь? Небо в огне! Мы должны плыть!
Text (Spanish): ¡Los botes son la única forma de abandonar la ciudad! ¿No lo entiendes? ¡El cielo está en llamas! ¡Debemos irnos!
Text (Thai): เรือเป็นทางออกเดียวของเมือง! เจ้าไม่เข้าใจเหรอ ท้องฟ้ากำลังลุกไหม้! เราต้องไปแล้ว!
Text (Traditional Chinese): 船是唯一離開這城市的方法！你不懂嗎？天空在燃燒！我們必須走！

Text: Everyone had the same idea. The crowded boats aren't moving at all. The others scream and wail. Everything begins to burn. I hold my son under the water and pray his death is quicker than mine.
Text (French): Tout le monde a eu la même idée ; les bateaux surpeuplés ne bougent pas d'un iota. Les gens hurlent et gémissent. Tout se met à brûler. Je plonge mon fils dans l'eau en priant pour que sa mort soit plus rapide que la mienne.
Text (German): Alle hatten die gleiche Idee. Die überfüllten Boote bewegen sich überhaupt nicht. Die anderen schreien und jammern. Alles beginnt zu brennen. Ich drücke meinen Sohn unter Wasser und bete, dass sein Tod schneller ist als meiner.
Text (Japanese): Everyone had the same idea. The crowded boats aren't moving at all. The others scream and wail. Everything begins to burn. I hold my son under the water and pray his death is quicker than mine.
Text (Korean): 모두가 같은 생각을 떠올리고 있었다. 만선이 된 배는 한 치도 움직이지 않았다. 사람들은 비명을 지르며 흐느낄 뿐이었다. 모든 것이 불타기 시작했다. 나는 물속에서 아들을 꼭 끌어안은 채 아들의 고통이 나보다 먼저 끝나기만을 기도하고 있었다.
Text (Portuguese): Todos tiveram a mesma ideia. Os barcos lotados não se moviam. Os outros gritavam e choravam. Tudo começou a queimar. Segurei meu filho embaixo d'água e rezei para que a morte dele fosse mais rápida que a minha.
Text (Russian): Так же думают все вокруг. Лодки забиты людьми и не могут сдвинуться с места. Люди на берегах орут и воют. Вокруг разгораются пожары. Я пихаю сына под воду, держу его и молюсь, чтобы сын умер быстрее меня.
Text (Spanish): Todos tuvieron la misma idea. Los botes repletos no se están moviendo. Los demás gritan y aúllan. Todo comienza a arder. Sostengo a mi hijo bajo el agua y ruego que su muerte sea más rápida que la mía.
Text (Thai): ทุกคนมีความคิดเดียวกัน เรือที่แออัดไม่ขยับเลย คนอื่นๆ กรีดร้องและคร่ำครวญ ทุกอย่างเริ่มไหม้ ข้ากดลูกชายของฉันไว้ใต้น้ำและภาวนาเขาจะได้ตายเร็วกว่าข้า
Text (Traditional Chinese): 每個人都想著一樣的事情。船上擠滿了人根本沒辦法航行。其他人開始尖叫並哀嚎。所有的東西都燒起來了。我把我兒子壓入水中並祈禱他起碼能死的比我還輕鬆。

Text: The most horrible thing is, I'm certain that parent was doing their child a mercy.
Text (French): Le plus horrible dans cette histoire, c'est que je suis certaine que ce père a fait preuve de miséricorde envers son enfant.
Text (German): Das Schlimmste ist, und da bin ich mir sicher, dass das Elternteil seinem Kind einen Gefallen getan hat.
Text (Japanese): The most horrible thing is, I'm certain that parent was doing their child a mercy.
Text (Korean): 가장 끔찍한 일은 저 부모가 자기 아이를 위해 저렇게 행동했다는 점이에요.
Text (Portuguese): O mais horrível é que eu tenho certeza de que aquele foi um ato de misericórdia da mãe.
Text (Russian): Ужаснее всего то, что отец наверняка считал убийство сына милосердным поступком.
Text (Spanish): La parte más espantosa es que estoy segura de que ese padre estaba siendo misericordioso con su hijo.
Text (Thai): สิ่งที่น่ากลัวที่สุดคือข้ามั่นใจว่าพ่อแม่กำลังช่วยลูกของเขาอยู่
Text (Traditional Chinese): ...最令人感到可怕的是，我居然也同意那對父母對他們孩子所作的事是慈悲之舉。

Text: My grandparents worshipped here, back when it was still a place of faith. I wonder, did the gods ever hear them?
Text (French): Mes grands-parents venaient témoigner leur foi ici, à l'époque où c'était encore un lieu de culte. Je me demande si les dieux ne les ont jamais entendus.
Text (German): Meine Großeltern beteten hier, damals, als es noch ein Ort des Glaubens war. Ich frage mich, ob die Götter sie jemals gehört haben.
Text (Japanese): My grandparents worshipped here, back when it was still a place of faith. I wonder, did the gods ever hear them?
Text (Korean): 여기에 아직 신앙이 있었을 적에, 조부모님께선 여기에서 신들을 찬양하셨다던데. 신들께서 들어주긴 하셨을까?
Text (Portuguese): Meus avós faziam cultos aqui, quando ainda era um lugar de fé. Será que os deuses os escutavam?
Text (Russian): Здесь молились мои предки, когда это место ещё было приютом веры. Слышали ли их боги? Услышали ли хоть раз?
Text (Spanish): Mis abuelos rezaban aquí, cuando este aún era un lugar de fe. ¿Alguna vez los habrán escuchado los dioses?
Text (Thai): My grandparents worshipped here, back when it was still a place of faith. I wonder, did the gods ever hear them?
Text (Traditional Chinese): 當這裡仍是一個信仰之地的時候，我的祖父母曾在這跪拜過。我很好奇！眾神真的有聆聽他們的聲音嗎？

Text: I choose to believe the gods did listen, and that I am here now out of that benevolence. It is the only way I can explain surviving the troubles.
Text (French): Je choisis de croire que les dieux les entendaient bel et bien et que ma présence ici est due à cette bienveillance. C'est la seule raison qui me permettrait d'expliquer pourquoi j'ai survécu à cette période de troubles.
Text (German): Ich beschließe zu glauben, dass die Götter zugehört haben, und dass ich jetzt aufgrund ihrer Güte hier bin. Es ist die einzige Schlussfolgerung, mit der ich mein Überleben erklären kann.
Text (Japanese): I choose to believe the gods did listen, and that I am here now out of that benevolence. It is the only way I can explain surviving the troubles.
Text (Korean): 분명 들으셨을 거야. 그 자비심 덕분에 지금 내가 여기 있는 걸 테니. 이렇게 숱한 문제 속에서도 살아남은 걸 설명할 방법은 그뿐이니까.
Text (Portuguese): Eu escolhi acreditar que os deuses ouviam, e que eu estava aqui agora graças à sua benevolência. É a única explicação pra minha sobrevivência.
Text (Russian): Я хочу верить, что боги слышали. Что я попал сюда из их милосердия. Только этим можно объяснить то, что я всё ещё живу.
Text (Spanish): Elijo pensar que los dioses sí escuchaban, y que si estoy aquí es por su benevolencia. Es la única explicación que encuentro para haber sobrevivido a todos los problemas.
Text (Thai): I choose to believe the gods did listen, and that I am here now out of that benevolence. It is the only way I can explain surviving the troubles.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我選擇相信眾神確實聽到了，而我現在已經不再受其恩典。這是我能從那場災難中存活的唯一解釋。

Text: Knowing what we now know about the gods, I think we can safely say benevolence was not the cause.
Text (French): Avec ce que l'on sait maintenant au sujet des dieux, je crois qu'on peut affirmer sans se tromper qu'aucune bienveillance n'était en cause.
Text (German): Mit dem Wissen, welches wir jetzt über die Götter haben, denke ich, dass wir mit Sicherheit sagen können, dass Wohlwollen nicht die Ursache war.
Text (Japanese): Knowing what we now know about the gods, I think we can safely say benevolence was not the cause.
Text (Korean): 우리가 지금 신들에 대해 알게 된 것들을 생각하면... 자비 때문에 그런 일을 한 건 아니라고 확실히 말할 수 있겠네요.
Text (Portuguese): Sabendo o que sabemos agora sobre os deuses, acho que é certo dizer que benevolência não era o motivo.
Text (Russian): Мы кое-что знаем о богах. Думаю, можно с уверенностью предположить, что никаким милосердием там и не пахло.
Text (Spanish): Sabiendo lo que sabemos de los dioses, creo que puedo decir con toda seguridad que la benevolencia no fue la causa.
Text (Thai): Knowing what we now know about the gods, I think we can safely say benevolence was not the cause.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 以我們現在對眾神的了解，我想我們可以肯定的說這跟神的恩典無關。

Text: Where am I? What happened? I remember a massive spider coming at me, and then... huh, I'm stuck in webbing...
Text (French): Où suis-je ? Que s'est-il passé ? Je me souviens d'une araignée gigantesque qui s'approchait de moi, et ensuite… Ah ! Je suis empêtré dans une toile…
Text (German): Wo bin ich? Was ist passiert? Ich erinnere mich an eine große Spinne, die auf mich zukam und dann ... huh, ich stecke in einem Netz fest ...
Text (Japanese): Where am I? What happened? I remember a massive spider coming at me, and then... huh, I'm stuck in webbing...
Text (Korean): 여긴 어디지? 대체 무슨 일이 있었던 거야? 거대한 거미가 덮쳤던 것까지는 기억나는데... 이런, 거미줄 때문에 꼼짝 못 하겠어...
Text (Portuguese): Onde estou? O que aconteceu? Lembro de uma aranha enorme vindo na minha direção, e aí... huh, estou presa na teia...
Text (Russian): Где я? Что случилось? Помню, ко мне спешит здоровенный паук, а потом... Ох, я застряла в паутине...
Text (Spanish): ¿Dónde estoy? ¿Qué ha pasado? Recuerdo una enorme araña viniendo hacia mí, y entonces... eh, estoy atrapado en una telaraña...
Text (Thai): Where am I? What happened? I remember a massive spider coming at me, and then... huh, I'm stuck in webbing...
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我是誰？我在哪裡？我只記得有隻大蜘蛛朝我衝過來，然後...呃，我好像被困在蜘蛛網裡....

Text: My stomach is really rumbling... and it hurts... and it's bulging... and rippling...
Text (French): Mon ventre gargouille terriblement… et il me fait mal… et il se gonfle… et il ondule…
Text (German): Mein Magen knurrt wirklich ... und er tut weh ... und er bläht sich auf ... und kräuselt sich ...
Text (Japanese): My stomach is really rumbling... and it hurts... and it's bulging... and rippling...
Text (Korean): 배가 부글거려... 아프기도 하고... 뭐가 이리 불룩하고... 움찔거리는 거야...
Text (Portuguese): Meu estômago ronca... e dói... está inchado... e se agitando...
Text (Russian): У меня живот вспучился... Он болит... бугрится... ходит ходуном...
Text (Spanish): Mi estómago está retumbando... y me duele... y está abultado... y agitado...
Text (Thai): My stomach is really rumbling... and it hurts... and it's bulging... and rippling...
Text (Traditional Chinese): 噢...我的胃有點脹...而且有點痛...好像有什麼東西...鼓鼓的...好像在動....

Text: Ugh, what a horrid way to die. Exile, if you ever find me in that state, you know what to do, right?
Text (French): <if:MS>{Beurk ! Quelle épouvantable façon de mourir ! Exilé, si jamais vous me trouvez dans cet état, vous savez ce qu'il vous restera à faire, j'espère ?}<elif:FS>{Beurk ! Quelle épouvantable façon de mourir ! Exilée, si jamais vous me trouvez dans cet état, vous savez ce qu'il vous restera à faire, j'espère ?}
Text (German): <if:MS>{Igitt, welch unappetitliche Art zu sterben. Verbannter, wenn Ihr mich jemals in diesem Zustand findet, wisst Ihr, was zu tun ist, oder?}<elif:FS>{Igitt, welch unappetitliche Art zu sterben. Verbannte, wenn Ihr mich jemals in diesem Zustand findet, wisst Ihr, was zu tun ist, oder?}
Text (Japanese): Ugh, what a horrid way to die. Exile, if you ever find me in that state, you know what to do, right?
Text (Korean): 윽, 정말 소름 끼치는 방식이군요. 제가 저런 상황에 처하게 되면... 아시죠?
Text (Portuguese): <if:MS>{Ugh. Que forma desagradável de morrer. Exilado, se me encontrar desse jeito, já sabe o que fazer, né?}<elif:FS>{Ugh. Que forma desagradável de morrer. Exilada, se me encontrar desse jeito, já sabe o que fazer, né?}
Text (Russian): <if:MS>{Фу-у... Что за ужасная смерть. Изгнанник, если когда-нибудь застанешь меня такой... Ты ведь знаешь, что делать?}<elif:FS>{Фу-у... Что за ужасная смерть. Изгнанница, если когда-нибудь застанешь меня такой... Ты ведь знаешь, что делать?}
Text (Spanish): <if:MS>{Ugh, qué forma horrenda de morir. Exiliado, si alguna vez me encuentras en ese estado, sabes qué hacer, ¿cierto?}<elif:FS>{Ugh, qué forma horrenda de morir. Exiliada, si alguna vez me encuentras en ese estado, sabes qué hacer, ¿cierto?}
Text (Thai): Ugh, what a horrid way to die. Exile, if you ever find me in that state, you know what to do, right?
Text (Traditional Chinese): 噁...這是什麼悽慘的死法啊。流亡者，如果真有一天你發現我變成那個樣子，你知道該怎麼做吧？

Text: Sarn is the city of opportunity, they said. The cradle of civilisation. Pardon me if I don't feel swaddled and taken care of in this 'cradle.'
Text (French): Sarn est la cité des possibles, qu'ils disaient. Le berceau de la civilisation. Désolé si je n'ai pas vraiment l'impression d'être langé et chouchouté dans ce soi-disant « berceau ».
Text (German): Sarn, die Stadt der Möglichkeiten, sagten sie. Die Wiege der Zivilisation. Entschuldigt mich, wenn ich mich in dieser \"Wiege\" nicht behütet und umsorgt fühle.
Text (Japanese): Sarn is the city of opportunity, they said. The cradle of civilisation. Pardon me if I don't feel swaddled and taken care of in this 'cradle.'
Text (Korean): 사안은 기회의 도시라고들 하더군. 문명의 요람이라던가. 미안하지만 내가 보기엔 이 '요람'이라는 게 그렇게 안락하거나 돌봐주는 곳은 아닌 것 같아.
Text (Portuguese): Diziam que Sarn era a cidade de oportunidades. O berço da civilização. Perdoe-me por não me sentir acolhido e bem cuidado nesse 'berço'.
Text (Russian): Они называли Сарн городом возможностей. Колыбелью цивилизации. Простите, но я, дитя этой «колыбели», не припомню ласки и любви.
Text (Spanish): Sarn es la ciudad de las oportunidades, solían decir. La cuna de la civilización. Perdona si no me siento acogido y cuidado en esta \"cuna\".
Text (Thai): Sarn is the city of opportunity, they said. The cradle of civilisation. Pardon me if I don't feel swaddled and taken care of in this 'cradle.'
Text (Traditional Chinese): 他們說，薩恩是希望之城。文明的搖籃。但我實在是感受不到任何這個\"搖籃\"提供了什麼機會或命運給我。

Text: It's starve or steal. I think I know which one I like better.
Text (French): Ici, c'est vole ou crève de faim — et je crois bien savoir ce que je préfère entre les deux.
Text (German): Hungern oder stehlen. Ich glaube, ich weiß, wofür ich mich lieber entscheide.
Text (Japanese): It's starve or steal. I think I know which one I like better.
Text (Korean): 현실은 훔치지 않으면 굶주리는 곳이겠지. 어느 쪽이 내 취향인지는 알 것 같네.
Text (Portuguese): Ou eu roubo ou morro de fome. Acho que sei qual dos dois eu prefiro.
Text (Russian): Ты воруешь или пухнешь с голоду, и я знаю, что мне больше по нраву.
Text (Spanish): Es robar o morir de hambre. Creo que sé cuál prefiero.
Text (Thai): It's starve or steal. I think I know which one I like better.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 這裡不去偷就是等著餓死，我知道我比較喜歡何者。

Text: With Oriath in the state it's in, I worry we're not far from tumbling down this same road. At least we can rule Venarius out of that memory.
Text (French): Vu l'état actuel d'Oriath, je crains que nous ne soyons à deux doigts de descendre la même pente. Au moins, on sait que ce souvenir n'est pas celui de Vénarius.
Text (German): In Anbetracht des Zustands, in dem Oriath sich befindet, befürchte ich, dass wir nicht mehr weit davon entfernt sind, vom selben Schicksal eingeholt zu werden. Wenigstens können wir Venarius aus dieser Erinnerung ausschließen.
Text (Japanese): With Oriath in the state it's in, I worry we're not far from tumbling down this same road. At least we can rule Venarius out of that memory.
Text (Korean): 오리아스도 이렇게 될 때까지 그렇게 오래 남은 것 같지는 않아요. 어쨌건 베나리우스의 기억은 아니었네요.
Text (Portuguese): Do jeito que Oriath se encontra, temo que não estamos longe de seguir por esse mesmo caminho. Pelo menos podemos eliminar Venarius dessa memória.
Text (Russian): Ориат сейчас в таком состоянии, что, боюсь, скоро мы покатимся по той же наклонной. По крайней мере, мы можем вымарать Венария из этого воспоминания.
Text (Spanish): Con Oriath en el estado en que está, me temo que no estamos lejos de caer en este mismo camino. Al menos podemos decir que esta memoria no era de Venarius.
Text (Thai): With Oriath in the state it's in, I worry we're not far from tumbling down this same road. At least we can rule Venarius out of that memory.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 看看奧瑞亞現在的狀況，我擔心不久之後我們便會步上這條後塵。但至少我們可以讓維那利斯遠離那個記憶。

Text: With one motion, I cleave a man in twain. A kick sends another flying, and the roar of the crowd swells. I am their idol!
Text (French): D'un seul geste, je fends un homme en deux. Un coup de pied en envoie voler un autre sous les rugissements grandissants de la foule. Je suis leur idole !
Text (German): Mit einer Bewegung spalte ich einen Mann in zwei Hälften. Mit einem Tritt lasse ich einen weiteren fliegen, und das Gebrüll der Menge erreicht den Siedepunkt. Ich bin ihr Idol!
Text (Japanese): With one motion, I cleave a man in twain. A kick sends another flying, and the roar of the crowd swells. I am their idol!
Text (Korean): 한 번의 움직임으로 한 놈을 둘로 갈랐어. 그리고 한 번의 발길질로 다른 놈을 날려버렸지. 어마어마한 사람들의 환호가 울려 퍼지더군. 내가 저들의 우상이라고!
Text (Portuguese): Com um movimento, eu parti um homem em dois. Fiz um outro voar com um chute, e a multidão foi à loucura. Eu sou seu ídolo!
Text (Russian): Я одним движением рассекаю человека напополам. Пинком отправляю другого в полёт и слышу рёв толпы. Я их кумир!
Text (Spanish): Con un solo movimiento, puedo partir a un hombre en dos. Con una patada lanzo a otro hombre por los aires, y el rugido del público crece. ¡Me idolatran!
Text (Thai): With one motion, I cleave a man in twain. A kick sends another flying, and the roar of the crowd swells. I am their idol!
Text (Traditional Chinese): 只消一個動作，我將一個人劈成了兩半。一腳踢飛另一個人，群眾的歡呼聲炸裂。我是他們的偶像！

Text: I was always meant to be at the top of the pile. Nobody else can compare. And this tiny man, this new challenger, Daresso, will fall like the rest to the might of Barkhul.
Text (French): Depuis toujours, je suis destiné à me trouver tout en haut de l'échelle. Personne ne peut se mesurer à moi. Daresso, cet avorton, tombera comme les autres sous la toute-puissance de Barkhul.
Text (German): Ich war immer dazu bestimmt, ganz oben zu stehen. Niemand sonst kann sich mit mir messen. Und dieser kleine Mann, dieser neue Herausforderer, Daresso, wird wie der Rest unter der Macht von Barkhul fallen.
Text (Japanese): I was always meant to be at the top of the pile. Nobody else can compare. And this tiny man, this new challenger, Daresso, will fall like the rest to the might of Barkhul.
Text (Korean): 난 언제나 최고여야 했어. 아무도 내게 비견될 수 없었지. 다레소라고 하는 작달막한 도전자 놈도 이 바르쿨 님의 힘 앞에서는 예외가 되지 못할 거야.
Text (Portuguese): Eu nasci para ser o número um. Ninguém se compara. E esse homenzinho, esse novo desafiante, Daresso, cairá como o resto dos poderosos de Barkhul.
Text (Russian): Я всегда поднимался на самый верх. Никто мне не ровня. И этот Дарессо, тщедушный, посмевший бросить мне вызов человечишка, тоже падёт от могучей руки Гавула.
Text (Spanish): Siempre tuve la intención de estar en la cima. Nadie más se puede comparar conmigo. Y este pequeño hombre, este nuevo contrincante, Daresso, caerá como el resto de las fuerzas de Barkhul.
Text (Thai): I was always meant to be at the top of the pile. Nobody else can compare. And this tiny man, this new challenger, Daresso, will fall like the rest to the might of Barkhul.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我就是金字塔頂端的象徵。所向披靡。而這個小傢伙，這個新來的菜逼巴，德瑞索，會像其他雜種一樣臣服在我大巴爾克霍的淫威之下。

Text: Ha! We know how that ended, don't we?
Text (French): Ha ! On sait comment ça s'est terminé, pas vrai ?
Text (German): Ha! Wir wissen, wie das endete, nicht wahr?
Text (Japanese): Ha! We know how that ended, don't we?
Text (Korean): 하! 저 이야기가 어떻게 끝나는지 우리는 잘 알고 있죠.
Text (Portuguese): Ha! Sabemos como isso terminou, né?
Text (Russian): Ха! Но мы-то знаем, чем закончился тот бой.
Text (Spanish): ¡Ja! Ya sabemos cómo termino aquello, ¿verdad?
Text (Thai): Ha! We know how that ended, don't we?
Text (Traditional Chinese): 哈！我們都知道結局如何，不是嗎？

Text: I've thirsted for adventure my entire life, but I suppose, at eighty-two, the most I can do now is walk along the village plateau.
Text (French): J'ai eu soif d'aventures toute ma vie, mais j'imagine qu'à quatre-vingt-deux ans, le mieux que je peux faire désormais est de me promener le long du plateau du village.
Text (German): Ich habe mich mein ganzes Leben lang nach Abenteuern gesehnt, aber nun nehme ich an, dass ich mit zweiundachtzig höchstens am Dorfplateau entlang spazieren kann.
Text (Japanese): I've thirsted for adventure my entire life, but I suppose, at eighty-two, the most I can do now is walk along the village plateau.
Text (Korean): 한평생을 모험에 목말라하며 살아왔지만, 여든두 살이 된 지금의 나에겐 마을 언덕을 오르는 일이 그나마 할 수 있는 전부구나.
Text (Portuguese): Tive sede de aventura a vida inteira, mas presumo que, aos oitenta e dois anos, o máximo que podia fazer era caminhar pelas planícies da aldeia.
Text (Russian): Всю жизнь меня манила дорога странствий, но теперь, в восемьдесят два года, я могу разве что прогуляться у деревни.
Text (Spanish): He ansiado la aventura durante toda mi vida, pero supongo que a mi edad, ochenta y dos años, lo más que puedo hacer es pasear por la explanada de la aldea.
Text (Thai): I've thirsted for adventure my entire life, but I suppose, at eighty-two, the most I can do now is walk along the village plateau.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我終其一生都渴望著冒險，但我想，在我八十二歲時，我頂多只能在村邊的高地晃晃而已吧。

Text: I dreamt of magic and adventure when I was younger. It's a shame this world isn't more exciting.
Text (French): Je rêvais de magie et d'aventure durant ma jeunesse. Dommage que ce monde ne soit pas plus palpitant.
Text (German): Ich habe von Magie und Abenteuern geträumt, als ich jünger war. Es ist eine Schande, dass diese Welt nicht aufregender ist.
Text (Japanese): I dreamt of magic and adventure when I was younger. It's a shame this world isn't more exciting.
Text (Korean): 젊은 시절에는 마법과 모험의 삶을 꿈꿨지. 이 세상이 그렇게까지 흥미진진한 곳은 아니라는 사실이 유감일 뿐이야.
Text (Portuguese): Eu sonhei com mágica e aventura quando era jovem. Uma pena que esse mundo não é mais emocionante.
Text (Russian): В молодости я грезил волшебством и приключениями. Как жаль, что мир стал скучным и тусклым.
Text (Spanish): Soñaba con aventuras y magia cuando era más joven. Es una pena que este mundo no sea tan emocionante.
Text (Thai): I dreamt of magic and adventure when I was younger. It's a shame this world isn't more exciting.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我年輕時曾經幻想充滿劍與魔法的探險時間。遺憾的是這個世界無聊得很。

Text: Ah, what I would give for a boring life...
Text (French): Ce que je donnerais pour une vie ennuyeuse…
Text (German): Ach, was würde ich nicht alles für ein langweiliges Leben geben ...
Text (Japanese): Ah, what I would give for a boring life...
Text (Korean): 아, 내 삶도 저렇게 평온했다면 얼마나 좋을까요...
Text (Portuguese): Ah, o que eu daria por uma vida pacata...
Text (Russian): Эх, сколько бы я отдала за «скучную» жизнь...
Text (Spanish): Ah, cómo desearía tener una vida aburrida...
Text (Thai): Ah, what I would give for a boring life...
Text (Traditional Chinese): 啊啊，我該為無聊的生活做些什麼...

Text: I wear the armor of a Templar, and I walk among the guards, but I am not one of them. My soul is Kitava's to consume.
Text (French): Je revêts l'armure des Templiers et je marche au même pas que les gardes, mais je ne suis pas l'un d'eux. Mon âme se réserve pour l'appétit de Kitava.
Text (German): Ich trage die Rüstung eines Templers und wandle unter den Wachen, aber ich bin keiner von ihnen. Meine Seele gehört Kitavas Hunger.
Text (Japanese): I wear the armor of a Templar, and I walk among the guards, but I am not one of them. My soul is Kitava's to consume.
Text (Korean): 템플러의 갑주를 입고 수호병들의 사이를 걷지만, 나는 저들과는 다르다. 내 영혼은 오로지 키타바께 바칠 것이니.
Text (Portuguese): Eu usava a armadura de um Templário, e eu andava entre os guardas, mas não era um deles. A minha alma pertencia a Kitava.
Text (Russian): Я ношу храмовые доспехи и хожу среди его стражей, но не являюсь одним из них. Мою душу поглотит Китава.
Text (Spanish): Visto la armadura de un Templario, y camino entre los guardias, pero no soy uno de ellos. Mi alma existe para que Kitava la consuma.
Text (Thai): ข้าสวมเสื้อเกราะของเทมพลาร์และข้าเดินเข้าไปในหมู่ทหารยาม แต่ข้าไม่ได้เป็นคนหนึ่งในพวกเขา วิญญาณข้ามีไว้ให้คิทาวากลืนกิน
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我穿著聖堂武僧的盔甲，走在守衛之間，但我並不是他們的一份子。我的靈魂是屬於奇塔弗的。

Text: The time nears. At the appointed hour, I will open the gates... all the gates.
Text (French): Le moment est bientôt arrivé. À l'heure prévue, j'ouvrirai les portes… toutes les portes.
Text (German): Die Zeit rückt näher. Zur vereinbarten Stunde werde ich die Tore öffnen ... sämtliche Tore.
Text (Japanese): The time nears. At the appointed hour, I will open the gates... all the gates.
Text (Korean): 때가 다가오는구나. 약속의 시간이 되면 문을 열어젖힐 것이다... 모든 문을 말이야..
Text (Portuguese): A hora se aproximava. Na hora marcada, eu abriria os portões... Todos os portões.
Text (Russian): Близится моё время. В урочный час я отворю ворота... все ворота.
Text (Spanish): El momento se acerca. En la hora pactada, abriré las puertas… todas las puertas.
Text (Thai): เวลาใกล้เข้ามา เมื่อถึงเวลาข้าจะเปิดประตู... ประตูทั้งหมด
Text (Traditional Chinese): 時機快到了。當時機來臨時，我將打開大門...所有的大門。

Text: Bastard... that bastard! Do you think he knew what he was about to loose upon us? No... I can't believe anyone would knowingly do that.
Text (French): Le salaud… Le salaud ! Pensez-vous qu'il savait ce qu'il s'apprêtait à déchaîner sur nous tous ? Non… Je ne peux croire que quiconque le ferait en toute connaissance de cause.
Text (German): Bastard ... dieser Bastard! Glaubt Ihr, er hatte eine Ahnung davon, was er da auf uns loslassen würde? Nein ... Ich kann einfach nicht glauben, dass jemand das wissentlich tun würde.
Text (Japanese): Bastard... that bastard! Do you think he knew what he was about to loose upon us? No... I can't believe anyone would knowingly do that.
Text (Korean): 저... 멍청한 자식! 저놈은 자기가 우리에게 뭘 풀어놓으려는 건지 알고나 있었을까요? 아뇨... 알면서도 그런 짓을 할 사람은 아무도 없을 거예요.
Text (Portuguese): Maldito... aquele maldito! Você acha que ele sabia o que ele estava prestes a soltar sobre nós? Não... Eu não acredito que alguém faria isso de propósito.
Text (Russian): Скотина... Ну и скотина. Думаешь, он понимал, кого собирается на нас натравить? Нет… Я не верю, что кто-нибудь мог пойти на такое добровольно.
Text (Spanish): Bastardo… ¡ese bastardo! ¿Crees que sabía lo que estaba por desatar sobre todos nosotros? No… no puedo creer que alguien pueda hacer algo así a sabiendas.
Text (Thai): ไอ้... ไอ้นั่น! เจ้าคิดว่าเขารู้หรือไม่ว่าเขาจะปลดปล่อยหายนะอะไรมาให้กับพวกเรา? ไม่... ข้าไม่อยากเชื่อเลยว่าใครจะทำอย่างนั้น
Text (Traditional Chinese): 混帳...那個混帳東西。你想他知道他到底將釋放什麼到這個世界上嗎？不！...我完全不敢相信居然有人會想這麼做。

Text: Centuries of my predecessors line these walls. It is supposedly the ultimate honor to rest with them, but I have my doubts.
Text (French): Des siècles de mes prédécesseurs sont alignés le long de ces murs. Reposer parmi eux représente apparemment l'honneur ultime, mais je nourris quelques doutes à ce propos.
Text (German): Jahrhunderte meiner Vorgänger säumen diese Mauern. Es ist angeblich die größte Ehre, bei ihnen zu ruhen, aber ich hege da so meine Zweifel.
Text (Japanese): Centuries of my predecessors line these walls. It is supposedly the ultimate honor to rest with them, but I have my doubts.
Text (Korean): 수백년에 걸친 전임자들이 이 벽에 줄지어 있다. 저들의 곁에 안치되는 것은 최고의 명예라던데, 정말로 그럴까?
Text (Portuguese): Séculos de meus predecessores estão nessas paredes. Teoricamente é a maior honra descansar junto deles, mas eu tenho minhas dúvidas.
Text (Russian): Моих предков хоронили в этих стенах столетиями. Считается, что упокоиться рядом с ними — высшая честь, но меня точит червячок сомнений.
Text (Spanish): Siglos de predecesores cubren estas paredes. Se supone que es el más grande honor descansar con ellos, pero tengo mis dudas.
Text (Thai): Centuries of my predecessors line these walls. It is supposedly the ultimate honor to rest with them, but I have my doubts.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 幾百年來所有前任者都被掛在這堵牆上。據說與之長眠可以說是至高的榮耀，但我很懷疑。

Text: How would anyone know which bones are mine? How would anyone know that I am even here? Because I recognise none of these remains myself...
Text (French): Qui pourrait savoir lesquels de ces ossements m'appartiennent ? Avec quelle certitude pourrait-on s'assurer que je suis bel et bien ici ? Parce que, personnellement, je ne reconnais aucun de ces restes…
Text (German): Woher sollte jemand wissen, welche Knochen mir gehören? Woher sollte jemand wissen, dass ich überhaupt hier bin? Ich erkenne nämlich selbst nicht, wem diese Überreste gehören ...
Text (Japanese): How would anyone know which bones are mine? How would anyone know that I am even here? Because I recognise none of these remains myself...
Text (Korean): 어느 뼈가 내 것인지 누가 어떻게 안다는 거지? 내가 여기에 있기는 한 건지 누가 어떻게 안다고? 나 역시도 이 유해들을 알아볼 수 없는데...
Text (Portuguese): Como alguém saberia quais ossos são os meus? Como alguém sequer saberia que eu estou aqui? Porque eu mesmo não reconheço nenhum desses restos...
Text (Russian): Как другие поймут, какие из этих костей принадлежат мне? Откуда они вообще узнают, что я там есть? Ведь я не могу опознать ни одного из усопших...
Text (Spanish): ¿Cómo podría alguien saber cuáles son mis huesos? ¿Cómo podría alguien siquiera saber que estoy aquí? Porque yo no reconozco ninguno de estos restos…
Text (Thai): How would anyone know which bones are mine? How would anyone know that I am even here? Because I recognise none of these remains myself...
Text (Traditional Chinese): 誰會知道哪些死人骨頭是我的呢？甚至有沒有人知道我混在裡面都不知道吧？甚至連我自己都不知道哪些遺骸是我的了...

Text: Confronting one's mortality is always troubling, isn't it? I believe Venarius would not be so humble as the owner of this memory.
Text (French): Être confronté à sa propre condition mortelle est toujours troublant, n'est-ce pas ? Je ne crois pas que Vénarius est aussi humble que le possesseur de ce souvenir.
Text (German): Sich seiner Sterblichkeit zu stellen, ist immer beunruhigend, oder etwa nicht? Ich glaube, Venarius wäre nicht so bescheiden wie der Besitzer dieser Erinnerung.
Text (Japanese): Confronting one's mortality is always troubling, isn't it? I believe Venarius would not be so humble as the owner of this memory.
Text (Korean): 죽음과 마주한다는 건 언제나 골치 아픈 일이죠. 베나리우스가 이 기억의 주인처럼 겸손하진 않았을 것 같네요.
Text (Portuguese): Confrontar a própria mortalidade é sempre inquietante, não é? Creio que Venarius não seria tão humilde quanto o dono dessa memória.
Text (Russian): Принять свою смертность всегда нелегко, не так ли? Сомневаюсь, что Венарий пойдёт по стопам хозяина этого воспоминания и смирится с общей долей.
Text (Spanish): Confrontar la propia mortalidad siempre es perturbador, ¿no es así? Creo que Venarius no sería tan humilde como el dueño de esta memoria.
Text (Thai): Confronting one's mortality is always troubling, isn't it? I believe Venarius would not be so humble as the owner of this memory.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 面對死亡總是沒那麼輕鬆，對吧？我相信維那利斯不會像這個記憶的主人那般的謙遜。

Text: I feel very nervous. Am I sweating? I think I'm sweating. I hope she doesn't notice how much I'm sweating. Oh no, she looked at me. She can definitely see how sweaty I am. I should say something. Your face is good?! Why would you say that!?
Text (French): Ce que je suis nerveux… C'est pas de la sueur, ça ? Je pense que je transpire. J'espère qu'elle remarquera pas comment je transpire. Oh non ! Elle m'a regardé. Elle peut carrément voir à quel point je suis trempé. Je devrais dire quelque chose. « T'es jolie du visage » ?! Pourquoi avoir dit une chose pareille ?!
Text (German): Ich bin ausgesprochen nervös. Schwitze ich? Ich denke, ich schwitze. Hoffentlich merkt sie nicht, wie sehr ich schwitze. Oh nein, sie hat mich angesehen. Sie kann definitiv sehen, wie verschwitzt ich bin. Ich sollte etwas sagen. Dein Gesicht ist gut?! Warum sagst du das!?
Text (Japanese): I feel very nervous. Am I sweating? I think I'm sweating. I hope she doesn't notice how much I'm sweating. Oh no, she looked at me. She can definitely see how sweaty I am. I should say something. Your face is good?! Why would you say that!?
Text (Korean): 너무 긴장돼. 나 지금 땀 흘리나? 아, 그런 것 같네. 내가 얼마나 땀을 흘리고 있는지 그녀가 몰랐으면 싶은데. 이런, 나를 보고 있잖아. 분명 내 땀을 알아챌 거야. 무슨 말이라도 해야 해. 당신 정말 예뻐?! 아, 왜 이런 말을 내뱉은 거야!?
Text (Portuguese): Me sentia muito nervoso. Estou suando? Acho que estou suando. Espero que ela não perceba o quanto estou suando. Oh não, ela olhou para mim. Definitivamente ela pode ver o quão suado eu estou. Deveria dizer algo. Você tem um bom rosto?! Por que eu diria isso?!
Text (Russian): Я очень нервничаю. Это что, пот? Кажется, я потею. Хоть бы она не заметила мою потливость. О нет, она смотрит на меня. Наверняка видит, как я вспотел. Мне надо что-то сказать. «Славная мордашка»?! Зачем ты это сказал?!
Text (Spanish): Me siento muy nervioso. ¿Estoy sudando? Creo que estoy sudando. Espero que ella no note cuánto estoy sudando. Oh no, me miró. Sin dudas puede ver cuán sudoroso estoy. Debería decir algo. ¡¿Tienes buena cara?! ¡¿Por qué dirías eso?!
Text (Thai): ข้ารู้สึกประหม่ามาก ข้าเหงื่อออกเหรอ? ข้าคิดว่าข้าเหงื่อออก ข้าหวังว่าเธอจะไม่สังเกตว่าข้ามีเหงื่อออกมากแค่ไหน โอ้ไม่ เธอมองมาที่ข้า เธอสามารถเห็นได้อย่างชัดเจนว่าข้าเหงื่อออกแค่ไหน ข้าควรพูดอะไรบางอย่าง เจ้าหน้าตาดีนะ! ทำไมถึงพูดออกไปแบบนั้น!?
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我真的超緊張的。我緊張到流汗了嗎？噢天啊我感覺我滿身大汗。噢我真希望他沒有注意到我這樣子。噢不，她正在看我。她一定看到我滿身大汗的樣子了。我該說些什麼。你看起來氣色不錯？！我的媽啊你到底說了什麼鬼！？

Text: She laughed at you. Now she's gonna tell all the women in Sarn how stupid and useless you are. You're gonna die alone. Wait... is she-- she's holding your hand! You did it! Your face is good! Classic line. Works every time.
Text (French): Elle s'est moquée de toi. Elle va raconter à toutes les femmes de Sarn à quel point t'es stupide et que tu sers à rien. Tu vas mourir seul. Une minute… Elle serait pas… ? Elle te tient la main ! T'as réussi ! « T'es jolie du visage » ! L'accroche imparable. Ça marche à tous les coups.
Text (German): Sie hat dich ausgelacht. Jetzt wird sie allen Frauen in Sarn erzählen, wie dumm und nutzlos du bist. Du wirst allein sterben. Warte ... hält sie etwa – sie hält deine Hand! Du hast es geschafft! Dein Gesicht ist gut! Ein Klassiker. Funktioniert jedes Mal.
Text (Japanese): She laughed at you. Now she's gonna tell all the women in Sarn how stupid and useless you are. You're gonna die alone. Wait... is she-- she's holding your hand! You did it! Your face is good! Classic line. Works every time.
Text (Korean): 그녀가 나를 비웃었어. 이제 사안에 있는 모든 여자에게 내가 얼마나 멍청하고 쓸모없는지 떠들어댈 거야. 나는 외롭게 혼자 죽게 될 거라고. 잠깐... 그녀가... 내 손을 잡았어! 됐어! '당신 정말 예뻐!'가 먹혔나 봐! 역시 고전적인 방식은 통하는 법이지.
Text (Portuguese): Ela riu de você. Agora ela vai contar pra todas as mulheres de Sarn que você é um estúpido e inútil. Você vai morrer sozinho. Espera... ela tá-- ela tá segurando sua mão! Você conseguiu! Você tem um bom rosto! Clássico. Funciona sempre.
Text (Russian): Она смеется над тобой. Теперь она расскажет всем женщинам в Сарне о том, насколько ты глуп и никчемен. Ты сдохнешь в одиночестве. Хотя... Она что... держит тебя за руку?! У тебя получилось! «Славная мордашка»! Классический подкат. Всегда срабатывает.
Text (Spanish): Se rio de ti. Ahora les dirá a todas las mujeres de Oriath cuán estúpido e inútil eres. Morirás solo. Espera.. ¡ella está… está tomando tu mano! ¡Lo hiciste! ¡Tienes buena cara! Un clásico. Siempre funciona.
Text (Thai): เธอหัวเราะเยาะเจ้า ตอนนี้เธอจะบอกผู้หญิงทุกคนในซาร์นว่าเจ้าโง่และไร้ประโยชน์อย่างไร เจ้าจะตายคนเดียว เดี๋ยวก่อน... เธอ-- เธอกำลังจับมือเจ้า! เจ้าทำสำเร็จ! เจ้าหน้าตาดีนะ! ประโยคเด็ด ใช้งานได้ทุกครั้ง
Text (Traditional Chinese): 啊太好了她在嘲笑你。現在她要告訴全薩恩的女人妳有多蠢多沒用了。完了，你的人生就到此為止了。等等...她...她握住你的手了！你辦到了！你氣色不錯！經典！太經典了！

Text: That was... deeply uncomfortable to witness.
Text (French): Alors ça, c'était… profondément perturbant.
Text (German): Dieses Schauspiel ... konnte nur mit einer großen Portion Unbehagen bestaunt werden.
Text (Japanese): That was... deeply uncomfortable to witness.
Text (Portuguese): Isso foi... profundamente desconfortável de presenciar.
Text (Spanish): Eso fue… realmente incómodo de ver.
Text (Thai): That was... deeply uncomfortable to witness.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 對於見證這種事情實在是...實在是很不舒服。

Text: This is not good. I can't believe I fell asleep. Now I'm in the middle of the bloody ocean without a bloody paddle. Micah, you stupid shite. Why couldn't you just follow the bloody captain's orders?
Text (French): Ça sent pas bon. Je peux pas croire que je me suis endormi. Là, je me retrouve perdu au beau milieu de cette saloperie d'océan sans même une foutue pagaie. Micah, espèce de pauvre tache ! Pourquoi t'as pas suivi les putain d'ordres du capitaine ?
Text (German): Das ist gar nicht gut. Ich kann nicht glauben, dass ich eingeschlafen bin. Jetzt bin ich inmitten dieses verdammten Ozeans ohne ein verdammtes Paddel. Micah, du elendiger Fliegenschiss. Warum konntest du nicht einfach den verdammten Befehlen des Kapitäns befolgen?
Text (Japanese): This is not good. I can't believe I fell asleep. Now I'm in the middle of the bloody ocean without a bloody paddle. Micah, you stupid shite. Why couldn't you just follow the bloody captain's orders?
Text (Korean): 이건 좋지 않아. 내가 왜 잠들었던 거지. 이젠 노도 없이 망망대해 한복판에 있게 됐잖아. 마이카, 이 멍청한 자식. 망할 선장의 명령에 그냥 좀 따르지 그랬냐!
Text (Portuguese): Isso não é bom. Não acredito que peguei no sono. Agora estou no meio da droga do oceano sem uma droga de remo. Micah, seu merda. Por que você não seguiu as ordens da droga do capitão?
Text (Russian): Плохо дело. Не могу поверить, что завалился спать. Теперь я посреди демонова океана без драных руля и ветрил. Мика, тупой говнюк. Чего тебе стоило выполнять клятые приказы капитана?
Text (Spanish): Esto no es bueno. No puedo creer que me quedara dormido. Ahora estoy en medio del maldito océano sin un estúpido remo. Micah, maldito idiota, ¿por qué no pudiste seguir las órdenes de tu maldito capitán?
Text (Thai): This is not good. I can't believe I fell asleep. Now I'm in the middle of the bloody ocean without a bloody paddle. Micah, you stupid shite. Why couldn't you just follow the bloody captain's orders?
Text (Traditional Chinese): 這不太妙。我不敢相信我居然睡著了。現在我在該死的海中央而且我連該死的槳都沒有。米凱，你這蠢貨。為什麼你就是不聽那個該死的船長的命令？

Text: Now you've gone and got yourself killed. Unless... what is that? Is that a ship on the horizon? It looks like Roth's! Long as he doesn't hold a grudge, I'm saved!
Text (French): Et voilà, t'es pas mieux que mort. À moins que… C'est quoi, ça ? C'est pas un navire à l'horizon ? On dirait le vaisseau de Roth ! S'il est pas rancunier, je suis sauvé !
Text (German): Jetzt bist fort und hast dir dein eigenes Grab geschaufelt. Es sei denn ... beim Klabautermann! Ist das ein Schiff am Horizont? Es sieht aus wie Roths! Solange er keinen Groll hegt, bin ich gerettet!
Text (Japanese): Now you've gone and got yourself killed. Unless... what is that? Is that a ship on the horizon? It looks like Roth's! Long as he doesn't hold a grudge, I'm saved!
Text (Korean): 죽을 일만 남았구먼. 뭐, 죽기를 자처한 거나 마찬가지였지. 아니면... 어, 저건 뭐지? 수평선에 저거 배인가? 로스의 배 같은데! 로스 녀석이 나한테 억하심정이 없었으면 좋겠는데, 아무튼 살았다!
Text (Portuguese): Agora você vai acabar se matando. A não ser que... o que é aquilo? Seria um navio no horizonte? Parece o navio de Roth! Se ele não for de guardar rancor, estou salvo!
Text (Russian): А вместо этого ты застрял тут и теперь сдохнешь. Погоди-ка... Это что? Корабль на горизонте? Кажись, это лоханка Рота! Если он не затаил обиду, я спасён!
Text (Spanish): Ahora has logrado terminar muerto. A menos que… ¿qué es eso? ¿Es un barco en el horizonte? ¡Parece ser el de Roth! Mientras no guarde rencor, ¡estoy salvado!
Text (Thai): Now you've gone and got yourself killed. Unless... what is that? Is that a ship on the horizon? It looks like Roth's! Long as he doesn't hold a grudge, I'm saved!
Text (Traditional Chinese): 現在你死定了，而且還是被自己害死的。除非...那是啥？那是艘船嗎？看起來像是羅斯的船！只要他別找碴我就得救了！

Text: Roth? Could it be-- no, that is simply too much of a coincidence. Still, I can't help but wonder...
Text (French): Roth… ? Ce ne serait pas… ? Non, la coïncidence serait trop extraordinaire… Pourtant, je ne peux m'empêcher de me poser la question…
Text (German): Roth ... Kann das sein – Nein, das ist einfach ein zu großer Zufall ... Dennoch kann ich nicht anders, als mir verwundert die Augen zu reiben ...
Text (Japanese): Roth? Could it be-- no, that is simply too much of a coincidence. Still, I can't help but wonder...
Text (Korean): 로스라고요? 그럼 혹시... 아뇨, 그건 너무 지나친 우연이네요. 그래도 의심이 드는 건 어쩔 수 없지만...
Text (Portuguese): Roth? Será que-- Não, é coincidência demais... Ainda assim, será que...
Text (Russian): Рот... Неужели это?.. Не-ет, слишком натянутое совпадение. И всё же меня не оставляет мысль...
Text (Spanish): ¿Roth? ¿Será…? No, sería demasiada coincidencia. Y sin embargo no dejo de preguntarme…
Text (Thai): รอธ? เป็นไปได้ไหม-- ไม่ใช่ นั่นเป็นเรื่องบังเอิญมากเกินไป ถึงกระนั้นฉันอดไม่ได้ที่จะสงสัย...
Text (Traditional Chinese): 羅斯...那會是...不，這實在是太過於巧合了...不過，我還是忍不住懷疑...

Text: Indexing artefact one-twelve in lot ten, an ancient jawbone. Carvings on the side attribute it to... Valako? This can't actually be the jawbone from the myth... and this... Tukohama's tooth? Hinekora's hair?
Text (French): Indexation de l'artefact vingt et un dans le lot dix. Une mandibule ancienne. Des inscriptions sur le côté indiquent qu'elle aurait appartenu à… Valako ? Ça ne peut quand même pas être l'os dont parle le mythe… Et ça… ? La dent de Tukohama ? Les cheveux d'Hinekora ?
Text (German): Indexierung von Artefakt eins-zwölf auf Platz zehn, ein alter Kieferknochen. Lässt es sich mit den Schnitzereien auf der Seite ... Valako zuordnen? Das kann unmöglich der Kieferknochen aus dem Mythos sein ... und das ... und das ... Tukohamas Zahn? Hinekoras Haar?
Text (Japanese): Indexing artefact one-twelve in lot ten, an ancient jawbone. Carvings on the side attribute it to... Valako? This can't actually be the jawbone from the myth... and this... Tukohama's tooth? Hinekora's hair?
Text (Korean): 10번 구역의 1-12 유물 색인을 정리하고 있다. 고대의 턱뼈다. 바깥쪽에 새겨진 건... 발라코인가? 설마 진짜 신화 속의 그 턱뼈일 리가... 그리고 이건... 투코하마의 이빨인가? 히네코라의 머리카락?
Text (Portuguese): Arquivando artefato um-doze no lote dez, um antigo maxilar. Escrituras na lateral atribuem a... Valako? Esse não pode ser o mesmo maxilar da mitologia... e esse... dente de Tukohama? Cabelo de Hinekora?
Text (Russian): Каталогизирую древнюю челюсть — артефакт один-двенадцать из десятой партии. Отметины на боку позволяют отнести её к... Валако? Эта челюсть не могла пожаловать сюда прямиком из мифа... А это... зуб Тукохамы? Волос Хинекоры?
Text (Spanish): Indexando artefacto uno-doce del lote diez, una mandíbula antigua. Los grabados a los lados la atribuyen a... ¿Valako? No es posible que sea la mandíbula del mito... y esto... ¿el diente de Tukohama? ¿Cabello de Hinekora?
Text (Thai): จัดทำดัชนีสิ่งประดิษฐ์หนึงถึงสิบสองในล็อตที่สิบ ขากรรไกรโบราณ การแกะสลักที่ด้านข้างระบุว่าเป็นของ... วาลาโค? นี่ไม่น่าจะเป็นกระดูกขากรรไกรในตำนานนะ... ส่วนนี่... ฟันของทูโคฮาม่า? ผมของฮิเนโคราเหรอ?
Text (Traditional Chinese): 索引工藝品編號 1-12-10，一個古老的顎骨。側面的雕刻顯示這屬於...瓦拉庫？這應該不會真的是那個傳說中的瓦拉庫之顎吧...還有這個...圖克哈瑪之牙？悉妮蔻拉之髮？

Text: These were in the archives for centuries. Are these what those thieves were after? Who would want these relics, except for followers of Kitava? But that's absurd... best not to mention the robbery attempt.
Text (French): Tous ces artefacts se trouvaient dans les archives depuis des siècles. Était-ce cela que les voleurs recherchaient ? Qui voudrait de ces reliques mis à part… des adorateurs de Kitava ? Mais non, c'est absurde… Il vaut mieux ne pas faire mention de cette tentative de vol.
Text (German): Diese befanden sich Jahrhunderte in den Archiven. Sind das die Relikte, hinter denen diese Diebe her waren? Wer würde diese Relikte schon haben wollen, außer den Anhängern Kitavas? Aber das ist doch lächerlich ... am besten verschweigen wir den versuchten Raubüberfall.
Text (Japanese): These were in the archives for centuries. Are these what those thieves were after? Who would want these relics, except for followers of Kitava? But that's absurd... best not to mention the robbery attempt.
Text (Korean): 몇백년 동안 이런 것들이 기록 보관소 안에 있었다니. 그 도둑들이 찾던 게 이거였나? 이런 유물을 도대체 누가 구한다고? 설마 키타바의 추종자들이었나? 말도 안 돼... 지난번에 탈취될 뻔했던 일은 그냥 숨기는 게 좋겠어.
Text (Portuguese): Estes estavam nos arquivos por séculos. São esses o que aqueles ladrões estavam procurando? Quem iria querer essas relíquias, além dos seguidores de Kitava? Mas isso é impossível... melhor não mencionar a tentativa de roubo.
Text (Russian): Они лежали в архивах столетиями. Не за ними ли приходили воры? Но кому нужны подобные реликвии? Разве что... почитателям Китавы? Но это абсурд. Лучше не докладывать об этой попытке ограбления.
Text (Spanish): Estuvieron en los archivos durante siglos. ¿Esto es lo que buscaban esos ladrones? ¿Quién querría esas reliquias además de los... seguidores de Kitava? Pero eso es absurdo... será mejor no mencionar el intento de robo.
Text (Thai): สิ่งเหล่านี้อยู่ในหอจดหมายเหตุมานานหลายศตวรรษ สิ่งเหล่านี้เป็นหัวขโมยต้องการเหรอ? ใครจะต้องการวัตถุโบราณเหล่านี้ยกเว้น... ผู้ติดตามของคิทาวา? แต่นั่นเป็นเรื่องไร้สาระ... อย่าพูดถึงความพยายามในการปล้นแล้วกัน
Text (Traditional Chinese): 好幾個世紀以來這些都存放在檔案室之中。這些會是那些小偷的目標嗎？除了奇塔弗的追隨者以外...誰會想要這些古文物？但這太荒謬了...最好不要引起偷仔的注意。

Text: Exile, I think a historian somewhere made a grave mistake by keeping quiet.
Text (French): <if:MS>{Exilé, je crois qu'un historien quelque part a commis une grave erreur en se taisant.}<elif:FS>{Exilée, je crois qu'un historien quelque part a commis une grave erreur en se taisant.}
Text (German): <if:MS>{Verbannter, ich denke, dass ein Historiker irgendwo einen schweren Fehler begannen hat, indem er geschwiegen hat.}<elif:FS>{Verbannte, ich denke, dass ein Historiker irgendwo einen schweren Fehler begannen hat, indem er geschwiegen hat.}
Text (Japanese): Exile, I think a historian somewhere made a grave mistake by keeping quiet.
Text (Korean): 유배자여, 내 생각엔 어딘가의 역사학자 하나가 침묵을 지킨다는 중대한 실수를 저질렀던 것 같군.
Text (Portuguese): <if:MS>{Exilado, acho que um historiador em algum lugar cometeu um erro grave ao acobertar isso.}<elif:FS>{Exilada, acho que um historiador em algum lugar cometeu um erro grave ao acobertar isso.}
Text (Russian): <if:MS>{Изгнанник, по мне так своим молчанием историк едва не свёл всех в могилу.}<elif:FS>{Изгнанница, по мне так своим молчанием историк едва не свёл всех в могилу.}
Text (Spanish): <if:MS>{Exiliado, creo que cierto historiador en alguna parte cometió un grave error al quedarse callado.}<elif:FS>{Exiliada, creo que cierto historiador en alguna parte cometió un grave error al quedarse callado.}
Text (Thai): เอ็กไซล์ ข้าคิดว่านักประวัติศาสตร์คนหนึ่งทำผิดมหันต์ที่เงียบไว้
Text (Traditional Chinese): 流亡者，我認為那些史學家保持沉默是個嚴重的錯誤...

Text: I'm a fool to have gotten lost here, but it was getting dark, and I thought I saw a way home. A crowd stands silently around me, their faces blank white, their bodies covered in webs.
Text (French): Me perdre en ces lieux fut stupide de ma part, mais la nuit tombait et je pensais avoir trouvé un raccourci pour rentrer chez moi. Une foule silencieuse m'entoure, le visage livide et le corps recouvert de toiles d'araignées.
Text (German): Ich bin ein Narr, dass ich mich hier verlaufen habe, aber es wurde dunkel, und ich dachte, ich sehe einen Weg nach Hause. Eine Menschenmenge steht still um mich herum, ihre Gesichter sind fahl, ihre Körper von Netzen bedeckt.
Text (Japanese): I'm a fool to have gotten lost here, but it was getting dark, and I thought I saw a way home. A crowd stands silently around me, their faces blank white, their bodies covered in webs.
Text (Korean): 나도 참 멍청하지, 이런 곳에서 길을 잃다니... 그나마 어두워지는 와중에 집으로 가는 길을 찾아낸 것 같았다. 사람들이 내 주변에 조용히 서 있었는데, 무표정하고 창백한 얼굴에다 몸은 거미줄에 감겨 있었다.
Text (Portuguese): Me senti um tolo por ter me perdido aqui, mas estava ficando escuro, e pensei ter visto um caminho para casa. Uma multidão se prostava em silêncio ao meu redor. Seus rostos brancos e lisos, seus corpos cobertos por teias.
Text (Russian): Как же глупо было тут заплутать, но уже темнело, а я вроде бы видела идущую к дому тропинку. Сейчас меня окружает безмолвная толпа. Лица людей закрыты белым, а тела закутаны в паутину.
Text (Spanish): Soy un tonto por haberme perdido aquí, pero estaba oscureciendo, y creí ver una forma de llegar a casa. Me rodea una multitud silenciosa, de caras pálidas e inexpresivas, y todos están cubiertos de telarañas.
Text (Thai): ข้าโง่นักที่หลงทางที่นี่ แต่มันมืดลงและข้าคิดว่าข้าเห็นทางกลับบ้าน ฝูงชนยืนอยู่เงียบๆ รอบตัวข้า ใบหน้าของพวกเขาขาวซีด ร่างกายของพวกเขาปกคลุมด้วยใย
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我一定是個蠢蛋才會在這裡迷路，天色漸漸變暗，我以為我找到了回家的路。一群人安靜的站在我身旁，他們臉色慘白，身上則覆滿著蜘蛛網。

Text: The crowd begins to shiver and shake as I creep between their bound hands. Some moan for help. Others scream as their bodies bubble, and I realise I cannot help them. Tiny spiders pour out of open wounds.
Text (French): Ils se mettent à frémir et à trembler tandis que je me fraye un chemin en silence parmi leurs mains entravées. Certains appellent à l'aide en gémissant ; d'autres commencent à hurler. Lorsque je vois leurs corps se prendre de convulsions, je comprends que je ne pourrai pas les secourir. De minuscules araignées se déversent de leurs plaies.
Text (German): Die Menschenmenge beginnt zu schaudern und zu zittern, als ich zwischen ihren gefesselten Händen krieche. Einige flehen um Hilfe. Andere schreien. Während ihre Körper Blasen bilden, merke ich, dass ich ihnen nicht helfen kann. Aus den offenen Wunden kriechen winzige Spinnen.
Text (Japanese): The crowd begins to shiver and shake as I creep between their bound hands. Some moan for help. Others scream as their bodies bubble, and I realise I cannot help them. Tiny spiders pour out of open wounds.
Text (Korean): 이들의 묶인 손들 사이로 살금살금 나아가는 동안, 사람들이 몸을 떨며 마구 뒤틀어대기 시작했다. 도와달라 외치며 흐느끼는 이들도, 비명을 지르는 이들도 있었다. 이윽고 그들의 몸이 부풀어 오르는 것을 봤을 때 이는 내가 도울 수 있는 일이 아니라는 사실을 깨달았다. 그렇게 벌어진 상처들에서는 작은 거미들이 쏟아져 나오고 있었다.
Text (Portuguese): A multidão começou a tremer e se sacudir enquanto eu rastejava entre suas mãos atadas. Alguns gemiam pedindo ajuda. Outros gritavam. Ao ver seus corpos borbulharem, percebi que não podia ajudá-los. Pequenas aranhas saíam das feridas abertas.
Text (Russian): Я пытаюсь протиснуться меж примотанных к телам рук, и тут люди начинают дрожать и ёрзать. Кто-то вопиет о помощи. Другие просто кричат. Когда их тела начинают бугриться, я понимаю, что не в силах им помочь. Из отверстых ран выползают крохотные паучки.
Text (Spanish): La multitud comienza a temblar y agitarse a medida que me abro paso entre sus manos unidas. Algunos piden auxilio entre gemidos. Otros gritan. Cuando sus cuerpos se hinchan, me doy cuenta de que no puedo ayudarlos. Unas pequeñas arañas comienzan a brotar de sus heridas abiertas.
Text (Thai): ฝูงชนเริ่มสั่นและสั่นเมื่อข้าคลานระหว่างมือที่ถูกมัด บางคนคร่ำครวญขอความช่วยเหลือ คนอื่นกรีดร้อง เมื่อร่างกายพองบวม ข้ารู้ว่าข้าไม่สามารถช่วยพวกเขาได้ แมงมุมตัวเล็กๆ ไหลออกมาจากแผล
Text (Traditional Chinese): 當我爬過那群人身旁時，那群人開始發抖並試著揮動他們的雙手。有些人呻吟求助。有些人則開始尖叫。當我看見他們身上的泡泡時，我意識到我完全沒辦法幫助他們。小隻的蜘蛛不斷地從他們身上的傷口中爬出來。

Text: Eugh, no! I can still feel them crawling on me!
Text (French): Pouah ! Je les sens encore me grimper partout sur le corps !
Text (German): Ugh, nein! Ich kann immer noch spüren, wie sie auf mir krabbeln!
Text (Japanese): Eugh, no! I can still feel them crawling on me!
Text (Korean): 윽, 안 돼! 아직도 거미들이 내 몸을 기어 다니는 기분이군!
Text (Portuguese): Eca, não! Ainda posso senti-las rastejando em mim!
Text (Russian): О, нет! Хватит! Я до сих пор чувствую их лапки!
Text (Spanish): ¡Oh, no! ¡Todavía puedo sentir cómo trepan por mi cuerpo!
Text (Thai): Eugh, no! I can still feel them crawling on me!
Text (Traditional Chinese): 噢，不要！我現在還能感覺到牠們在我身上爬！！

Text: Sometimes, we in the Brotherhood don't need to harm anyone at all. We surround Drusus in the Baths. He has a family, and that means he is vulnerable.
Text (French): Dans la Confrérie, il arrive que l'usage de la force ne soit même pas nécessaire. Nous acculons Drusus dans les Bains. Il a une famille, ce qui signifie donc qu'il est vulnérable.
Text (German): Manchmal ist es nicht notwendig, dass wir, die Bruderschaft, jemandem ein Haar krümmen. Wir umzingeln Drusus in den Bädern. Er hat eine Familie, und das bedeutet, dass er verwundbar ist.
Text (Japanese): Sometimes, we in the Brotherhood don't need to harm anyone at all. We surround Drusus in the Baths. He has a family, and that means he is vulnerable.
Text (Korean): 형제단의 일을 하다 보면 굳이 직접 해칠 필요가 없을 때가 있다. 그래, 우린 욕탕 안에서 드루수스를 둘러쌌다. 그에겐 가족이 있거든. 이 말인즉슨, 그에게 약점이 있다는 것이다.
Text (Portuguese): Às vezes, nós da Irmandade não precisamos machucar ninguém. Nós cercamos Drusus nas Banheiras. Ele tem família, o que significa que ele é vulnerável.
Text (Russian): Порой нашему братству даже не требуется причинять вред. Мы окружили Друса в термах. У него есть семья, а это серьёзная уязвимость.
Text (Spanish): A veces, nosotros en la Hermandad no necesitamos lastimar a nadie. Rodeamos a Drusus en los Baños. Tiene familia, y eso significa que es vulnerable.
Text (Thai): บางครั้งเราในกลุ่มภราดรภาพไม่จำเป็นต้องทำร้ายใครเลย เราล้อมรอบดรูซัสในห้องอาบน้ำ เขามีครอบครัวและนั่นหมายความว่าเขามีจุดอ่อน
Text (Traditional Chinese): 有時候，我們兄弟會一幫人根本不需要傷害任何人。我們在浴場裡圍著德魯蘇斯。他有家室，而那成為他的弱點。

Text: He doesn't even protest. He knows what this is. Wordlessly, he backs into the baths and sinks to the bottom. All that remains are the bubbles of his last breath.
Text (French): Il ne proteste même pas. Il sait de quoi il en retourne. Sans un mot, il recule dans un bain et s'immerge complètement. Tout ce qui reste, ce sont les bulles de son dernier souffle.
Text (German): Er wehrt sich nicht einmal. Er weiß, was ihn erwartet. Wortlos geht er zurück in die Bäder und taucht in das Wasser ein. Alles, was bleibt, sind die aufsteigenden Blasen seines letzten Atemzugs.
Text (Japanese): He doesn't even protest. He knows what this is. Wordlessly, he backs into the baths and sinks to the bottom. All that remains are the bubbles of his last breath.
Text (Korean): 드루수스는 저항조차 하지 않았다. 그는 이 상황의 의미를 알고 있다. 한마디 말도 없이, 그는 욕탕 속으로 돌아와 스스로 물속에 잠겼다. 그가 마지막으로 내뱉은 공기 방울들만이 위로 떠올랐다.
Text (Portuguese): Ele nem protestou. Ele sabia o que era. Sem dizer uma palavra, ele voltou para a banheira e afundou. Tudo que restou foram as bolhas de seu último suspiro.
Text (Russian): Он даже не перечит. Знает, что его ждёт. Без лишних слов он спускается в бассейн и погружается до самого дна. На поверхность всплывают только пузырьки его последнего выдоха.
Text (Spanish): Ni siquiera protesta. Sabe lo que pasa. En silencio, se retrae hacia los baños y se hunde hasta el fondo. Todo lo que queda son las burbujas de su último aliento.
Text (Thai): เขาไม่แม้แต่จะประท้วง เขารู้ว่านี่คืออะไร พูดไม่ออกเขากลับไปที่ห้องอาบน้ำและจมลงสู่ก้นบึ้ง สิ่งที่เหลืออยู่คือฟองอากาศจากลมหายใจสุดท้ายของเขา
Text (Traditional Chinese): 他並沒有反抗。他知道這代表什麼。他安靜的回到浴池中並自己沉進池底。池子中只剩下他最後一口氣所形成的氣泡。

Text: I find myself less perturbed by that memory than I should be. It was almost... peaceful. What does that say about me?
Text (French): Je me sens moins bouleversé par ce souvenir que je devrais l'être. C'était presque… paisible. Qu'est-ce que cela dit sur ma personnalité ?
Text (German): Ich bin über diese Erinnerung weniger verstört, als ich es sein sollte. Es war fast schon ... friedlich. Was sagt das über mich aus?
Text (Japanese): I find myself less perturbed by that memory than I should be. It was almost... peaceful. What does that say about me?
Text (Korean): 저 기억에 내 마음이 생각보다 동요하지 않는군. 거의... 평온할 정도야. 난 도대체 뭐였던 거지?
Text (Portuguese): Me sinto menos perturbado por essa memória do que deveria. Foi quase... pacífico. O que isso diz ao meu respeito?
Text (Russian): Почему-то я не слишком потрясён этим воспоминанием. Оно почти что... мирное. Почему я так его воспринимаю?
Text (Spanish): Siento que esa memoria me perturba menos de lo que debería. Era casi… pacífica. ¿Qué dice eso sobre mí?
Text (Thai): I find myself less perturbed by that memory than I should be. It was almost... peaceful. What does that say about me?
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我發現我對這個記憶的厭惡程度並沒有想像中的高。我的心情幾乎...很平靜。我怎麼了？

Text: The boats are the only way out of the city! Don't you understand? The sky is burning! We have to go!
Text (French): Les bateaux sont le seul moyen de sortir de la cité ! Vous ne comprenez donc pas ? Le ciel est en feu ! Nous devons partir !
Text (German): Die Boote sind der einzige Weg aus der Stadt! Verstehst du nicht? Der Himmel brennt! Wir müssen los!
Text (Japanese): The boats are the only way out of the city! Don't you understand? The sky is burning! We have to go!
Text (Korean): 도시를 빠져나갈 방법은 배편밖에 없어! 아직 모르겠어? 하늘이 불타고 있다고! 도망쳐야 해!
Text (Portuguese): Os barcos são o único jeito de sair sa cidade! Você não entendeu? O céu está em chamas! Temos que ir!
Text (Russian): Мы можем выбраться из города только на лодках! Ты что, не видишь? Небо в огне! Мы должны плыть!
Text (Spanish): ¡Los botes son la única forma de abandonar la ciudad! ¿No lo entiendes? ¡El cielo está en llamas! ¡Debemos irnos!
Text (Thai): เรือเป็นทางออกเดียวของเมือง! เจ้าไม่เข้าใจเหรอ ท้องฟ้ากำลังลุกไหม้! เราต้องไปแล้ว!
Text (Traditional Chinese): 船是唯一離開這城市的方法！你不懂嗎？天空在燃燒！我們必須走！

Text: Everyone had the same idea. The crowded boats aren't moving at all. The others scream and wail. Everything begins to burn. I hold my son under the water and pray his death is quicker than mine.
Text (French): Tout le monde a eu la même idée ; les bateaux surpeuplés ne bougent pas d'un iota. Les gens hurlent et gémissent. Tout se met à brûler. Je plonge mon fils dans l'eau en priant pour que sa mort soit plus rapide que la mienne.
Text (German): Alle hatten die gleiche Idee. Die überfüllten Boote bewegen sich überhaupt nicht. Die anderen schreien und jammern. Alles beginnt zu brennen. Ich drücke meinen Sohn unter Wasser und bete, dass sein Tod schneller ist als meiner.
Text (Japanese): Everyone had the same idea. The crowded boats aren't moving at all. The others scream and wail. Everything begins to burn. I hold my son under the water and pray his death is quicker than mine.
Text (Korean): 모두가 같은 생각을 떠올리고 있었다. 만선이 된 배는 한 치도 움직이지 않았다. 사람들은 비명을 지르며 흐느낄 뿐이었다. 모든 것이 불타기 시작했다. 나는 물속에서 아들을 꼭 끌어안은 채 아들의 고통이 나보다 먼저 끝나기만을 기도하고 있었다.
Text (Portuguese): Todos tiveram a mesma ideia. Os barcos lotados não se moviam. Os outros gritavam e choravam. Tudo começou a queimar. Segurei meu filho embaixo d'água e rezei para que a morte dele fosse mais rápida que a minha.
Text (Russian): Так же думают все вокруг. Лодки забиты людьми и не могут сдвинуться с места. Люди на берегах орут и воют. Вокруг разгораются пожары. Я пихаю сына под воду, держу его и молюсь, чтобы сын умер быстрее меня.
Text (Spanish): Todos tuvieron la misma idea. Los botes repletos no se están moviendo. Los demás gritan y aúllan. Todo comienza a arder. Sostengo a mi hijo bajo el agua y ruego que su muerte sea más rápida que la mía.
Text (Thai): ทุกคนมีความคิดเดียวกัน เรือที่แออัดไม่ขยับเลย คนอื่นๆ กรีดร้องและคร่ำครวญ ทุกอย่างเริ่มไหม้ ข้ากดลูกชายของฉันไว้ใต้น้ำและภาวนาเขาจะได้ตายเร็วกว่าข้า
Text (Traditional Chinese): 每個人都想著一樣的事情。船上擠滿了人根本沒辦法航行。其他人開始尖叫並哀嚎。所有的東西都燒起來了。我把我兒子壓入水中並祈禱他起碼能死的比我還輕鬆。

Text: Such suffering and loss in this world... sometimes I wonder if I'm better off not remembering.
Text (French): Tant de souffrances et de pertes accablent ce monde… Parfois, je me demande s'il serait préférable que je continue à ne me souvenir de rien.
Text (German): Welch Leid und Verlust in dieser Welt ... manchmal frage ich mich, ob ich nicht besser dran wäre, mich nicht zu erinnern ...
Text (Japanese): Such suffering and loss in this world... sometimes I wonder if I'm better off not remembering.
Text (Korean): 이러한 고통과 상실이 넘치는 세상이라니... 가끔은 그냥 기억을 되찾지 않는 편이 더 좋은 게 아닐까 싶을 때도 있어.
Text (Portuguese): Tanto sofrimento e perda nesse mundo... Às vezes acho que não lembrar é melhor.
Text (Russian): Сколько страданий и потерь в этом мире... Порой мне вовсе не хочется вспоминать былое.
Text (Spanish): Hay tanto sufrimiento y pérdida en este mundo… a veces me pregunto si no estoy mejor así sin recordar.
Text (Thai): ความทุกข์ทรมานและการสูญเสียเช่นนี้ในโลกนี้... บางทีข้าก็สงสัยว่าข้าจำไม่ได้จะดีกว่าไหม
Text (Traditional Chinese): 這世界充滿了痛苦與折磨...有時候我覺得最好不要記起那些事情...

Text: We pack up our camp just before sunrise and journey towards the capital, Azala Vaal. We hear the crowd before we see them. Word of our victory spread quickly, and even the Queen has come to meet us.
Text (French): Nous levons le camp avant l'aube et poursuivons notre route en direction d'Azala Vaal, la capitale. Nous entendons la foule avant de l'apercevoir. La rumeur de notre victoire se répand rapidement ; même la Reine vient à notre rencontre.
Text (German): Wir packen unser Lager kurz vor Sonnenaufgang und reisen in Richtung der Hauptstadt Azala Vaal. Wir hören die Menge, bevor wir sie sehen. Die Nachricht von unserem Sieg verbreitete sich schnell, und selbst die Königin ist gekommen, um uns zu treffen.
Text (Japanese): We pack up our camp just before sunrise and journey towards the capital, Azala Vaal. We hear the crowd before we see them. Word of our victory spread quickly, and even the Queen has come to meet us.
Text (Korean): 우리는 해가 뜨기 직전에 야영지를 거두고 수도 아잘라 바알로 여정을 재개했다. 사람들이 보이기도 전에 군중들이 몰려오는 소리부터 들려왔다. 승전 소식은 빠르게 퍼져나갔고, 여왕께서도 우리를 직접 만나러 나오셨다.
Text (Portuguese): Recolhemos o acampamento logo antes do sol nascer e fomos em direção a capital, Azala Vaal. Escutamos a multidão antes de vê-los. A fama de nossa vitória se espalhou rapidamente, e até mesmo a Rainha veio nos conhecer.
Text (Russian): Незадолго до рассвета мы свернули лагерь и направились к столице — Азале Ваал. Мы услышали рёв толпы раньше, чем увидели людей. Весть о нашей победе быстро разлетелась по городу. Сама царица вышла, чтобы поприветствовать нас.
Text (Spanish): Levantamos nuestro campamento justo antes del amanecer y viajamos hacia la capital, Azala Vaal. Oímos a la multitud antes de verla. La historia de nuestra victoria se propagó rápido, y hasta la Reina vino a recibirnos.
Text (Thai): เราบรรจุค่ายของเราก่อนพระอาทิตย์ขึ้นและเดินทางไปยังเมืองหลวงอาซาลาวาล์ เราได้ยินเสียงฝูงชนก่อนที่จะเห็นพวกเขา คำพูดของชัยชนะของเราแพร่กระจายอย่างรวดเร็ว และแม้แต่ราชินีก็มาพบเรา
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我們在日出之前收拾好營地並起程前往首都，阿札拉瓦爾。在我們看見人群之前我們就先聽到他們的吵雜聲了。關於我勝利的消息相傳的很快，甚至連女王都來迎接我們。

Text: My family has come to watch the ceremony. As I lay on the stone altar, I hear them chanting my name. It is the last thing I hear before the Queen's dagger is plunged into my chest.
Text (French): Ma famille est venue assister à la cérémonie. Tous scandent mon nom tandis que je m'allonge sur l'autel de pierre. C'est la dernière chose que j'entends avant que la dague de la Reine plonge dans ma poitrine.
Text (German): Meine Familie ist gekommen, um der Zeremonie beizuwohnen. Als ich auf dem Steinaltar liege, höre ich sie meinen Namen rufen. Es ist das Letzte, was ich höre, bevor der Dolch der Königin in meiner Brust versenkt wird.
Text (Japanese): My family has come to watch the ceremony. As I lay on the stone altar, I hear them chanting my name. It is the last thing I hear before the Queen's dagger is plunged into my chest.
Text (Korean): 가족들이 의식을 보러 왔다. 돌 제단 위에 눕자, 사람들이 내 이름을 연호하는 소리가 들린다. 여왕님의 단검이 내 가슴에 박히는 소리가 마지막으로 들려왔다.
Text (Portuguese): Minha família veio assistir a cerimônia. Quando me deitei no altar de pedra, eu os ouvi cantar meu nome. Foi a última coisa que ouvi antes da adaga da Rainha ser fincada no meu peito.
Text (Russian): На церемонию пришла и моя семья. Я лежу на каменном алтаре и слышу, как люди скандируют моё имя. Потом царица взрезает ножом мою грудь, и больше я ничего не слышу.
Text (Spanish): Mi familia ha venido a ver la ceremonia. Mientras me encuentro acostado en el altar de piedra, los escucho entonar mi nombre. Es lo último que escucho antes de que la daga de la Reina atraviese mi pecho.
Text (Thai): ครอบครัวของฉันได้มาดูพิธี ขณะที่ข้านอนบนแท่นหิน ข้าได้ยินพวกเขาสวดมนต์ชื่อของฉัน มันเป็นสิ่งสุดท้ายที่ข้าได้ยินก่อนที่กริชของราชินีจะทิ่มเข้าใส่หน้าอกของฉัน
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我的家人都來觀看儀式了。當我躺在石壇上時，我聽見他們念誦著我的名字。那是在女王的匕首刺近我的胸膛之前，我最後聽到的一件事情。

Text: I could almost feel the blade. What a chilling moment from a terrible time in history. Far older than I, I'm afraid.
Text (French): J'ai presque pu sentir la lame. Quel instant effrayant, issu d'une époque terrible de l'Histoire ! Une époque bien trop lointaine pour être la mienne, j'en ai bien peur.
Text (German): Ich konnte die Klinge beinahe spüren. Was für ein eisiger Moment aus einer schrecklichen Zeit in der Geschichte. Viel älter als ich, fürchte ich.
Text (Japanese): I could almost feel the blade. What a chilling moment from a terrible time in history. Far older than I, I'm afraid.
Text (Korean): 거의 칼날이 느껴질 지경이로군. 역사에서도 끔찍하기로 이름 높은 시대의 오싹한 순간이었어. 내가 태어나기도 훨씬 더 오래전의 기억 같은데.
Text (Portuguese): Quase pude sentir a lâmina. Um momento assustador de uma época terrível na História. Creio que muito mais velho que eu.
Text (Russian): Я почти почувствовал нож. От этого пугающего прошлого меня бросает в дрожь. Боюсь, это воспоминание куда старше меня.
Text (Spanish): Casi pude sentir la hoja. Fue un momento muy escalofriante de un tiempo terrible de la historia. Mucho más antiguo que yo, lamento decir.
Text (Thai): ข้าเกือบสัมผัสได้ถึงใบมีดนั่น ช่างเป็นช่วงเวลาที่หนาวเหน็บจากยุคที่เลวร้ายในประวัติศาสตร์ ข้าเกรงว่ามันเก่าแก่กว่าข้ามาก
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我感覺我也被那把刀刺穿了。真是個令人不寒而慄的瞬間，這大概是遠在我出生之前的某個歷史上的恐怖時代。

Text: These shiny baubles we pull out of the rock are worth more than their weight in gold, yet we hardly get paid at all! We should stop work and demand our fair share.
Text (French): Ces babioles reluisantes qu'on extrait de la roche valent plus que leur poids en or, et pourtant on est à peine payés ! On devrait arrêter de bosser pour exiger une part équitable.
Text (German): Diese glänzenden Kugeln, die wir aus dem Gestein holen, sind wertvoller als Gold, und doch werden wir kaum entlohnt! Wir sollten die Arbeit einstellen und unseren gerechten Anteil einfordern.
Text (Japanese): These shiny baubles we pull out of the rock are worth more than their weight in gold, yet we hardly get paid at all! We should stop work and demand our fair share.
Text (Korean): 우리가 바위에서 뽑아낸 이 반짝이는 보석들을 보십쇼. 같은 무게의 금보다도 비싼 것들입니다. 하지만 우리는 제대로 된 임금조차 받지 못하고 있습니다! 우리 모두 일을 멈추고 공평한 분배를 요구해야 합니다.
Text (Portuguese): Essas bugigangas brilhantes que tiramos da rocha valem mais do que o peso deles em ouro, mas não pagam nada pra gente! Deveríamos parar de trabalhar e exigir a nossa parte.
Text (Russian): Мы вынимаем из жилы блестящие голыши, каждый из которых на вес дороже золота. И ведь нам за них вряд ли заплатят! Надо прекратить работу и потребовать справедливую долю.
Text (Spanish): Estas baratijas brillantes que sacamos de la roca valen más que su peso en oro, ¡y casi ni nos pagan! Deberíamos dejar de trabajar y exigir nuestra parte.
Text (Thai): ต่างหูที่เปล่งประกายเหล่านี้ที่เราดึงออกมาจากหินนั้นมีค่ามากกว่าน้ำหนักของพวกมันในทองคำ แต่เราแทบจะไม่ได้รับเงินเลย! เราควรหยุดทำงานและเรียกร้องส่วนแบ่งที่ยุติธรรมของเรา
Text (Traditional Chinese): 這些從岩石中取出來的閃亮小玩意兒可是比等重黃金還值錢，但我們幾乎拿不到應得的報酬！我們應該罷工來爭取合理的待遇！

Text: Don't worry! They're just sealing the entrance as a way to intimidate us! They wouldn't dare leave a thousand men down here to die.
Text (French): Vous en faites pas ! Ils bloquent l'entrée pour nous intimider ! Jamais ils oseraient laisser crever un millier d'hommes là-dessous !
Text (German): Keine Sorge! Sie verschließen den Eingang nur, um uns einzuschüchtern! Sie würden es nicht wagen, tausend Männer hier unten verrotten zu lassen.
Text (Japanese): Don't worry! They're just sealing the entrance as a way to intimidate us! They wouldn't dare leave a thousand men down here to die.
Text (Korean): 걱정 마십시오! 우리에게 겁을 주려고 입구를 봉쇄한 것뿐입니다! 아무리 저들이라도 천 명에 달하는 우리들을 이 아래에서 죽어가도록 놔두지는 못할 겁니다.
Text (Portuguese): Não se preocupe! Eles só estão fechando a entrada pra intimidar a gente. Eles não deixariam milhares de homens aqui embaixo pra morrer.
Text (Russian): Не беспокойтесь! Они перекрыли выход только чтобы припугнуть нас! Они не посмеют оставить тысячу человек умирать под землёй.
Text (Spanish): ¡No te preocupes! ¡Sellan la entrada solamente para intimidarnos! No se atreverían a dejar mil hombres aquí abajo a morir.
Text (Thai): ไม่ต้องกังวล! พวกเขาแค่ปิดผนึกทางเข้าเพื่อเป็นการข่มขู่เรา! พวกเขาไม่กล้าปล่อยให้พันคนลงไปที่นี่เพื่อตายหรอก
Text (Traditional Chinese): 別擔心！他們只是想透過封鎖入口來恐嚇我們！他們絕對不敢留下一千個人在這裡自生自滅。

Text: It seems the Empire was harsher than even its citizens knew. I doubt their bodies were ever found.
Text (French): Il semblerait que l'Empire était encore plus dur que ce qu'en savaient les citoyens. Je doute que les corps de ceux-là aient été retrouvés.
Text (German): Es scheint, dass das Königreich härter vorging, als selbst den Bürgern bewusst war. Ich bezweifle stark, dass ihre Leichname jemals entdeckt wurden.
Text (Japanese): It seems the Empire was harsher than even its citizens knew. I doubt their bodies were ever found.
Text (Korean): 제국은 알려진 것보다도 더욱 가혹했던 것 같군. 저 시신들은 발견이나 되었을까 모르겠어.
Text (Portuguese): Parece que o Império era mais severo do que seus cidadãos imaginavam. Duvido que seus corpos enham sido encontrados.
Text (Russian): Видимо, всю жестокость Империи не представляли даже её граждане. Сомневаюсь, что их тела когда-нибудь нашли.
Text (Spanish): Parece que el Imperio era más despiadado de lo que creían sus propios ciudadanos. Dudo que hayan encontrado sus cuerpos alguna vez.
Text (Thai): It seems the Empire was harsher than even its citizens knew. I doubt their bodies were ever found.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 看起來帝國實際上遠比他們的人民想像中的還要來的殘酷。我敢說他們甚至連屍首都不會被人找到。

Text: You can't just keep me locked up! I have rights you know! I deserve a fair trial! Hey! You hear me!?
Text (French): Vous ne pouvez pas m'enfermer comme ça ! J'ai des droits, vous savez ! J'ai droit à un procès équitable ! Hé ! Vous m'entendez ?
Text (German): Ihr könnt mich nicht einfach wegsperren! Ich habe Rechte, wisst Ihr! Ich verdiene einen fairen Prozess! Hey! Hört Ihr mich?
Text (Japanese): You can't just keep me locked up! I have rights you know! I deserve a fair trial! Hey! You hear me!?
Text (Korean): 이렇게 나를 가둘 순 없어! 내게 권리가 있다고! 공정한 재판을 받을 자격이 있단 말이야! 이봐! 내 말 들려!?
Text (Portuguese): Vocês não podem simplesmene me prender! Eu tenho direitos! Mereço um julgamento justo! Ei! Alguém tá me ouvindo?
Text (Russian): Вы не имеете права держать меня под замком! Вы знаете, что у меня есть права! Я заслуживаю честного суда! Эй! Вы меня слышите?!
Text (Spanish): ¡No puedes dejarme aquí encerrado! ¡Tengo derechos! ¡Merezco un juicio justo! ¡Ey! ¡¿Estás escuchando?!
Text (Thai): You can't just keep me locked up! I have rights you know! I deserve a fair trial! Hey! You hear me!?
Text (Traditional Chinese): 你不能就這樣把我關起來！你不能就這樣無視我的基本權利！我應該要受到公平的審判！嘿！聽見了嗎！？

Text: Hello?! Guard!? I smell smoke! Get me out of here-- please! Don't just leave me to die! Someone please help! Please!
Text (French): Ohé ! Gardes ! Je sens de la fumée ! Faites-moi sortir d'ici ! S'il vous plaît ! Ne me laissez pas mourir ! Quelqu'un, aidez-moi ! Je vous en supplie !
Text (German): Hallo?! Wache!? Ich rieche Rauch! Holt mich hier raus – bitte! Lasst mich nicht einfach sterben! Bitte hilft mir jemand! Bitte!
Text (Japanese): Hello?! Guard!? I smell smoke! Get me out of here-- please! Don't just leave me to die! Someone please help! Please!
Text (Korean): 저기?! 경비병!? 타는 냄새가 나는데! 꺼내줘요-- 제발! 이렇게 두지 마세요! 아무나 좀 도와줘요! 제발 부탁이에요!
Text (Portuguese): Olá?! Guarda? Sinto cheiro de fumaça! Me tirem daqui-- Por favor! Não me deixem aqui pra morrer! Alguém me ajude, por favor! Por favor!
Text (Russian): Эй?! Стража?! Я чувствую дым! Выпустите меня! Пожалуйста! Не оставляйте меня умирать! Кто-нибудь, прошу, помогите! Пожалуйста!
Text (Spanish): ¡¿Hola?! ¡¿Guardia?! ¡Huelo humo! Déjame salir, ¡por favor! ¡No me dejes morir aquí! ¡Alguien ayúdeme! ¡Por favor!
Text (Thai): Hello?! Guard!? I smell smoke! Get me out of here-- please! Don't just leave me to die! Someone please help! Please!
Text (Traditional Chinese): 哈囉？！守衛！？我聞到煙味！放我出去！ 拜託！別把我丟在這等死！誰來救救我！救命！

Text: I fear that man never again saw the light of day. I'm so grateful I was never incarcerated.
Text (French): Je crains que cet homme n'ait plus jamais revu la lumière du jour. Je suis si reconnaissant de n'avoir jamais été incarcéré.
Text (German): Ich fürchte, dass dieser Mann nie wieder das Licht der Welt erblickt hat. Ich bin so dankbar, dass ich nie eingekerkert worden bin.
Text (Japanese): I fear that man never again saw the light of day. I'm so grateful I was never incarcerated.
Text (Korean): 저 사람은 다시는 태양빛을 보지 못했겠지. 안쓰럽군. 나는 투옥되진 않았다는 게 이렇게 고마울 줄이야.
Text (Portuguese): Temo que esse homem nunca mais viu a luz do dia. Sou muito grato por nunca ter sido preso.
Text (Russian): Боюсь, этому человеку было не суждено вновь увидеть дневной свет. Как же я рад, что никогда не сидел за решёткой...
Text (Spanish): Temo que aquel hombre nunca vio la luz del sol de nuevo. Estoy muy agradecido de no haber sido encarcelado jamás.
Text (Thai): I fear that man never again saw the light of day. I'm so grateful I was never incarcerated.
