Text (Korean): 세 번째 시체이자 내장이 꺼내어진 채 죽은 하녀를 발견하고는 소리를 질렀지만 가주는 내 말을 듣지 않았다. 심지어 날 보려고도 하지 않았다. 그제서야 나는 깨달았다... 나는 이미 죽었다는 것을...
Text (Portuguese): Quando eles encontraram a terceira criada morta e estripada, eu falei, mas o mestre da casa não escutou. Ele se recusou a olhar pra mim. Foi então que me dei conta... de que já estava morta.
Text (Russian): Когда они находят третью мёртвую и выпотрошенную служанку, я подаю голос, но хозяин дома не желает ничего слышать. Он не хочет даже смотреть на меня. И тут я понимаю причину... Я уже мертв.
Text (Spanish): Cuando hallan a la tercera sirvienta muerta y destripada, hablo, pero el señor de la casa no escucha. Incluso se rehúsa a mirarme. Es ahí cuando entiendo que… ya estoy muerto…
Text (Thai): When they find the third dead and disemboweled maid, I speak up, but the master of the household doesn't listen. He refuses to even look at me. It is then that I realise... I am already dead...
Text (Traditional Chinese): 當他們發現第三個死去且內臟被掏空的女僕時，我試圖向主人報告，但莊園之主並沒有聽進去。他甚至連看都沒看我一眼。但當我意識到的時候...我已經死了。

Text: Quite the twist on that memory, Exile, but I was never a servant, nor a manor-bound spirit. At least, as far as I know...
Text (French): <if:MS>{On ne peut nier la puissance de la chute de ce souvenir, exilé, mais je n'ai jamais été un serviteur ni un esprit lié à un quelconque manoir. Du moins, pas que je sache…}<elif:FS>{On ne peut nier la puissance de la chute de ce souvenir, exilée, mais je n'ai jamais été un serviteur ni un esprit lié à un quelconque manoir. Du moins, pas que je sache…}
Text (German): <if:MS>{Diese Erinnerung nahm eine ziemliche Wendung, Verbannter, aber ich war weder ein Diener noch an ein Herrenhaus gebundener Geist. Zumindest, soweit ich mich erinnern kann ...}<elif:FS>{Diese Erinnerung nahm eine ziemliche Wendung, Verbannte, aber ich war weder ein Diener noch an ein Herrenhaus gebundener Geist. Zumindest, soweit ich mich erinnern kann ...}
Text (Japanese): Quite the twist on that memory, Exile, but I was never a servant, nor a manor-bound spirit. At least, as far as I know...
Text (Korean): 꽤 반전이 있는 기억이로군. 하지만 나는 절대로 하인은 아니었고, 저택에 매인 유령도 아니었어. 내가 알기로는 그래...
Text (Portuguese): <if:MS>{Uma bela reviravolta nessa memória, Exilado, mas eu nunca fui um criado, nem uma alma penada numa mansão. Pelo menos até onde eu sei...}<elif:FS>{Uma bela reviravolta nessa memória, Exilada, mas eu nunca fui um criado, nem uma alma penada numa mansão. Pelo menos até onde eu sei...}
Text (Russian): Какое неожиданное завершение. Впрочем, я никогда не был ни слугой, ни призраком особняка. По крайней мере, мне так кажется...
Text (Spanish): <if:MS>{Vaya giro en la trama de esa memoria, exiliado, pero nunca fui un sirviente ni un fantasma atado a una mansión. Al menos hasta donde sé…}<elif:FS>{Vaya giro en la trama de esa memoria, exiliada, pero nunca fui un sirviente ni un fantasma atado a una mansión. Al menos hasta donde sé…}
Text (Thai): Quite the twist on that memory, Exile, but I was never a servant, nor a manor-bound spirit. At least, as far as I know...
Text (Traditional Chinese): 這個記憶十分的扭曲，流亡者。但我從不會是個從者，也不會是什麼莊園御主。至少...據我所知是這樣...

Text: Nineteen more days in the mountains... I'll never survive, never earn my Mutewind name... I'm already starving and dying after ten... and is that... a wolf?!
Text (French): Encore dix-neuf jours à passer dans les montagnes… Je n'y survivrai pas, jamais je n'obtiendrai mon nom de Ventmuet… Je suis déjà affamé et pratiquement mourant après seulement dix — qu'est-ce que c'est que ça ? Un loup ?!
Text (German): Neunzehn weitere Tage in den Bergen ... Ich werde niemals überleben, mich niemals ein Stummwind nennen dürfen ... Ich hungere und liege schon nach zehn Tagen im Sterben ... und ist das ... ein Wolf?!
Text (Japanese): Nineteen more days in the mountains... I'll never survive, never earn my Mutewind name... I'm already starving and dying after ten... and is that... a wolf?!
Text (Korean): 산속에서 열아흐레나 더 지내야 한다니... 나는 결코 살아남지 못하겠지. 고요한 바람단의 일원이 되지 못할 거야... 열흘째 이후로 계속 굶주리며 죽어가고 있건만... 잠깐 저건... 늑대인가?!
Text (Portuguese): Mais dezenove dias nas montanhas... Eu não vou sobreviver, não conquistarei meu título de Vento Mudo... Já estava morrendo de fome depois de dez... e aquilo é... um lobo?!
Text (Russian): Ещё девятнадцать дней в горах... Я не выживу, не заслужу своё имя Немого ветра. Ведь я уже умираю с голоду всего через десять дней... Кто это?.. Волк?!
Text (Spanish): Diecinueve días más en las montañas… nunca sobreviviré, nunca obtendré mi nombre Viento Mudo… Ya estoy famélico y muriendo después de diez… ¡¿es eso… un lobo?!
Text (Thai): อีกสิบเก้าวันบนภูเขา... ข้าจะไม่รอด ไม่ได้รับชื่อมิ้วท์วินของข้า... แค่สิบวันข้าก็ใกล้อดตายแล้ว... และนั่นคือ... หมาป่า?!
Text (Traditional Chinese): 還得在山上待 19 天...看來我是活不下去了，看來我永遠也拿不到我的啞風之名...我真的要餓死了...等等...那是隻...狼！？

Text: Kindest friend, kindred wolf. You kept me warm for nineteen days. I will return one day, when I am old, and let your descendants feast upon my remains.
Text (French): Frère loup, fidèle compagnon. Tu m'auras tenu au chaud pendant dix-neuf jours. Je reviendrai un jour quand je serai vieux et laisserai tes descendants se repaître de mes restes.
Text (German): Gütiger Freund, vertrauter Wolf. Neunzehn Tage hieltst du mich warm. Eines Tages kehre ich zurück, wenn ich älter bin, und deine Nachkommen sollen sich an meinen Überresten sattfressen.
Text (Japanese): Kindest friend, kindred wolf. You kept me warm for nineteen days. I will return one day, when I am old, and let your descendants feast upon my remains.
Text (Korean): 친절한 친구여, 친절한 늑대여. 열아흐레 동안 내게 온기를 나누어 주었구나. 내가 늙으면 여기에 돌아와, 네 자손들이 내 시체를 만찬 삼을 수 있도록 하마.
Text (Portuguese): Meu gentil amigo, irmão lobo. Você me manteve quente por dezenove dias. Eu retornarei um dia, quando estiver velho, e deixarei seus descententes se alimentarem dos meus restos.
Text (Russian): Мой дорогой, славный волчок. Ты согревал меня все девятнадцать дней. Взамен, состарившись, я позволю твоим потомкам вдоволь попировать моими останками.
Text (Spanish): Mi más querido amigo, mi lobo alma gemela. Me mantuviste caliente por diecinueve días. Volveré un día, cuando sea viejo, y dejaré que tus descendientes se alimenten con mis restos.
Text (Thai): หมาป่าเพื่อนยาก เจ้าทำให้ข้าอบอุ่นเป็นเวลาสิบเก้าวัน ข้าจะกลับมาวันหนึ่งเมื่อข้าแก่แล้วและให้ลูกหลานของเจ้ากัดกินซากของข้า
Text (Traditional Chinese): 最好的摯友，與我相隨的狼啊。你幫助我保持溫暖渡過了這 19 天。當我老了我終會回來，我將以我的身軀宴請你的後代。

Text: Exile! I felt a wolf's fur... whose life was that? So very different from what I expected!
Text (French): <if:MS>{Exilé ! J'ai senti la peau d'un loup… Qui était-ce ? Son sort fut bien différent de ce à quoi je m'attendais !}<elif:FS>{Exilée ! J'ai senti la peau d'un loup… Qui était-ce ? Son sort fut bien différent de ce à quoi je m'attendais !}
Text (German): <if:MS>{Verbannter! Ich spürte das Fell eines Wolfes ... wessen Leben war das? So ganz anders als ich es erwartet habe!}<elif:FS>{Verbannte! Ich spürte das Fell eines Wolfes ... wessen Leben war das? So ganz anders als ich es erwartet habe!}
Text (Japanese): Exile! I felt a wolf's fur... whose life was that? So very different from what I expected!
Text (Korean): 유배자! 늑대의 털이 느껴졌어... 누구의 삶이었던 거지? 예상했던 것과는 너무 다른데!
Text (Portuguese): <if:MS>{Exilado! Eu senti o pelo de um lobo... de quem era essa vida? Tão diferente do que eu imaginava!}<elif:FS>{Exilada! Eu senti o pelo de um lobo... de quem era essa vida? Tão diferente do que eu imaginava!}
Text (Russian): <if:MS>{Изгнанник! Я ощутил волчий мех... Чья это была жизнь? Она так отличалась от ожидаемого!}<elif:FS>{Изгнанница! Я ощутил волчий мех... Чья это была жизнь? Она так отличалась от ожидаемого!}
Text (Spanish): ¡Exiliado! Sentí el pelaje de un lobo… ¿de quién era esa vida? ¡Era muy diferente a lo que hubiera esperado!
Text (Thai): เอ็กไซล์! ข้าสัมผัสถึงขนของหมาป่า... ชีวิตของใครเล่า? แตกต่างจากที่ข้าคาดไว้มาก!
Text (Traditional Chinese): 流亡者！我感覺到狼的皮...那是誰的人生？這跟我預期的完全不一樣！

Text: I move through the stacks, seeking that one perfect moment from my youth. I once read a book here, its name lost to me, that perfectly struck the chords of my heart.
Text (French): J'erre entre les piles de livres à la recherche de ce moment parfait de ma jeunesse. J'ai lu un livre ici jadis, un livre dont j'ignore le titre, un livre qui a su faire vibrer les cordes de mon cœur à la perfection.
Text (German): Ich wandle durch die Stapel und suche nach diesem einen perfekten Moment aus meiner Jugend. Ich habe hier einmal ein Buch gelesen, dessen Name mir entfallen ist, das mir wirklich aus der Seele gesprochen hat.
Text (Japanese): I move through the stacks, seeking that one perfect moment from my youth. I once read a book here, its name lost to me, that perfectly struck the chords of my heart.
Text (Korean): 나는 젊은 시절 경험했던 그 완벽한 순간을 찾아 서가 사이를 헤매고 있다. 제목은 기억나지 않지만, 여기서 완벽하게 내 심금을 울렸던 책을 한 권 읽었었지.
Text (Portuguese): Eu procurava entre as pilhas, buscando aquele momento perfeito da minha juventude. Uma vez eu li um livro aqui, não me lembro o nome, que atingiu perfeitamente os acordes do meu coração.
Text (Russian): Я хожу между кипами книг в поисках той, что подарила мне идеальный момент юности. Когда-то я побывал здесь и прочитал книгу. Я не помню её названия, но помню, что она затронула потаённые струны моей души.
Text (Spanish): Me deslizo por las estanterías buscando ese momento perfecto de mi juventud. Un día leí un libro aquí, aunque no recuerdo su nombre, que tocó perfectamente las fibras de mi corazón.
Text (Thai): I move through the stacks, seeking that one perfect moment from my youth. I once read a book here, its name lost to me, that perfectly struck the chords of my heart.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我穿過書堆，尋找我年輕時追尋的完美時刻。我曾經在這邊讀到一本書，但我忘記書名了，那本書完美的扣動了我的心弦。

Text: It was as if that book was written for me, and yet, I cannot find it now. There are more tomes here than I could ever pick up and check in an entire lifetime.
Text (French): C'était comme si cet ouvrage avait été écrit pour moi et, pourtant, il m'est impossible de le retrouver aujourd'hui. Il y a plus d'ouvrages ici que je ne pourrais en consulter en une existence entière.
Text (German): Es war, als wäre dieses Buch nur für mich geschrieben worden, und doch kann ich es jetzt nicht finden. Hier liegen mehr Bücher, als ich je in meinem ganzen Leben aufheben und durchblättern könnte.
Text (Japanese): It was as if that book was written for me, and yet, I cannot find it now. There are more tomes here than I could ever pick up and check in an entire lifetime.
Text (Korean): 마치 나를 위해 쓰인 책 같았다. 하지만 이제 와서 그걸 찾을 방법이 없다. 여기에는 일생 동안 제목만 확인해도 시간이 모자랄 정도의 책이 쌓여 있다.
Text (Portuguese): Foi como se aquele livro tivesse sido escrito para mim, mas eu não conseguia achá-lo. Tinha mais livros aqui do que eu poderia ler em toda a minha vida.
Text (Russian): Словно бы эту книгу написали именно для меня, но... теперь я не могу её отыскать. Здесь столько томов, что на одну проверку названий уйдёт целая жизнь.
Text (Spanish): Era como si ese libro hubiese sido escrito para mí, y sin embargo no ahora no puedo encontrarlo. Hay más tomos aquí de los que jamás podría tomar y revisar en toda mi vida.
Text (Thai): It was as if that book was written for me, and yet, I cannot find it now. There are more tomes here than I could ever pick up and check in an entire lifetime.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 它就像是為了我而寫的書，然而，我找不到它了。這裡有成堆的書籍，我想我的餘生都不足以一一拿起來檢查了。

Text: The words of the story he read were... so poignant... and yet they escape me, like sand blown from the ridge of a dune.
Text (French): Les mots qui formaient l'histoire que cet homme avait lue étaient… si touchants… et pourtant ils m'échappent comme le sable balayé de la crête d'une dune.
Text (German): Die Worte der Geschichte, die er las, waren ... so ergreifend ... und doch entfliehen sie mir, wie Sand, der vom Kamm einer Düne verweht wurde.
Text (Japanese): The words of the story he read were... so poignant... and yet they escape me, like sand blown from the ridge of a dune.
Text (Korean): 그가 읽었던 이야기는... 굉장히 가슴 아픈 내용이었군... 그리고는 흩어져 버렸어. 마치 사막의 모래 언덕이 바람에 날려 흩어지듯이.
Text (Portuguese): As palavras da história que ele leu foram... tão comoventes... e ainda assim elas me escapam, como a areia que voa do come de uma duna.
Text (Russian): Эта история была написана сильными, западающими в душу словами... но они ускользают от меня словно песок, сдуваемый ветром с верхушки дюны.
Text (Spanish): Las palabras de la historia que leyó eran… tan emotivas… y sin embargo se me escapan, como la arena que se desliza por las crestas de las dunas.
Text (Thai): The words of the story he read were... so poignant... and yet they escape me, like sand blown from the ridge of a dune.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 他所讀的的故事用字如此的...淒美...然而它們卻遠離了我，就像從山脊吹拂而去的風沙那般。

Text: I don't know much longer I can do this. Every day, we cart in the poor folk the General has rounded up for the Witch's experiments. I used to count, but I stopped at two thousand.
Text (French): J'ignore pendant encore combien de temps je pourrai continuer à faire ça. Chaque jour, nous transportons les pauvres gens que le Général a sélectionnés pour les expériences de la Sorcière. J'avais commencé à les compter, mais j'ai arrêté à deux mille.
Text (German): Ich weiß nicht, wie lange ich das noch durchhalten kann. Jeden Tag karren wir die Armen her, die der General für die Experimente der Hexe zusammengetrieben hat. Ich habe früher gezählt, aber bei zweitausend habe ich aufgegeben.
Text (Japanese): I don't know much longer I can do this. Every day, we cart in the poor folk the General has rounded up for the Witch's experiments. I used to count, but I stopped at two thousand.
Text (Korean): 내가 이 일을 얼마나 더 할 수 있을지 모르겠다. 우리는 장군이 마녀의 실험을 위해 모아둔 불쌍한 사람들을 수레로 실어나른다. 나는 그 숫자를 세어보다가 이천을 넘기고는 그만두었다.
Text (Portuguese): Eu não sabia se podia aguentar por muito mais tempo. Todos os dias coletamos as pobres almas que o General recolheu para os experimentos da Bruxa. Eu costumava contar, mas parei depois de dois mil.
Text (Russian): Лунарис, помоги мне обрести спокойствие. Помоги обрести мир. Помоги лишить голоса тех, кто меня тревожит.
Text (Spanish): No sé cuánto tiempo más pueda hacer esto. Cada día traemos en carros a la pobre gente que el General ha elegido para los experimentos de la Bruja. Solía contarlos, pero dejé de hacerlo al alcanzar dos mil.
Text (Thai): I don't know much longer I can do this. Every day, we cart in the poor folk the General has rounded up for the Witch's experiments. I used to count, but I stopped at two thousand.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我實在不知道我還能做這個多久。每天，我們都用車載著一些窮人來給將軍，投入那個女巫的實驗之中。我曾經數過到底是第幾回了，但最終我在兩千時停止了計算。

Text: This is not the career the Blackguards promised me. We're worse than monsters. Look at this place! Rivers of blood! Piles of corpses! We were just following orders...
Text (French): Ce n'est pas la carrière que la Garde noire m'avait promise. Nous sommes pires que des monstres. Regardez-moi ça ! Des rivières de sang ! Des amoncellements de cadavres ! Nous ne faisions que suivre les ordres…
Text (German): Das ist nicht die Karriere, die mir die Schwarzgardisten versprochen haben. Wir sind schlimmer als Monster. Seht diesen Ort an! Flüsse aus Blut! Berge von Leichen! Wir haben nur Befehle befolgt ...
Text (Japanese): This is not the career the Blackguards promised me. We're worse than monsters. Look at this place! Rivers of blood! Piles of corpses! We were just following orders...
Text (Korean): 이건 검은 근위대가 내게 약속했던 일이 아냐. 우린 괴물보다 못한 이가 되었어. 여길 봐! 피는 강을 이루고 있고! 시체는 산이 되었다고! 우린 그저 명령을 따랐을 뿐인데...
Text (Portuguese): Essa não foi a carreira que me prometeram na Guarda Negra. Somos piores que monstros. Olha pra esse lugar! Rios de sangue! Pilhas de corpos! Estávamos apenas seguindo ordens...
Text (Russian): Лунарис, помоги мне уничтожить врагов! Позволь забрать то, что моё по праву!
Text (Spanish): Esta no es la carrera que los Guardias Negros me prometieron. Somos peor que monstruos. ¡Mira este lugar! ¡Ríos de sangre! ¡Pilas de cadáveres! Solo seguíamos órdenes…
Text (Thai): นี่​ไม่ใช่​อาชีพ​ที่​พวกการ์ดดำ​สัญญา​ไว้​กับ​ข้า เรา​เลวร้าย​ยิ่ง​กว่า​อสุรกาย​เสียอีก ดู​ที่​นี่! แม่น้ำ​แห่ง​เลือด! กองศพ! เรา​เพียง​แค่​ทำ​ตาม​คำสั่ง...
Text (Traditional Chinese): 這才不是當初黑旗守衛向我承諾的工作內容！我們比怪物還不如。看看這鬼地方！血流成河！屍首成山！而我們只是麻木的聽從命令...

Text: We were just following orders. Hollow words. He didn't believe his own absolution.
Text (French): Nous ne faisions que suivre les ordres. Que des paroles creuses. Il ne croyait même pas en sa propre absolution.
Text (German): Wir haben nur Befehle befolgt. Leere Worte. Er glaubte nicht einmal an seine eigene Absolution.
Text (Japanese): We were just following orders. Hollow words. He didn't believe his own absolution.
Text (Korean): 우리는 그저 명령을 따랐을 뿐이라. 공허한 말이야. 아니, 본인조차도 자신이 죄가 없다고 믿지 않았는걸.
Text (Portuguese): Estávamos apenas seguindo ordens.  Palavras vazias. Ele não acreditava em sua própria absolvição.
Text (Russian): Какое странное видоизменение веры... Я абсолютно уверен, что это не моё воспоминание. Я знаю, что был человеком твёрдых взглядов.
Text (Spanish): Solo seguíamos órdenes. Palabras vacías. Él no creía en su propia absolución.
Text (Thai): เราเพียงแค่ทำตามคำสั่ง คำกลวง เขาไม่เชื่อการอภัยโทษของเขาเอง
Text (Traditional Chinese): 「我們只是聽命行事」多麼空洞的一句話。他難道還認為他是無辜的嗎。

Text: I don't understand. I saw Bryn die. I held him. The fever that took him was so intense... I remember the moment his body went cold. But now he lives once more.
Text (French): Je ne comprends pas… J'ai vu Bryn mourir. Je le tenais dans mes bras. La fièvre qui l'a emporté était si intense… Je me souviens du moment où son corps s'est refroidi pour de bon. Mais maintenant, il vit à nouveau.
Text (German): Ich verstehe nicht. Ich sah Bryn sterben. Ich hielt ihn fest. Das Fieber, das er hatte, war so intensiv ... Ich erinnere mich an den Moment, als sein Körper kalt wurde. Aber jetzt lebt er wieder.
Text (Japanese): I don't understand. I saw Bryn die. I held him. The fever that took him was so intense... I remember the moment his body went cold. But now he lives once more.
Text (Korean): 이해가 안 돼. 분명 브린이 죽는 걸 봤어. 내가 안아줬어. 고열이 심했지... 그 작은 몸이 차게 식어가던 순간이 아직도 생생해. 그런데 다시 살아났다고?
Text (Portuguese): Não entendi... eu vi Bryn morrer. Eu o segurava. A febre que o pegou foi tão intensa... Lembro-me do momento em que seu corpo ficou frio. Mas ele vivia novamente.
Text (Russian): Я не понимаю... Я видела Брина мёртвым. Была рядом с ним. Его забрала неизлечимая лихорадка. Я помню миг, когда его тело начало остывать... Но теперь он снова жив.
Text (Spanish): No lo entiendo... vi a Bryn morir. Lo sostuve en mis brazos. La fiebre que se lo llevó era tan intensa... Recuerdo el momento en el que su cuerpo se enfrió. Pero ahora vive de nuevo.
Text (Thai): I don't understand. I saw Bryn die. I held him. The fever that took him was so intense... I remember the moment his body went cold. But now he lives once more.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我不明白...我親眼看見布林死了。帶走他的高燒是那麼的灼熱...我記得他身體逐漸冰冷得那一刻。但現在他又活了過來。

Text: Yet it is not truly him. I know that. A mother knows her son and this creature is not my son. It is a hollow imposter. My son's spirit is with Innocence. So I go to him at last.
Text (French): Pourtant, ce n'est pas lui. Je le sais. Une mère connaît son fils et cette créature n'est pas le mien. C'est un imposteur, une enveloppe vide. L'âme de mon fils se trouve aux côtés d'Innocence désormais ; ainsi, je m'en vais enfin le rejoindre.
Text (German): Doch er ist es nicht wirklich. Das weiß ich. Eine Mutter kennt ihren Sohn, und diese Kreatur ist nicht mein Sohn. Sie ist eine trügerische Hülle. Der Geist meines Sohnes ist unschuldig. Also sehe ich ihn endlich wieder.
Text (Japanese): Yet it is not truly him. I know that. A mother knows her son and this creature is not my son. It is a hollow imposter. My son's spirit is with Innocence. So I go to him at last.
Text (Korean): 그건 진짜 브린이 아니야. 난 알 수 있어. 아무렴 어미가 제 새끼를 모르려고. 그 괴물은 내 아들이 아니야. 그건 빈 껍질만 남은 가짜지. 브린의 영혼은 이노센스 님의 곁에 있어. 그러니 나도 드디어 내 아들 곁으로 가는 거야.
Text (Portuguese): Mas ele não era completamente humano. Disso eu sabia. Uma mãe conhece seu filho e aquela criatura não era o meu filho. Era um impostor vazio. O espírito do meu filho está com Innocence. Então eu finalmente me juntaria a ele.
Text (Russian): Только это не совсем он. Я это знаю. Мать знает своего сына, а это существо — не мой сын. Это пустая подделка. Дух моего сына сейчас с Невинностью. Мне пора идти к нему.
Text (Spanish): Pero no es él. Lo sé. Una madre conoce a su hijo y esta criatura no es mi hijo. Es un impostor vacío El espíritu de mi hijo está con Inocencia. Así que iré con él por fin.
Text (Thai): Yet it is not truly him. I know that. A mother knows her son and this creature is not my son. It is a hollow imposter. My son's spirit is with Innocence. So I go to him at last.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 然而那並非真的是他。我知道的。作為一個母親我能夠認的出那個怪物並不是我的兒子。這是一個虛假的仿冒品。我兒子的靈魂是純淨無罪的。於是我最終找上了他。

Text: If I still possessed a heart, it would now be broken. We are no strangers to the returning dead, but this was not my memory.
Text (French): Si j'avais encore eu un cœur, il viendrait de se briser. Bien que nous connaissions le fléau des morts qui reviennent, ce souvenir n'est pas le mien.
Text (German): Wenn noch ein Herz in meiner Brust schlüge, wäre es jetzt zerbrochen. Die wiederkehrenden Toten sind uns nicht fremd, doch dies war nicht meine Erinnerung.
Text (Japanese): If I still possessed a heart, it would now be broken. We are no strangers to the returning dead, but this was not my memory.
Text (Korean): 내게 마음이 있었더라도 이번에 부서지고 말았겠지. 죽은 이가 돌아오는 게 우리에겐 낯선 일은 아니지만... 이건 나의 기억은 아니야.
Text (Portuguese): Se eu ainda tivesse um coração, ele estaria partido. Já estamos acostumados com mortos voltando à vida, mas essa memória não era minha.
Text (Russian): Будь у меня сейчас сердце, оно оказалось бы разбито. Нам не привыкать к возвращению мёртвых, но это не моё воспоминание.
Text (Spanish): Si tuviese un corazón, estaría roto ahora. No somos ajenos a los muertos que regresan, pero esta no era mi memoria.
Text (Thai): If I still possessed a heart, it would now be broken. We are no strangers to the returning dead, but this was not my memory.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 如果我心仍再跳動，一定會再碎一次。我們對死者蘇生並不陌生，但這確實不是我的記憶。

Text: I've thirsted for adventure my entire life, but I suppose, at eighty-two, the most I can do now is walk along the village plateau.
Text (French): J'ai eu soif d'aventures toute ma vie, mais j'imagine qu'à quatre-vingt-deux ans, le mieux que je peux faire désormais est de me promener le long du plateau du village.
Text (German): Ich habe mich mein ganzes Leben lang nach Abenteuern gesehnt, aber nun nehme ich an, dass ich mit zweiundachtzig höchstens am Dorfplateau entlang spazieren kann.
Text (Japanese): I've thirsted for adventure my entire life, but I suppose, at eighty-two, the most I can do now is walk along the village plateau.
Text (Korean): 한평생을 모험에 목말라하며 살아왔지만, 여든두 살이 된 지금의 나에겐 마을 언덕을 오르는 일이 그나마 할 수 있는 전부구나.
Text (Portuguese): Tive sede de aventura a vida inteira, mas presumo que, aos oitenta e dois anos, o máximo que podia fazer era caminhar pelas planícies da aldeia.
Text (Russian): Всю жизнь меня манила дорога странствий, но теперь, в восемьдесят два года, я могу разве что прогуляться у деревни.
Text (Spanish): He ansiado la aventura durante toda mi vida, pero supongo que a mi edad, ochenta y dos años, lo más que puedo hacer es pasear por la explanada de la aldea.
Text (Thai): I've thirsted for adventure my entire life, but I suppose, at eighty-two, the most I can do now is walk along the village plateau.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我終其一生都渴望著冒險，但我想，在我八十二歲時，我頂多只能在村邊的高地晃晃而已吧。

Text: I dreamt of magic and adventure when I was younger. It's a shame this world isn't more exciting.
Text (French): Je rêvais de magie et d'aventure durant ma jeunesse. Dommage que ce monde ne soit pas plus palpitant.
Text (German): Ich habe von Magie und Abenteuern geträumt, als ich jünger war. Es ist eine Schande, dass diese Welt nicht aufregender ist.
Text (Japanese): I dreamt of magic and adventure when I was younger. It's a shame this world isn't more exciting.
Text (Korean): 젊은 시절에는 마법과 모험의 삶을 꿈꿨지. 이 세상이 그렇게까지 흥미진진한 곳은 아니라는 사실이 유감일 뿐이야.
Text (Portuguese): Eu sonhei com mágica e aventura quando era jovem. Uma pena que esse mundo não é mais emocionante.
Text (Russian): В молодости я грезил волшебством и приключениями. Как жаль, что мир стал скучным и тусклым.
Text (Spanish): Soñaba con aventuras y magia cuando era más joven. Es una pena que este mundo no sea tan emocionante.
Text (Thai): I dreamt of magic and adventure when I was younger. It's a shame this world isn't more exciting.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我年輕時曾經幻想充滿劍與魔法的探險時間。遺憾的是這個世界無聊得很。

Text: From what I've seen in my time with you, Exile, the owner of that memory must have been uncommonly lucky to avoid Wraeclast's dangers. Or, seemingly, unlucky.
Text (French): <if:MS>{À en juger par ce que j'ai pu voir à vos côtés, exilé, le possesseur de ce souvenir a eu l'incroyable chance d'échapper aux dangers de Wraeclast. Ou plutôt la malchance, visiblement.}<elif:FS>{À en juger par ce que j'ai pu voir à vos côtés, exilée, le possesseur de ce souvenir a eu l'incroyable chance d'échapper aux dangers de Wraeclast. Ou plutôt la malchance, visiblement.}
Text (German): <if:MS>{Wenn ich bedenke, was wir schon zusammen erlebt haben, Verbannter, muss der Besitzer dieser Erinnerung ungewöhnlich viel Glück gehabt haben, den Gefahren Wraeclasts zu entgehen. Oder, wie es scheint, Unglück.}<elif:FS>{Wenn ich bedenke, was wir schon zusammen erlebt haben, Verbannte, muss der Besitzer dieser Erinnerung ungewöhnlich viel Glück gehabt haben, den Gefahren Wraeclasts zu entgehen. Oder, wie es scheint, Unglück.}
Text (Japanese): From what I've seen in my time with you, Exile, the owner of that memory must have been uncommonly lucky to avoid Wraeclast's dangers. Or, seemingly, unlucky.
Text (Korean): 내 시대를 기준으로 살펴본 바로는, 저 기억의 소유자는 레이클라스트의 무수한 위험을 피해간 흔치 않은 행운의 주인이었을 것 같아. 뭐 겉만 보면 그냥 운 없는 녀석 같기도 하지만.
Text (Portuguese): <if:MS>{Pelo que vi em meu tempo com você, Exilado, o dono dessa memória deve ter dado uma sorte bem incomum para evitar os perigos de Wraeclast. Ou, ao que parece, não deu sorte. }<elif:FS>{Pelo que vi em meu tempo com você, Exilada, o dono dessa memória deve ter dado uma sorte bem incomum para evitar os perigos de Wraeclast. Ou, ao que parece, não deu sorte. }
Text (Russian): Из увиденного после знакомства с тобой я могу заключить, что хозяину этого воспоминания несказанно повезло избежать опасностей Рэкласта. Правда, он этого не понимал.
Text (Spanish): <if:MS>{Por lo que he visto durante mi tiempo contigo, exiliado, el dueño de esa memoria debe haber sido extrañamente afortunado para evadir los peligros de Wraeclast. O, aparentemente, desafortunado.}<elif:FS>{Por lo que he visto durante mi tiempo contigo, exiliada, el dueño de esa memoria debe haber sido extrañamente afortunado para evadir los peligros de Wraeclast. O, aparentemente, desafortunado.}
Text (Thai): From what I've seen in my time with you, Exile, the owner of that memory must have been uncommonly lucky to avoid Wraeclast's dangers. Or, seemingly, unlucky.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 從我跟你一起看過這麼多的記憶來說，流亡者，這個記憶的主人一定是個幸運無比的傢伙，居然能躲過瓦爾克拉斯上的危機。不過，還是應該說是不幸運呢。

Text: We're trapped down here. Though we strike it again and again, the Sekhema's seal remains unharmed. No one down here can sleep. My throat is parched, yet I feel no thirst.
Text (French): Nous sommes enfermés ici. Nous avons beau le frapper encore et encore, le Sceau de la Sekhema demeure intact. Personne n'arrive à dormir. J'ai la gorge sèche et, pourtant, je ne ressens aucune soif.
Text (German): Wir sind hier unten gefangen. Obwohl wir immer wieder versuchen, es zu zerschlagen, lässt sich Sekhemas Siegel einfach nicht brechen. Niemand vermag es, hier unten zu schlafen. Mein Hals ist ganz rau, und doch verspüre ich keinen Durst.
Text (Japanese): We're trapped down here. Though we strike it again and again, the Sekhema's seal remains unharmed. No one down here can sleep. My throat is parched, yet I feel no thirst.
Text (Korean): 우린 이곳에 갇혀버리고 말았다. 아무리 내리쳐봐도 세케마의 봉인은 꼼짝도 하지 않는다. 이 아래에선 아무도 잠들지 못한다. 목구멍이 말라붙어 가지만 갈증은 느껴지지 않는다.
Text (Portuguese): Estávamos presos aqui embaixo. Apesar de termos batido várias e várias vezes, o selo de Sekhema permanece intacto. Ninguém aqui conseguia dormir. Minha garganta estava seca, mas eu não sentia sede.
Text (Russian): Мы заперты в ловушке. Сколько бы мы ни бились о печать Сехемы, ей всё нипочём. Никто из оставшихся внизу не может заснуть. Моё горло сухое как наждак, но я не чувствую жажду.
Text (Spanish): Estamos atrapados aquí abajo. Aunque picamos una y otra vez, el sello de la Sekhema sigue intacto. Nadie aquí abajo puede dormir. Mi garganta está seca, y sin embargo no tengo sed.
Text (Thai): เราติดกับดักที่นี่ แม้ว่าเราจะตีมันซ้ำแล้วซ้ำอีก คาถาผนึกของเซ็คเคมาก็ยังไม่เสียหาย ไม่มีใครในนี้สามารถหลับได้ลง ข้าคอแห้ง แต่ข้าไม่รู้สึกกระหาย
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我們被困在這了。即使我們一次又一次的敲擊，絲克瑪的封印依舊紋風不動。在這裡沒有人能夠安穩的睡覺。我的喉嚨乾渴撕裂，但我卻沒有感受到一絲的口渴。

Text: The foreman is beginning to show signs of madness. He claims the walls, earth, and even his pick have become sticky as honey. I pray death comes for us soon, but I fear we will receive something far worse.
Text (French): Le contremaître commence à montrer des signes de folie. Il affirme que les parois rocheuses, le sol et même son pic sont devenus aussi collants que le miel. Je souhaite que la mort vienne nous prendre rapidement, mais je crains que quelque chose de bien pire nous attende.
Text (German): Der Vorarbeiter beginnt langsam wahnsinnig zu werden. Er behauptet, die Wände, die Erde und sogar seine Spitzhacke seien so klebrig wie Honig. Ich bete dafür, dass uns der Tod bald erlöst, doch ich fürchte, dass uns etwas noch viel Schlimmeres bevorsteht.
Text (Japanese): The foreman is beginning to show signs of madness. He claims the walls, earth, and even his pick have become sticky as honey. I pray death comes for us soon, but I fear we will receive something far worse.
Text (Korean): 작업반장이 미쳐가는 징후가 보인다. 그는 벽이, 땅이, 곡괭이가 꿀처럼 끈적거린다고 말한다. 차라리 빨리 죽었으면 좋겠다. 죽기보다 못한 신세가 될까 두렵다.
Text (Portuguese): O capataz começava a mostrar sinais de loucura. Ele alegava que as paredes, a terra e até mesmo sua picareta tinham se tornado pegajosas como mel. Eu rezei para que a morte viesse logo, mas temia que receberíamos algo muito pior.
Text (Russian): Наш бригадир, кажется, сходит с ума. Он уверяет, что стены, земля и даже его кирка стали липкими словно мёд. Я молю смерть поскорее забрать нас, но боюсь, что нам уготована куда худшая участь.
Text (Spanish): El capataz está empezando a mostrar signos de locura. Dice que las paredes, la tierra, y hasta su pico se han vuelto pegajosos como la miel. Rezo para que la muerte nos llegue pronto, pero me temo que recibiremos algo mucho peor.
Text (Thai): หัวหน้าคนงานเริ่มแสดงอาการบ้าคลั่ง เขาอ้างว่าผนังดินและแม้แต่ตัวเลือกของเขาก็เหนียวเหนอะหนะเหมือนน้ำผึ้ง ข้าอธิษฐานขอให้ความตายมาถึงเราในเร็วๆ นี้ แต่ข้ากลัวว่าเราจะได้พบกับสิ่งที่เลวร้ายยิ่งกว่านั้น
Text (Traditional Chinese): 工頭已經開始失去理智。他聲稱牆壁、大地甚至是他的鎬頭都變得像蜂蜜般黏稠。我祈禱死亡能夠盡快的降臨我們，但我擔心我們即將面對比死亡還要糟糕的命運。

Text: Some of these events have the ring of familiarity, yet I cannot place myself in this one. I suspect it is simply too old to be mine.
Text (French): Certains de ces événements me paraissent familiers, mais je n'arrive pourtant pas à me situer dans celui-ci. Je le soupçonne d'être trop ancien pour qu'il m'appartienne.
Text (German): Einige dieser Ereignisse kommen mir bekannt vor, und doch habe ich nicht das Gefühl, dass es sich um eine meiner Erinnerungen handelt. Dafür scheint sie einfach zu alt zu sein.
Text (Japanese): Some of these events have the ring of familiarity, yet I cannot place myself in this one. I suspect it is simply too old to be mine.
Text (Korean): 친숙한 부분이 없지는 않지만, 내 기억은 아니야. 그러기엔 너무 오래된 기억이거든.
Text (Portuguese): Alguns desses eventos tem um toque de familiaridade, mas não consigo me localizar nesse. Suspeito que essa memória seja velha demais para ser minha.
Text (Russian): Некоторые из воспоминаний кажутся смутно знакомыми, но я не могу примерить их на себя. Думаю, это воспоминание слишком старое, чтобы оказаться моим.
Text (Spanish): Algunos de estos eventos son algo familiares, y sin embargo no puedo ubicarme en este. Sospecho que es demasiado antigua para ser mía.
Text (Thai): Some of these events have the ring of familiarity, yet I cannot place myself in this one. I suspect it is simply too old to be mine.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 歷史總是驚人的相似，但這次事件我實在無法身歷其中。我猜這個太過於古老的記憶並不是我的。

Text: Lunaris, help me find calm. Help me find peace. Help me silence those who trouble me.
Text (French): Lunaris, aidez-moi à trouver la tranquillité. Aidez-moi à trouver la paix. Aidez-moi à réduire au silence ceux qui m'importunent !
Text (German): Lunaris, hilf mir, Ruhe zu finden. Hilf mir, Frieden zu finden. Hilf mir, diejenigen ruhigzustellen, die meine Ruhe stören.
Text (Japanese): Lunaris, help me find calm. Help me find peace. Help me silence those who trouble me.
Text (Korean): 루나리스여, 제가 고요를 찾도록, 평화를 찾도록 도와주소서. 저를 괴롭히는 자들을 침묵시킬 수 있도록 도와주소서.
Text (Portuguese): Lunaris, ajude-me a encontrar calma. Ajude-me a encontrar paz. Ajude-me a silenciar os que me pertubam!
Text (Russian): Лунарис, помоги мне обрести спокойствие. Помоги обрести мир. Помоги лишить голоса тех, кто меня тревожит.
Text (Spanish): Lunaris, ayúdame a encontrar calma. Ayúdame a encontrar paz. Ayúdame a silenciar a quienes me perturban.
Text (Thai): ลูนาริส ช่วยข้าค้นหาความสงบ ช่วยข้าพบความสงบสุข ช่วยข้าปิดปากผู้ที่รบกวนข้า
Text (Traditional Chinese): 月耀神啊，請幫助我找到平靜。請幫助我找到祥和。請幫助我讓那些打擾我的人沉默。

Text: Lunaris, help me destroy my enemies! Help me take what is rightfully mine!
Text (French): Lunaris, aidez-moi à anéantir mes ennemis ! Aidez-moi à prendre ce qui me revient de droit !
Text (German): Lunaris, hilf mir, meine Feinde zu zerstören! Hilf mir, das zu erobern, was rechtmäßig mir gehört!
Text (Japanese): Lunaris, help me destroy my enemies! Help me take what is rightfully mine!
Text (Korean): 루나리스여, 제가 적들을 처치하도록 도와주소서! 정당한 저의 것을 되찾도록 도와주소서!
Text (Portuguese): Lunaris, ajude-me a destruir meus inimigos! Ajude-me a pegar o que é meu por direito!
Text (Russian): Лунарис, помоги мне уничтожить врагов! Позволь забрать то, что моё по праву!
Text (Spanish): Lunaris, ¡ayúdame a destruir a mis enemigos! ¡Ayúdame a tomar lo que me pertenece por derecho!
Text (Thai): ลูนาริส ช่วยข้าทำลายศัตรูของข้าด้วย! ช่วยข้ายึดสิ่งที่ควรเป็นของข้า!
Text (Traditional Chinese): 月耀神啊，請幫助我摧毀我的敵人。請幫助我獲得我應得之物！

Text: Such a strange evolution of beliefs... that is most assuredly not my memory. I know I was a man of conviction.
Text (French): Quelle étrange évolution que fut celle de sa croyance ! Je suis pratiquement certain que ce souvenir n'est pas le mien. Je sais que je suis un homme de convictions.
Text (German): Menschen mit solch starkem Glauben ... das kann auf keinen Fall meine Erinnerung sein. Ich weiß, dass ich ein Mann der Überzeugung war – und nicht des Glaubens.
Text (Japanese): Such a strange evolution of beliefs... that is most assuredly not my memory. I know I was a man of conviction.
Text (Korean): 참으로 특이한 믿음이로군... 내 기억은 절대로 아냐. 나는 자기 확신으로 가득한 사람이었으니까.
Text (Portuguese): Uma evolução tão estranha de crenças... certamente essa memória não é minha. Eu sei que era um homem convicto.
Text (Russian): Какое странное видоизменение веры... Я абсолютно уверен, что это не моё воспоминание. Я был человеком твёрдых взглядов.
Text (Spanish): Qué evolución tan extraña de creencias… esa definitivamente no es mi memoria. Sé que solía ser un hombre con convicción.
Text (Thai): วิวัฒนาการความเชื่อที่แปลกประหลาดเช่นนี้... นั่นไม่ใช่ความทรงจำของข้าอย่างแน่นอน ข้ารู้ว่าข้าเป็นคนที่มีศรัทธา
Text (Traditional Chinese): 真是奇怪的宗教儀式...這絕對不是我的記憶。我知道我是個虔誠的人。

Text: Help! Please, somebody, help me! I've fallen down here! I think I've hurt my leg! Hello?! Stay calm. I'm sure someone will come soon. I'm so hungry... If I get desperate, maybe I can eat some of the mushrooms down here.
Text (French): Au secours ! S'il vous plaît, quelqu'un, aidez-moi ! Je suis tombé ! Je crois que je me suis cassé la jambe ! Ohé… ! Reste calme. Quelqu'un va finir par arriver. Qu'est-ce que j'ai faim… En désespoir de cause, je pourrai toujours manger deux ou trois de ces champignons…
Text (German): Hilfe! Bitte, irgendjemand, helft mir! Ich bin hier runtergefallen! Ich glaube, ich habe mir das Bein verletzt! Hallo?! Nur Ruhe bewahren. Ich bin sicher, dass bald jemand kommen wird. Ich bin so hungrig ... Zur Not könnte ich einige der Pilze hier unten essen.
Text (Japanese): Help! Please, somebody, help me! I've fallen down here! I think I've hurt my leg! Hello?! Stay calm. I'm sure someone will come soon. I'm so hungry... If I get desperate, maybe I can eat some of the mushrooms down here.
Text (Korean): 도와주세요! 아무나 좀 도와주세요! 사람이 여기에 떨어졌어요! 다리를 다친 것 같아요! 아무도 없어요?! 진정하자. 분명 지나가는 사람이 있을 거야. 배가 너무 고픈데... 상황이 정 안 좋아지면 저 아래에 있는 버섯이라도 먹어야겠어.
Text (Portuguese): Socorro! Por favor, alguém me ajude! Eu caí aqui! Acho que machuquei minha perna! Olá? Acalme-se. Com certeza alguém virá logo. Estou com tanta fome... Se eu entrar em desespero, posso comer uns cogumelos desses aqui.
Text (Russian): Спасите! Кто-нибудь, пожалуйста, помогите мне! Я упал! Кажется, я сломал ногу! Эй?! Так, спокойно. Кто-нибудь обязательно скоро придёт... Я так хочу есть. Если живот совсем сведёт от голода, попробую съесть здешние грибы.
Text (Spanish): ¡Ayuda! ¡Por favor, alguien ayúdeme! ¡He caído aquí dentro! ¡Creo que lastimé mi pierna! ¡¿Hola?! Mantén la calma… Estoy seguro de que alguien vendrá pronto. Tengo tanta hambre… Si estoy demasiado desesperado quizás pueda comer alguno de los hongos que hay aquí.
Text (Thai): Help! Please, somebody, help me! I've fallen down here! I think I've hurt my leg! Hello?! Stay calm. I'm sure someone will come soon. I'm so hungry... If I get desperate, maybe I can eat some of the mushrooms down here.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 救命！拜託，誰來救救我！我摔下來了！而且我想我的腿受傷了！哈囉！？冷靜下來，我相信一定有人會經過這裡的。我好餓...危急時，我想我可以吃旁邊的蘑菇求生。

Text: I feel strange... my head feels like it is filled with bubbles. Are the walls breathing? The colours here are so vibrant... oh... my stomach... I'm ill. The world is spinning and, oh, my gut! What did I eat? I feel--
Text (French): Je me sens bizarre… Comme si j'avais la tête remplie de bulles. Les murs seraient pas en train de respirer ? Ma parole, les couleurs sont vraiment vives ici… Aïe… Mon ventre… Je suis malade. Le monde vrille autour de moi et — aïe, mon bide ! Qu'est-ce que j'ai bien pu avaler ? Je me sens —
Text (German): Ich fühle mich seltsam ... mein Kopf fühlt sich an, als wäre er mit Blasen gefüllt. Atmen die Wände etwa? Die Farben hier sind so prächtig ... oh ... mein Magen ... ich bin krank. Die Welt dreht sich und, oh, mein Bauch! Was habe ich gegessen? Ich fühle mich –
Text (Japanese): I feel strange... my head feels like it is filled with bubbles. Are the walls breathing? The colours here are so vibrant... oh... my stomach... I'm ill. The world is spinning and, oh, my gut! What did I eat? I feel--
Text (Korean): 기분이 이상해... 머리에 거품이 가득 낀 것 같아. 벽이 숨을 쉬는 건가? 색깔이 굉장히 선명한... 으... 배가... 뭔가 잘못됐어. 세상이 도네... 으, 배야! 내가 뭘 먹었었지? 기분이...
Text (Portuguese): Sinto-me estranha... Minha cabeça parece estar cheia de bolhas. As paredes estão respirando? As cores aqui são tão vibrantes... Oh... Meu estômago... Não estou bem. O mundo gira e oh, minhas entranhas! O que eu comi? Eu sinto--
Text (Russian): Странное чувство... Моя голова будто наполнена пузырьками. А эти стены... Они дышат? Какие яркие здесь цвета... Ох. Мой живот... Я болен. Всё вокруг вращается и... Ах, мои кишки! Что я такого съел? Я сейчас...
Text (Spanish): Me siento extraño. Siento mi cabeza llena de burbujas. ¿Están respirando las paredes? Los colores son tan vibrantes… oh… mi estómago… estoy enfermo. El mundo gira y, ¡ay, mis tripas! ¿Qué comí? Me siento…
Text (Thai): I feel strange... my head feels like it is filled with bubbles. Are the walls breathing? The colours here are so vibrant... oh... my stomach... I'm ill. The world is spinning and, oh, my gut! What did I eat? I feel--
Text (Traditional Chinese): 感覺好怪...我的腦袋裡面像充滿了泡泡。那個牆壁在吐氣？哦啊好鮮豔的顏色...哦...我的胃...這蘑菇...有毒...。所有的東西都在旋轉，天旋地轉，噢，我的內臟！我到底吃了什麼？我覺得－－...

Text: Wow... Exile... that was a very strange memory. Certainly not my own.
Text (French): <if:MS>{Houla… Exilé… En voilà un étrange souvenir. Ce n'était certainement pas le mien.}<elif:FS>{Houla… Exilée… En voilà un étrange souvenir. Ce n'était certainement pas le mien.}
Text (German): <if:MS>{Wow ... Verbannter ... das war eine ausgesprochen merkwürdige Erinnerung. Ganz sicher nicht meine eigene.}<elif:FS>{Wow ... Verbannte ... das war eine ausgesprochen merkwürdige Erinnerung. Ganz sicher nicht meine eigene.}
Text (Japanese): Wow... Exile... that was a very strange memory. Certainly not my own.
Text (Korean): 우... 유배자... 굉장히 이상한 기억이었어. 물론 내 기억은 아니었고 말이지.
Text (Portuguese): <if:MS>{Wow... Exilado... Esssa memória foi muito estranha. Certamente não é minha.}<elif:FS>{Wow... Exilada... Esssa memória foi muito estranha. Certamente não é minha.}
Text (Russian): <if:MS>{Ух... Изгнанник... Это более чем странное воспоминание. И уж точно не моё.}<elif:FS>{Ух... Изгнанница... Это более чем странное воспоминание. И уж точно не моё.}
Text (Spanish): <if:MS>{Vaya, exiliado… esa fue una memoria muy extraña. Definitivamente no era mía.}<elif:FS>{Vaya, exiliada… esa fue una memoria muy extraña. Definitivamente no era mía.}
Text (Thai): ว้าว... เอ็กไซล์... นั่นเป็นความทรงจำที่แปลกมาก ไม่ใช่ความทรงจำของข้าอย่างแน่นอน
Text (Traditional Chinese): 哇...流亡者...這真是個非常奇怪的記憶。鐵定不是我的。

Text: I cannot escape the feeling that I am being cooked by the sun in a cauldron made of sand. As I dream of water, walking, dying, I see it: an oasis.
Text (French): Impossible de chasser l'impression que le soleil est en train de me faire cuire dans un chaudron de sable. Tandis que je rêve d'eau en marchant, à l'article de la mort, je la vois soudain apparaître : une oasis.
Text (German): Ich werde das Gefühl nicht los, dass ich mich in einem großen Kessel voller Sand befinde. Die Hitze der Sonne brennt auf meiner Haut. Ich träume von Wasser, torkle vor mich hin, bin dem Sterben nahe, und da sehe ich es: eine Oase.
Text (Japanese): I cannot escape the feeling that I am being cooked by the sun in a cauldron made of sand. As I dream of water, walking, dying, I see it: an oasis.
Text (Korean): 모래 가마솥 안에서 햇빛에 구워지는 듯한 기분을 벗어던질 수가 없다. 물을 갈망하며, 걸어가고, 죽어가는 동안 그것이 보였다. 오아시스다.
Text (Portuguese): Parecia que eu estava cozinhando no sol em uma panela de areia. Eu sonhava com água ao caminhar, quase morrendo, quando eu vi: um oasis.
Text (Russian): Не могу избавиться от чувства, что солнце жарит меня на сковородке из песка. Я иду, брежу о воде и готовлюсь умереть, но вижу оазис.
Text (Spanish): No puedo escapar la sensación de estar asándome por el sol en un caldero hecho de arena. Mientras sueño con algo de agua, caminando y muriendo, lo veo: un oasis.
Text (Thai): ข้าไม่อาจหนีความรู้สึกว่าข้าถูกปรุงโดยแสงแดดในหม้อที่ทำจากทราย ขณะที่ข้าฝันถึงน้ำกำลังเดินและกำลังจะตาย ข้าเห็นมัน: โอเอซิส
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我無法擺脫那種像是被丟在砂鍋中受烈日烹煮的感覺。當我夢見水、步行、死亡，我看見了：是綠洲。

Text: I slake my thirst with chill liquid that sparkles in the sun. I dunk my head, then lie down, exhausted and exhilarated. Today, I get to live.
Text (French): J'étanche ma soif de ce liquide frais qui étincèle au soleil, puis je plonge la tête dedans avant de finalement m'allonger, aussi exténué qu'exalté. Je vivrai encore un autre jour.
Text (German): Ich stille meinen Durst mit dem kühlen Nass, das in der Sonne glitzert. Ich tauche meinen Kopf ein und lege mich hin, vollkommen erschöpft. Heute bin ich mit dem Leben davongekommen.
Text (Japanese): I slake my thirst with chill liquid that sparkles in the sun. I dunk my head, then lie down, exhausted and exhilarated. Today, I get to live.
Text (Korean): 햇빛에 반짝이는 차가운 액체로 목을 축였다. 머리를 물에 담근 다음엔 드러누워 버렸다. 기진맥진했지만 기운이 솟는 듯하다. 오늘도 난 살아남았다.
Text (Portuguese): Matei a sede com o líquido gelado que brilhava sob o sol. Mergulhei a cabeça, então deitei, exausto e em júbilo. Hoje, eu viveria.
Text (Russian): Я утоляю жажду прохладной водой, которая искрится под солнечными лучами. Лью воду на голову и ложусь, донельзя уставшая, но счастливая. Сегодня я ещё поживу.
Text (Spanish): Aplaco mi sed con el fresco líquido que brilla en la luz del sol. Hundo mi cabeza y me acuesto, exhausto y eufórico. Hoy, puedo vivir.
Text (Thai): ข้าดับกระหายด้วยของเหลวเย็นที่ส่องประกายในดวงอาทิตย์ ข้าจุ่มหัวแล้วก็นอนลงหมดแรงและเบิกบาน วันนี้ข้าได้อยู่ต่อไป
Text (Traditional Chinese): 在烈日底下搖曳著閃光的冰冷的液體解除了我的飢渴。我晃了晃頭，接著躺下，筋疲力竭，但興奮不已。今天，我活過來了。

Text: Even if I could remember my life, Exile, I am certain no single drink would ever have tasted so good.
Text (French): <if:MS>{Même si je me rappelais mon existence, exilé, je suis sûr qu'aucun breuvage n'a jamais été aussi bon.}<elif:FS>{Même si je me rappelais mon existence, exilée, je suis sûr qu'aucun breuvage n'a jamais été aussi bon.}
Text (German): <if:MS>{Selbst wenn ich mich an mein Leben erinnern könnte, Verbannter, wäre ich mir dieser einen Sache gewiss: Kein einziges Getränk hat jemals so gut geschmeckt.}<elif:FS>{Selbst wenn ich mich an mein Leben erinnern könnte, Verbannte, wäre ich mir dieser einen Sache gewiss: Kein einziges Getränk hat jemals so gut geschmeckt.}
Text (Japanese): Even if I could remember my life, Exile, I am certain no single drink would ever have tasted so good.
Text (Korean): 설령 내 기억을 되찾는다고 해도, 이 정도로 감미로운 물맛을 느껴본 적은 없었을 거야.
Text (Portuguese): <if:MS>{Mesmo se eu pudesse me lembrar da minha vida, Exilado, tenho certeza de que bebida nenhuma teria o gosto tão bom. }<elif:FS>{Mesmo se eu pudesse me lembrar da minha vida, Exilada, tenho certeza de que bebida nenhuma teria o gosto tão bom. }
Text (Russian): <if:MS>{Изгнанник, даже сумей я вспомнить прошлую жизнь, такой сладкой и вкусной воды я не пил отродясь.}<elif:FS>{Изгнанница, даже сумей я вспомнить прошлую жизнь, такой сладкой и вкусной воды я не пил отродясь.}
Text (Spanish): <if:MS>{Aunque pudiera recordar mi vida, exiliado, estoy seguro de que ningún trago de nada podría haber sabido tan bien.}<elif:FS>{Aunque pudiera recordar mi vida, exiliada, estoy seguro de que ningún trago de nada podría haber sabido tan bien.}
Text (Thai): Even if I could remember my life, Exile, I am certain no single drink would ever have tasted so good.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 即使在我僅存的記憶之中，流亡者，我非常肯定沒有任何的飲料嚐起來能有如此美妙的滋味。

Text: Centuries of my predecessors line these walls. It is the ultimate honor to rest with them, supposedly, but I have my doubts.
Text (French): Des siècles de mes prédécesseurs sont alignés le long de ces murs. Reposer parmi eux représente apparemment l'honneur ultime, mais je nourris quelques doutes à ce propos.
Text (German): Jahrhunderte meiner Vorgänger säumen diese Mauern. Es ist angeblich die größte Ehre, bei ihnen zu ruhen, aber ich hege da so meine Zweifel.
Text (Japanese): Centuries of my predecessors line these walls. It is the ultimate honor to rest with them, supposedly, but I have my doubts.
Text (Korean): 수백년에 걸친 전임자들이 이 벽에 줄지어 있다. 저들의 곁에 안치되는 것은 최고의 명예라던데, 정말로 그럴까?
Text (Portuguese): Séculos de meus predecessores estão nessas paredes. Teoricamente é a maior honra descansar junto deles, mas eu tenho minhas dúvidas.
Text (Russian): Моих предков хоронили в этих стенах столетиями. Считается, что упокоиться рядом с ними — высшая честь, но меня точит червячок сомнений.
Text (Spanish): Siglos de predecesores cubren estas paredes. Se supone que es el más grande honor descansar con ellos, pero tengo mis dudas.
Text (Thai): Centuries of my predecessors line these walls. It is the ultimate honor to rest with them, supposedly, but I have my doubts.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 幾百年來所有前任者都被掛在這堵牆上。據說與之長眠可以說是至高的榮耀，但我很懷疑。

Text: How would anyone know which bones are mine? How would anyone know that I am even here? Because I recognise none of these remains myself...
Text (French): Qui pourrait savoir lesquels de ces ossements m'appartiennent ? Avec quelle certitude pourrait-on s'assurer que je suis bel et bien ici ? Parce que, personnellement, je ne reconnais aucun de ces restes…
Text (German): Woher sollte jemand wissen, welche Knochen mir gehören? Woher sollte jemand wissen, dass ich überhaupt hier bin? Ich erkenne nämlich selbst nicht, wem diese Überreste gehören ...
Text (Japanese): How would anyone know which bones are mine? How would anyone know that I am even here? Because I recognise none of these remains myself...
Text (Korean): 어느 뼈가 내 것인지 누가 어떻게 안다는 거지? 내가 여기에 있기는 한 건지 누가 어떻게 안다고? 나 역시도 이 유해들을 알아볼 수 없는데...
Text (Portuguese): Como alguém saberia quais ossos são os meus? Como alguém sequer saberia que eu estou aqui? Porque eu mesmo não reconheço nenhum desses restos...
Text (Russian): Как другие поймут, какие из этих костей принадлежат мне? Откуда они вообще узнают, что я там есть? Ведь я не могу опознать ни одного из усопших...
Text (Spanish): ¿Cómo podría alguien saber cuáles son mis huesos? ¿Cómo podría alguien siquiera saber que estoy aquí? Porque yo no reconozco ninguno de estos restos…
Text (Thai): How would anyone know which bones are mine? How would anyone know that I am even here? Because I recognise none of these remains myself...
Text (Traditional Chinese): 誰會知道哪些死人骨頭是我的呢？甚至有沒有人知道我混在裡面都不知道吧？甚至連我自己都不知道哪些遺骸是我的了...

Text: I can relate to that feeling, Exile.
Text (French): <if:MS>{Je me reconnais dans ce sentiment, exilé.}<elif:FS>{Je me reconnais dans ce sentiment, exilée.}
Text (German): <if:MS>{Ich kann mit ihm mitfühlen, Verbannter.}<elif:FS>{Ich kann mit ihm mitfühlen, Verbannte.}
Text (Japanese): I can relate to that feeling, Exile.
Text (Korean): 내 저 기분 잘 이해하지, 암.
Text (Portuguese): <if:MS>{Eu consigo me identificar com esse sentimento, Exilado. }<elif:FS>{Eu consigo me identificar com esse sentimento, Exilada.}
Text (Russian): <if:MS>{Изгнанник, я понимаю его чувства.}<elif:FS>{Изгнанница, я понимаю его чувства.}
Text (Spanish): <if:MS>{Me siento identificado con ese sentimiento, exiliado.}<elif:FS>{Me sientoidentificado con ese sentimiento, exiliada.}
Text (Thai): I can relate to that feeling, Exile.

Text: People stream down the street towards Oriath Square. I hear their shouts and cheers, and when Mother isn't looking, sneak out to join the merry crowd. Just outside the pens, a Karui boy, no older than I, stands atop the gallows.
Text (French): Les gens affluent dans la rue qui mène à la Place d'Oriath. Excité par les cris et les acclamations, je me glisse dans la foule en liesse aussitôt que Mère a le dos tourné. À l'extérieur des enclos, je vois un garçon karui de mon âge debout sur l'échafaud.
Text (German): Die Menschen strömen die Straße hinunter in Richtung Oriaths Stadtplatz. Ich höre ihre Schreie und Jubelrufe, und als Mutter nicht hinsieht, schleiche ich mich hinaus, um mich der fröhlichen Menge anzuschließen. Etwas außerhalb der Sklavenpferche steht ein Karui-Junge, nicht älter als ich, am Galgen.
Text (Japanese): People stream down the street towards Oriath Square. I hear their shouts and cheers, and when Mother isn't looking, sneak out to join the merry crowd. Just outside the pens, a Karui boy, no older than I, stands atop the gallows.
Text (Korean): 사람들이 길을 따라 오리아스 광장으로 몰려들었다. 밖에서 들려오는 함성과 환호에 홀려 어머니 몰래 그 흐름에 합류했다. 쳐 놓은 울타리 바로 저편에, 내 또래의 카루이 소년이 교수대 위에 서 있었다.
Text (Portuguese): As pessoas corriam pela rua em direção à Praça de Oriath. Escutava seus gritos e aplausos, e quando mamãe não estava olhando, saí sorrateiramente para me juntar à multidão alegre. Além do rebuliço, um menino Karui, não mais velho que eu, pendurado na forca.
Text (Russian): Люди идут по улице к площади Ориата. Я слышу их выкрики и радостный гам. Стоит маме отвернуться, как я выскальзываю наружу и вливаюсь в весёлую толпу. Прямо возле бараков я вижу каруи. Мальчишку едва ли старше меня, который стоит на помосте виселицы.
Text (Spanish): La gente se arremolina hacia la Plaza de Oriath. Escucho sus gritos y vítores, y cuando madre no mira, me escabullo para unirme a la alegre multitud. Fuera de las jaulas hay un chico karui, no mayor que yo, parado en la horca.
Text (Thai): People stream down the street towards Oriath Square. I hear their shouts and cheers, and when Mother isn't looking, sneak out to join the merry crowd. Just outside the pens, a Karui boy, no older than I, stands atop the gallows.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 群眾往奧瑞亞大廣場聚集。我聽到他們的叫喊與歡呼聲，而我趁母親不注意時偷偷溜出去加入了歡騰的人群中。在欄杆外，我看見一個比我還年輕的卡魯族小孩，站在絞刑架上。

Text: I see by the sign around his neck he has been caught stealing. I swear I will not look away. But fear overtakes me. I hear the rope snap taut and the crowd cheer, but I fight back tears...
Text (French): Je comprends grâce à l'écriteau qui pend à son cou qu'il a été pris en flagrant délit de vol. Je me promets de ne pas détourner le regard, mais ma peur l'emporte. J'entends la corde se tendre subitement et la foule pousser des exclamations de joie tandis que je retiens mes larmes…
Text (German): Anhand des Schilds um seinen Hals erkenne ich, dass er beim Stehlen erwischt worden ist. Ich schwöre, ich werde nicht wegschauen. Aber die Angst überkommt mich. Ich höre, wie das Seil straff wird und die Menge jubelt, während ich gegen die Tränen ankämpfe ...
Text (Japanese): I see by the sign around his neck he has been caught stealing. I swear I will not look away. But fear overtakes me. I hear the rope snap taut and the crowd cheer, but I fight back tears...
Text (Korean): 목에 건 판자를 보니 도둑질을 하다가 붙잡힌 아이였다. 끝까지 지켜볼 것이라고 속으로 맹세해 보지만 두려움이 엄습해오는 건 어쩔 수가 없다. 밧줄이 팽팽해지는 소리와 사람들의 환호 소리가 들려 왔다. 난 그저 흘러내리려는 눈물을 참을 뿐이었다.
Text (Portuguese): Vi pela marca em seu pescoço que ele fora pego roubando. Jurei que não desviaria o olhar. Mas o medo me consumiu. Escutei o estalo da corda e a alegria da plateia, mas lutei contra as lágrimas...
Text (Russian): Я вижу на его шее табличку с надписью, что мальчика поймали на воровстве. Я клянусь себе не отворачиваться, но страх оказывается сильнее. Я слышу звук натянутой верёвки и одобрительный гомон толпы, но с трудом сдерживаю слезы.
Text (Spanish): Veo el letrero en su cuello y sé que lo atraparon robando. Juro que no desviaré la mirada, pero el miedo me supera. Oigo cómo la soga se tensa y la multitud aclama, pero me esfuerzo para no llorar…
Text (Thai): I see by the sign around his neck he has been caught stealing. I swear I will not look away. But fear overtakes me. I hear the rope snap taut and the crowd cheer, but I fight back tears...
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我看見他脖子上的記號，他是因為偷竊被捕。我發誓我不會把眼光移開。但恐懼直竄心頭。我聽件繩索緊繃的聲音與人群的歡呼聲，但我的淚水奪眶而出...

Text: I remember this well, Exile. I remember hearing that snap in my dreams for many years.
Text (French): <if:MS>{Je m'en souviens bien, exilé. Je me rappelle avoir entendu le claquement de cette corde dans mes rêves pendant de nombreuses années.}<elif:FS>{Je m'en souviens bien, exilée. Je me rappelle avoir entendu le claquement de cette corde dans mes rêves pendant de nombreuses années.}
Text (German): <if:MS>{Ich erinnere mich gut daran, Verbannter. Ich erinnere mich an das Geräusch des straff werdenden Seils, das viele Jahre lang meine Träume begleitete.}<elif:FS>{Ich erinnere mich gut daran, Verbannte. Ich erinnere mich an das Geräusch des straff werdenden Seils, das viele Jahre lang meine Träume begleitete.}
Text (Japanese): I remember this well, Exile. I remember hearing that snap in my dreams for many years.
Text (Korean): 기억이 떠오르는군. 줄이 팽팽해지는 저 소리를 몇 년 동안이나 꿈에서 들어왔던 기억이 나.
Text (Portuguese): <if:MS>{Eu me lembro bem disso, Exilado. Eu me lembro de ouvir aquele estalo em meus sonhos por muitos anos. }<elif:FS>{Eu me lembro bem disso, Exilada. Eu me lembro de ouvir aquele estalo em meus sonhos por muitos anos. }
Text (Russian): <if:MS>{Я хорошо это помню, изгнанник. Помню, потому что многие годы слышал этот звук во сне.}<elif:FS>{Я хорошо это помню, изгнанница. Помню, потому что многие годы слышал этот звук во сне.}
Text (Spanish): <if:MS>{Recuerdo bien esto, exiliado. Recuerdo haber escuchado ese chasquido en mis sueños durante muchos años.}<elif:FS>{Recuerdo bien esto, exiliada. Recuerdo haber escuchado ese chasquido en mis sueños durante muchos años.}
Text (Thai): I remember this well, Exile. I remember hearing that snap in my dreams for many years.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我記得很清楚，流亡者。我記得多年以來我不斷在夢中聽過那些叫罵聲。

Text: The stench convenes around me thicker than the press of the vagabonds themselves. Though starving, their strength while holding on to one another is surprising. I'm trapped in a knot of ragged bodies, and the men of the Church clap me in irons despite my cries.
Text (French): La puanteur des lieux me suffoque encore davantage que la masse de vagabonds pressée contre moi. Même affamés, ils sont capables d'une force prodigieuse lorsqu'ils s'appuient l'un sur l'autre. Je suis empêtré dans un nœud de corps déguenillés et les hommes de l'Église me mettent aux fers malgré mes supplications.
Text (German): Der Gestank um mich herum ist stärker als die Muskeln der Vagabunden. Obwohl sie ausgehungert sind, halten sie einander mit einer solch überraschenden Kraft fest. Ich bin gefangen in einem Knoten aus geschundenen Körpern, und mein klägliches Schreien hält die Männer der Kirche nicht davon ab, mich in Ketten zu legen.
Text (Japanese): The stench convenes around me thicker than the press of the vagabonds themselves. Though starving, their strength while holding on to one another is surprising. I'm trapped in a knot of ragged bodies, and the men of the Church clap me in irons despite my cries.
Text (Korean): 노숙자들 그 자체보다도 악취가 더욱더 진득하게 내게 달라붙는다. 굶주렸음에도 이들이 서로에게 달라붙는 힘은 놀랍기까지 하다. 교회 사람들이 그런 비루한 몸뚱이들 사이에 갇혀 있는 나를 철창에 가둔다. 내 비명은 철장 속에서 공허히 울릴 뿐이었다.
Text (Portuguese): O fedor me cercava mais do que a pressão dos próprios vagabundos. Ainda que famintos, a força que se seguravam uns aos outros era surpreendente. Estava preso em um nó de corpos esfarrapados, e os homens da Igreja me algemaram, apesar dos meus gritos.
Text (Russian): Сила окутывающей вони превосходит даже силу пихающих меня мерзавцев. Люди здесь голодают, но с поразительной силой держатся друг за друга. Я вязну в толпе оборванцев, а храмовники заковывают меня в железо несмотря на протесты.
Text (Spanish): El hedor hace más presión sobre mí que el peso de los propios vagabundos. Aunque están hambrientos, su fuerza mientras se agarran unos a otros es sorprendente. Estoy atrapado en un embrollo de cuerpos andrajosos, y los hombres de la iglesia me encadenan a pesar de mis gritos.
Text (Thai): The stench convenes around me thicker than the press of the vagabonds themselves. Though starving, their strength while holding on to one another is surprising. I'm trapped in a knot of ragged bodies, and the men of the Church clap me in irons despite my cries.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我周圍的惡臭堪比那個無賴對我所施加的壓力。雖然我也很餓，但這兩種感覺摻雜在一起之強烈依舊令人感到驚訝。我體無完膚的被綁著，而那個來自教堂的男人無視我的哭聲，不斷地以鐵條痛毆我。

Text: I'm not one of them! Can't you hear me? I'm not Maraketh, nor homeless, and have committed no sins. That ship is not for me! Why won't you listen?
Text (French): Je ne suis pas l'un d'eux ! Vous ne m'entendez donc pas ? Je ne suis ni Maraketh ni sans-abri et je n'ai commis aucun péché ! Je n'ai rien à faire dans ce navire ! Pourquoi ne m'écoutez-vous pas ?
Text (German): Ich bin keiner von ihnen! Könnt ihr mich nicht hören? Ich bin weder ein Maraketh noch obdachlos und frei von Sünden. Das Schiff ist nicht für mich! Warum hört ihr mir nicht zu?
Text (Japanese): I'm not one of them! Can't you hear me? I'm not Maraketh, nor homeless, and have committed no sins. That ship is not for me! Why won't you listen?
Text (Korean): 난 저쪽 사람이 아니라고! 내 말 안 들려? 난 마라케스 사람도 아니고, 노숙자도 아냐! 죄를 짓지도 않았고! 저 배는 내가 탈 배가 아니라는데 왜 내 말을 안 들어주는데?
Text (Portuguese): Eu não sou um deles! Estão me ouvindo? Eu não sou Maraketh, nem sem-teto, e não comei pecados. Aquele navio não é pra mim! Por que não me escutam?
Text (Russian): Я не из этих! Вы меня слышите? Я не маракет, не бездомный и не совершал грехов. Я не должен быть на этом корабле! Почему вы не слушаете?
Text (Spanish): ¡No soy uno de ellos! ¿No me oyen? No soy maraketh, ni un indigente, y no he cometido ningún pecado. ¡Ese barco no es para mí! ¡¿Por qué no me escuchan?!
Text (Thai): I'm not one of them! Can't you hear me? I'm not Maraketh, nor homeless, and have committed no sins. That ship is not for me! Why won't you listen?
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我跟他們不是一夥的！你沒聽見嗎？我不是馬拉克斯人，我也不是流浪漢，我更沒有犯任何的罪。我不屬於那艘船！為什麼你就是聽不懂？

Text: I think this is one of mine, Exile. I feel it: at eight years old, I was almost exiled by mere happenstance. If my mother had not found me and gotten the Templars to release me, I would have been lost...
Text (French): <if:MS>{Je crois que c'est l'un de mes miens, exilé. Ça me revient : à l'âge de huit ans, j'ai presque été forcé à l'exil par erreur. Si ma mère ne m'avait pas trouvé et qu'elle n'avait pas convaincu les Templiers de me libérer, j'aurais été perdu pour de bon…}<elif:FS>{Je crois que c'est l'un de mes miens, exilée. Ça me revient : à l'âge de huit ans, j'ai presque été forcé à l'exil par erreur. Si ma mère ne m'avait pas trouvé et qu'elle n'avait pas convaincu les Templiers de me libérer, j'aurais été perdu pour de bon…}
Text (German): <if:MS>{Ich glaube diese hier ist meine, Verbannter. Ich kann es spüren: Mit acht Jahren drohte mir die Verbannung. Hätte meine Mutter mich damals nicht gefunden und die Templer davon überzeugt, mich gehen zu lassen, wäre ich für immer verloren gewesen ...}<elif:FS>{Ich glaube diese hier ist meine, Verbannte. Ich kann es spüren: Mit acht Jahren drohte mir die Verbannung. Hätte meine Mutter mich damals nicht gefunden und die Templer davon überzeugt, mich gehen zu lassen, wäre ich für immer verloren gewesen ...}
Text (Japanese): I think this is one of mine, Exile. I feel it: at eight years old, I was almost exiled by mere happenstance. If my mother had not found me and gotten the Templars to release me, I would have been lost...
Text (Korean): 유배자, 이건 내 기억인 것 같은데. 그런 기분이 들어. 여덟살 때, 어쩌다 보니 거의 추방당할 뻔했었지. 어머니가 나를 찾아 템플러들에게서 빼내지 않았다면 난 그때 그대로 사라졌을지도...
Text (Portuguese): <if:MS>{Acho que essa é uma das minhas, Exilado. Posso sentir: aos oito anos de idade, eu quase fui exilado pelo mero acaso. Se minha mãe não tivesse me encontrado e feito os Templários me libertarem, eu estaria perdido...}<elif:FS>{Acho que essa é uma das minhas, Exilada. Posso sentir: aos oito anos de idade, eu quase fui exilado pelo mero acaso. Se minha mãe não tivesse me encontrado e feito os Templários me libertarem, eu estaria perdido...}
Text (Russian): <if:MS>{Изгнанник, кажется, это моё воспоминание. Я вспоминаю, как восьмилетним мальчишкой едва не был выслан из-за какого-то пустяка. Не найди меня мама, не скажи она жрецам отпустить меня, я бы пропал...}<elif:FS>{Изгнанница, кажется, это моё воспоминание. Я вспоминаю, как восьмилетним мальчишкой едва не был выслан из-за какого-то пустяка. Не найди меня мама, не скажи она жрецам отпустить меня, я бы пропал...}
Text (Spanish): <if:MS>{Creo que esta es una de las mías, exiliado. Puedo sentirlo: a los ocho años, casi fui exiliado por equivocación. Si mi madre no me hubiera encontrado y hecho que los Templarios me liberen, habría estado perdido...}<elif:FS>{Creo que esta es una de las mías, exiliada. Puedo sentirlo: a los ocho años, casi fui exiliado por equivocación. Si mi madre no me hubiera encontrado y hecho que los Templarios me liberen, habría estado perdido...}
Text (Thai): I think this is one of mine, Exile. I feel it: at eight years old, I was almost exiled by mere happenstance. If my mother had not found me and gotten the Templars to release me, I would have been lost...
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我想這是我的記憶，流亡者。我感受到了：在我八歲的時候，我差一點就被流放了。如果我的母親沒有即時找到我，並說服聖堂武僧放我走，我想我會失去...

Text: I've thirsted for adventure my entire life, but I suppose, at eighty-two, the most I can do now is walk along the village plateau.
Text (French): J'ai eu soif d'aventures toute ma vie, mais j'imagine qu'à quatre-vingt-deux ans, le mieux que je peux faire désormais est de me promener le long du plateau du village.
Text (German): Ich habe mich mein ganzes Leben lang nach Abenteuern gesehnt, aber nun nehme ich an, dass ich mit zweiundachtzig höchstens am Dorfplateau entlang spazieren kann.
Text (Japanese): I've thirsted for adventure my entire life, but I suppose, at eighty-two, the most I can do now is walk along the village plateau.
Text (Korean): 한평생을 모험에 목말라하며 살아왔지만, 여든두 살이 된 지금의 나에겐 마을 언덕을 오르는 일이 그나마 할 수 있는 전부구나.
Text (Portuguese): Tive sede de aventura a vida inteira, mas presumo que, aos oitenta e dois anos, o máximo que podia fazer era caminhar pelas planícies da aldeia.
Text (Russian): Всю жизнь меня манила дорога странствий, но теперь, в восемьдесят два года, я могу разве что прогуляться у деревни.
Text (Spanish): He ansiado la aventura durante toda mi vida, pero supongo que a mi edad, ochenta y dos años, lo más que puedo hacer es pasear por la explanada de la aldea.
Text (Thai): I've thirsted for adventure my entire life, but I suppose, at eighty-two, the most I can do now is walk along the village plateau.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我終其一生都渴望著冒險，但我想，在我八十二歲時，我頂多只能在村邊的高地晃晃而已吧。

Text: I dreamt of magic and adventure when I was younger. It's a shame this world isn't more exciting.
Text (French): Je rêvais de magie et d'aventure durant ma jeunesse. Dommage que ce monde ne soit pas plus palpitant.
Text (German): Ich habe von Magie und Abenteuern geträumt, als ich jünger war. Es ist eine Schande, dass diese Welt nicht aufregender ist.
Text (Japanese): I dreamt of magic and adventure when I was younger. It's a shame this world isn't more exciting.
Text (Korean): 젊은 시절에는 마법과 모험의 삶을 꿈꿨지. 이 세상이 그렇게까지 흥미진진한 곳은 아니라는 사실이 유감일 뿐이야.
Text (Portuguese): Eu sonhei com mágica e aventura quando era jovem. Uma pena que esse mundo não é mais emocionante.
Text (Russian): В молодости я грезил волшебством и приключениями. Как жаль, что мир стал скучным и тусклым.
Text (Spanish): Soñaba con aventuras y magia cuando era más joven. Es una pena que este mundo no sea tan emocionante.
Text (Thai): I dreamt of magic and adventure when I was younger. It's a shame this world isn't more exciting.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我年輕時曾經幻想充滿劍與魔法的探險時間。遺憾的是這個世界無聊得很。

Text: From what I've seen in my time with you, Exile, the owner of that memory must have been uncommonly lucky to avoid Wraeclast's dangers. Or, seemingly, unlucky.
Text (French): <if:MS>{À en juger par ce que j'ai pu voir à vos côtés, exilé, le possesseur de ce souvenir a eu l'incroyable chance d'échapper aux dangers de Wraeclast. Ou plutôt la malchance, visiblement.}<elif:FS>{À en juger par ce que j'ai pu voir à vos côtés, exilée, le possesseur de ce souvenir a eu l'incroyable chance d'échapper aux dangers de Wraeclast. Ou plutôt la malchance, visiblement.}
Text (German): <if:MS>{Wenn ich bedenke, was wir schon zusammen erlebt haben, Verbannter, muss der Besitzer dieser Erinnerung ungewöhnlich viel Glück gehabt haben, den Gefahren Wraeclasts zu entgehen. Oder, wie es scheint, Unglück.}<elif:FS>{Wenn ich bedenke, was wir schon zusammen erlebt haben, Verbannte, muss der Besitzer dieser Erinnerung ungewöhnlich viel Glück gehabt haben, den Gefahren Wraeclasts zu entgehen. Oder, wie es scheint, Unglück.}
Text (Japanese): From what I've seen in my time with you, Exile, the owner of that memory must have been uncommonly lucky to avoid Wraeclast's dangers. Or, seemingly, unlucky.
Text (Korean): 내 시대를 기준으로 살펴본 바로는, 저 기억의 소유자는 레이클라스트의 무수한 위험을 피해간 흔치 않은 행운의 주인이었을 것 같아. 뭐 겉만 보면 그냥 운 없는 녀석 같기도 하지만.
Text (Portuguese): Pelo que vi em meu tempo com você, Exilado, o dono dessa memória deve ter dado uma sorte bem incomum para evitar os perigos de Wraeclast. Ou, ao que parece, não deu sorte.
Text (Russian): Из увиденного после знакомства с тобой я могу заключить, что хозяину этого воспоминания несказанно повезло избежать опасностей Рэкласта. Правда, он этого не понимал.
Text (Spanish): <if:MS>{Por lo que he visto durante mi tiempo contigo, exiliado, el dueño de esa memoria debe haber sido extrañamente afortunado para evadir los peligros de Wraeclast. O, aparentemente, desafortunado.}<elif:FS>{Por lo que he visto durante mi tiempo contigo, exiliada, el dueño de esa memoria debe haber sido extrañamente afortunado para evadir los peligros de Wraeclast. O, aparentemente, desafortunado.}
Text (Thai): From what I've seen in my time with you, Exile, the owner of that memory must have been uncommonly lucky to avoid Wraeclast's dangers. Or, seemingly, unlucky.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 從我跟你一起看過的記憶來說，流亡者，這個記憶的主人一定是個幸運無比的傢伙，居然能躲過瓦爾克拉斯上的危機。還是應該說是不幸運呢。

Text: My legs ache, but at last they can rest. We are two days journey from the nearest city, and the trickle of water sets me at ease. I begin to set up camp.
Text (French): Mes jambes me font mal, mais au moins elles peuvent se reposer. Nous sommes à deux jours de la ville la plus proche et le clapotis de l'eau m'apaise. Je commence à installer le campement.
Text (German): Meine Beine schmerzen, aber endlich können sie sich ausruhen. Wir sind zwei Tage von der nächsten Stadt entfernt, und das Rieseln des Wassers beruhigt mich. Ich beginne, ein Lager aufzuschlagen.
Text (Japanese): My legs ache, but at last they can rest. We are two days journey from the nearest city, and the trickle of water sets me at ease. I begin to set up camp.
Text (Korean): 다리는 좀 아프지만 드디어 쉴 수 있게 되었다. 이곳은 가장 가까운 도시까지도 이틀이 걸리는 곳이다. 흐르는 물줄기에 마음이 편안해진다. 나는 야영지를 차리기 시작했다.
Text (Portuguese): Minhas pernas doíam, mas finalmente descansavam. Estávamos a dois dias de viagem da cidade mais próxima e as gotas de água me acalmavam. Comecei a montar o acampamento.
Text (Russian): Мои ноги горят, но теперь я могу дать им отдых. Мы в двух днях пути от ближайшего города. Меня успокаивает мерное журчание воды. Я начинаю разбивать лагерь.
Text (Spanish): Me duelen las piernas, pero al fin pueden descansar. Estamos a dos días de viaje de la ciudad más cercana, y el ruido del agua me reconforta. Empiezo a preparar mi campamento.
Text (Thai): ข้าปวดขานัก แต่ในที่สุดก็สามารถพักขาได้สักที เราห่างจากเมืองที่ใกล้ที่สุดสองวัน และหยดน้ำทำให้ข้าสบายใจ ข้าเริ่มตั้งค่าย
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我的雙腿疼痛不已，但它們現在可以好好休息了。我們距離最近的城市只剩下兩天的路程，而且這邊的潺潺流水讓我感到輕鬆。我開始搭起營地。

Text: My wife bathes naked in the stream. I appreciate her form from the banks. With any luck, we will never see another person as long as we live.
Text (French): Ma femme se baigne nue dans le ruisseau tandis que je contemple ses formes depuis la berge. Avec un peu de chance, nous ne croiserons plus personne pour le restant de nos jours.
Text (German): Meine Frau badet nackt im Fluss. Ich genieße ihre Figur vom Ufer aus. Mit etwas Glück werden wir nie wieder einen anderen Menschen sehen, solange wir leben.
Text (Japanese): My wife bathes naked in the stream. I appreciate her form from the banks. With any luck, we will never see another person as long as we live.
Text (Korean): 아내가 개울에서 몸을 씻고 있다. 나는 둑에서 그녀의 모습을 즐겁게 지켜본다. 운이 좋다면 앞으로 아무도 만나지 않고 우리끼리만 살아갈 수 있으리라.
Text (Portuguese): Minha esposa se banhava nua no riacho. Apreciava sua beleza dos bancos. Com sorte, nunca teríamos que ver outra pessoa enquanto vivermos.
Text (Russian): Моя жена разделась и купается в ручье. Я любуюсь её формами с берега. Если повезёт, мы до конца своих дней не увидим других людей.
Text (Spanish): Mi esposa se baña desnuda en el arroyo. Aprecio su figura desde la orilla. Con algo de suerte, nunca más veremos a otra persona mientras vivamos.
Text (Thai): ภรรยาของข้าแก้ผ้าอาบน้ำในลำธาร ข้าชื่นชมเรือนร่างของเธอจากชายฝั่ง ด้วยโชคใดๆ เราจะไม่เห็นคนอื่นตราบเท่าที่เรามีชีวิตอยู่
Text (Traditional Chinese): 我老婆在溪裡洗澡。我則在河畔邊欣賞她曼妙的身姿。運氣好的話，不會有別人會來打擾我們倆。

Text: So peaceful. I could have dwelt in that memory forever. Alas, I do not think it belongs to me.
Text (French): Comme c'était paisible. J'aurais pu me prélasser dans ce souvenir pour toujours. Hélas, je ne crois pas qu'il m'appartienne.
Text (German): So friedlich. Ich hätte auf ewig in dieser Erinnerung schwelgen können. Das sagt mir, dass es nicht meine gewesen sein kann.
Text (Japanese): So peaceful. I could have dwelt in that memory forever. Alas, I do not think it belongs to me.
Text (Korean): 이렇게 평화로운 순간이라니. 이 기억 속에서라면 영원히 살아갈 수도 있겠어. 안타깝게도 나의 기억은 아닌 듯하지만.
Text (Portuguese): Tão pacífico. Eu poderia viver nessa memória pra sempre. Mas, não creio que pertença a mim.
Text (Russian): Какая мирная картина. Я бы хотел остаться в этом воспоминании. Увы, но маловероятно, чтобы оно принадлежало мне.
Text (Spanish): Qué pacífico. Podría haberme quedado en esa memoria para siempre. Desgraciadamente, no creo que me pertenezca.
Text (Thai): สงบสุขมาก ข้าคงจะระลึกความทรงจำนั้นได้ตลอดไป อนิจจาข้าไม่คิดว่าเป็นความทรงจำของข้า
Text (Traditional Chinese): 這世界是如此的和平。我想我可以永遠住在那個記憶之中。嗚呼哀哉，這個記憶不是屬於我的。

Text: The shackles cut into my wrists and ankles. The guards are deaf to my pleading, but I am no murderer. If I am guilty of anything, it is falling in love with the wrong person. Justice served, they claim.
Text (French): Les fers me mordent les poignets et les chevilles. Les gardiens restent sourds lorsque je leur clame mon innocence, mais je ne suis pas un meurtrier. Si je suis coupable de quelque chose, c'est d'être tombé amoureux de la mauvaise personne. Pff ! Justice rendue, qu'ils disent.
Text (German): Die Fesseln haben sich in meine Handgelenke und Knöchel geschnitten. Die Wachen reagieren meinem Flehen gegenüber mit Taubheit, aber ich bin kein Mörder. Wenn ich mich einer Sache schuldig gemacht habe, dann ist es, dass ich mich in die falsche Person verliebt habe. Der Gerechtigkeit ist Genüge getan, behaupten sie.
Text (Japanese): The shackles cut into my wrists and ankles. The guards are deaf to my pleading, but I am no murderer. If I am guilty of anything, it is falling in love with the wrong person. Justice served, they claim.
Text (Korean): 손목과 발목에 족쇄가 파고든다. 나는 살인자가 아니라고 아무리 애원해도 경비병들은 들은 척도 하지 않는다. 내게 죄가 있다면 사랑하지 말았어야 했던 사람과 사랑에 빠졌다는 거겠지. 이래놓고 정의가 실현되었다고 말하는 꼴이라니.
Text (Portuguese): As algemas cortavam meus pulsos e tornozelos. Os guardas não escutavam minhas súplicas, mas eu não era um assassino. Se eu era culpado de algo, era de ter me apaixonado pela pessoa errada. Ugh! Justiça foi feita, eles diziam.
Text (Russian): Оковы врезаются в запястья и лодыжки. Стража глуха к моим мольбам, а ведь я не убийца. Я виноват только в том, что полюбил не ту женщину. Они говорят, что справедливость восторжествовала.
Text (Spanish): Las cadenas cortan mis muñecas y mis tobillos. Los guardias hacen oídos sordos a mis súplicas, pero no soy ningún asesino. Si soy culpable de algo, es de enamorarme de la persona equivocada. Y claman estar haciendo justicia.
Text (Thai): The shackles cut into my wrists and ankles. The guards are deaf to my pleading, but I am no murderer. If I am guilty of anything, it is falling in love with the wrong person. Justice served, they claim.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 鐐銬深深的嵌入我的雙腕與腳踝。守衛對我的懇求充耳不聞，但我不是殺人犯。如果說我犯了什麼罪，那一定只有我愛上了錯誤的人。啊啊啊！他們居然聲稱，正義必得伸張。

Text: This is not justice. Any chance at justice evaporated the moment I walked into the courtroom and saw her husband held the gavel. I'm just the scapegoat. It's easy to get away with murder when you're the judge...
Text (French): Ça n'a rien de juste. Tout espoir que justice soit faite s'est volatilisé à l'instant où je suis entré dans la salle d'audience et que j'ai vu que c'était son mari qui tenait le marteau. Je ne suis que le bouc émissaire. Facile pour un meurtrier de s'en tirer quand c'est lui le juge…
Text (German): Das ist keine Gerechtigkeit. Jede Chance auf Gerechtigkeit verflog in dem Moment, als ich den Gerichtssaal betrat und sah, wie ihr Mann den Hammer hielt. Ich bin nichts weiter als der Sündenbock. Es ist einfach, mit Mord davonzukommen, wenn man der Richter ist ...
Text (Japanese): This is not justice. Any chance at justice evaporated the moment I walked into the courtroom and saw her husband held the gavel. I'm just the scapegoat. It's easy to get away with murder when you're the judge...
Text (Korean): 이런 건 정의가 아냐. 그녀의 남편이 법정 안에서 의사봉을 들고 있는 모습을 본 순간, 공정함 따위는 어디에도 없음을 깨달았다. 나는 그저 희생양일 뿐이었구나. 판사가 되면 합법적으로 사람을 죽이는 것이 이렇게 쉬운 거였구나...
Text (Portuguese): Isso não é justiça. Qualquer chance de justiça evaporou no momento em que adentrei o tribunal e vi o marido dela segurar o martelo. Fui o bode expiatório. É fácil se safar de homicídio quando se é o juiz...
Text (Russian): Это не справедливость. Любой намёк на справедливость испарился, когда я вошёл в зал суда и увидел молоточек в руке её мужа. Я стал козлом отпущения. Как просто уйти от правосудия, если убийца — судья...
Text (Spanish): Esto no es justicia. Cualquier posibilidad de justicia se evaporó al entrar a esa corte y ver que su esposo sostenía el martillo. Soy solo un chivo expiatorio. Es fácil salir indemne de un asesinato cuando eres el juez…
Text (Thai): นี่ไม่ใช่ความยุติธรรม โอกาสใด ๆ ของความยุติธรรมจะหายไปทันทีที่ข้าเดินเข้าไปในห้องพิจารณาคดีและเห็นว่าสามีของเธอถือค้อน ข้าเป็นแค่แพะรับบาป มันง่ายที่จะหนีจากการฆาตกรรมเมื่อเจ้าเป็นผู้พิพากษา
Text (Traditional Chinese): 這才不是正義。每當我走進法庭並看見那個女人的丈夫手持著木槌時，任何的公理與正義都蕩然無存。我只是個替罪的羔羊。當你就是法官時，逃避謀殺的罪責是易如反掌的事情...

Text: How horrid! Are all people as corrupt, Exile? Thankfully I'm certain this was not me.
Text (French): <if:MS>{Quelle horreur ! Est-ce que tout le monde est corrompu de la sorte, exilé ? Heureusement, je suis certain que ce n'était pas moi.}<elif:FS>{Quelle horreur ! Est-ce que tout le monde est corrompu de la sorte, exilée ? Heureusement, je suis certain que ce n'était pas moi.}
Text (German): <if:MS>{Wie grausam! Sind alle Menschen so korrupt, Verbannter? Glücklicherweise bin ich mir sicher, dass ich es nicht war.}<elif:FS>{Wie grausam! Sind alle Menschen so korrupt, Verbannte? Glücklicherweise bin ich mir sicher, dass ich es nicht war.}
Text (Japanese): How horrid! Are all people as corrupt, Exile? Thankfully I'm certain this was not me.
Text (Korean): 지독하구먼! 모든 사람들이 이렇게 타락한 건가? 다행히도 이자는 절대로 나는 아니었어.
Text (Portuguese): <if:MS>{Que horrível! Todas as pessoas são corruptas assim, Exilado? Ainda bem que estou certo de que esse não era eu. }<elif:FS>{Que horrível! Todas as pessoas são corruptas assim, Exilada? Ainda bem que estou certo de que esse não era eu. }
Text (Russian): <if:MS>{Какой кошмар! Изгнанник, неужто все люди гнилые внутри? Хорошо хоть это воспоминание ко мне не относится.}<elif:FS>{Какой кошмар! Изгнанница, неужто все люди гнилые внутри? Хорошо хоть это воспоминание ко мне не относится.}
Text (Spanish): <if:MS>{¡Qué horror! ¿Todas las personas son así de corruptas, exiliado? Por suerte estoy seguro de que ese no era yo.}<elif:FS>{¡Qué horror! ¿Todas las personas son así de corruptas, exiliada? Por suerte estoy seguro de que ese no era yo.}
Text (Thai): How horrid! Are all people as corrupt, Exile? Thankfully I'm certain this was not me.
Text (Traditional Chinese): 太可怕了！所有人都如此腐敗嗎，流亡者？謝天謝地，我確定那並不是我。

Text: I strike the earth once more as I have countless times, but my strike feels unfamiliar. Instead of the crack of stone, I am met with flexing sinew. I examine my pick axe. A dark red liquid froths on its tip.
Text (French): Je frappe le sol d'un nouveau coup de pioche comme je l'ai fait d'innombrables fois auparavant, mais l'impact me paraît inhabituel. Au lieu d'une fissure dans la pierre, je constate ce qui semble être un muscle qui se tord. J'examine mon outil… Un liquide sombre et rouge bouillonne sur la pointe.
Text (German): Ich schlage mit meiner Hacke in den Stein, so wie die unzähligen Male zuvor, doch dieses Mal fühlt sich mein Schlag ungewohnt an. Anstelle des bröckelnden Steins treffe ich eine fleischige Sehne. Ich begutachte meine Spitzhacke. Eine dunkelrote Flüssigkeit schäumt von der Spitze.
